text:
Dawat-e-Taqwa: Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko taqwe ka hukum farmata hai aur aane wale dehshat-naak umoor se dara raha hai, khusoosan Qayamat ke zalzale se. Is se murad ya toh woh zalzala hai jo Qayamat ke qaim hone ke darmiyan aayega. Jaise farman hai aayat (Iza zulzilatil-ardu zilzalaha) (Surah Az-Zalzalah: 1), zameen khoob achi tarah jhanjhor di jayegi. Aur farmaya aayat (Wa humilatil-ardu wal-jibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidah) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 14), yani zameen aur pahar utha kar baham takra kar tukre tukre kar diye jayenge. Aur farman hai aayat (Iza rujjatil-ardu rajja) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 4), yani jab ke zameen bare zor se hilne lagegi aur pahar reza reza ho jayenge. Soor ki hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala jab aasman-o-zameen ko paida kar chuka toh Soor ko paida kiya, use Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ko diya, woh use munh mein liye hue aankhein upar ko uthaye hue Arsh ki janib dekh rahe hain ke kab hukum-e-Ilahi ho aur woh Soor phoonk dein. Abu Huraira (R.A) ne poocha, Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Soor kya cheez hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, ek phoonkne ki cheez hai bahut bari jis mein teen martaba phoonka jayega; pehla nafkha ghabrahat ka hoga, dusra behoshi ka, teesra Allah ke samne khara hone ka. Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ko hukum hoga, woh phoonkenge jis se kul zameen-o-aasman wale ghabra uthenge siwaye un ke jinhein Allah chahe. Baghair ruke, baghair saans liye bahut der tak barabar use phoonkte rahenge. Isi pehle Soor ka zikr (Wama yanzuru ha'ula'i illa saihatan wahidatan malaha min fawaq) mein hai, is se pahar reza reza ho jayenge, zameen kapkapane lagegi. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yauma tarjuful-rajifah) (Surah An-Nazi'at: 6), jab ke zameen larzne lagegi aur yak-e-baad-e-deegare zabardast jhatke lagenge, dil dharakne lagenge, zameen ki woh halat ho jayegi jo kashti ki toofan mein aur girdab mein hoti hai, ya jaise koi qandeel Arsh mein latak rahi ho jise hawain charon taraf jhola rahi hon. Aah! Yehi waqt hoga ke doodh pilane waliyan apne doodh peete bachon ko bhool jayengi aur hamila aurton ke hamal gir jayenge aur bache boorhe ho jayenge, shayateen bhagne lagenge, zameen ke kinaron tak pahunch jayenge lekin wahan se farishton ki maar kha kar laut aayenge. Log idhar udhar hairan pareshan, zameen ek taraf se dusre ko aawazein dene lagenge, isi liye is din ka naam Quran ne Yaum-ut-Tanad rakha. Isi waqt zameen ek taraf se dusri taraf tak phat jayegi, is waqt ki ghabrahat ka andaza nahin ho sakta. Ab aasman mein inqilabat zahir honge, suraj chand benoor ho jayenge, sitare jharne lagenge aur khal udharne lagegi. Zinda log yeh sab kuch dekh rahe honge, haan murda log is se bekhabar honge. Aayat-e-Quran: (Wa nufikha fis-soori fasa'iqa man fis-samawati wa man fil-ardi illa man sha'allahu summa nufikha fihi ukhra fa-iza hum qiyamun yanzurun) (Surah Az-Zumar: 68).

(Az-Zumar: 68) mein jin logon ka istisna kiya gaya hai ke woh behosh na honge us se murad shaheed log hain. Yeh ghabrahat zindon par hogi, shaheed Allah ke haan zinda hain aur roziyan paate hain. Allah Ta'ala unhein us din ke sharr se nijat dega aur unhein pur-amn rakhega. Yeh azab-e-Ilahi sirf badtareen makhlooq ko hoga. Isi ko Allah Ta'ala is surat ki shuru ki ayaton mein bayan farmata hai. Yeh hadith Tabrani, Jarir, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim waghera mein hai aur bahut mutawwal hai, is hissay ko naqal karne se yahan maqsood yeh hai ke is ayat mein jis zalzalay ka zikr hai yeh Qayamat se pehle hoga. Aur Qayamat ki taraf is ki izafat bajah-e-qurb aur nazdeki ke hai. Jaise kaha jata hai Ashrat-us-Sa'ah waghera, wallahu a'lam. Ya is se murad woh zalzala hai jo qayam-e-Qayamat ke baad maidan-e-mahshar mein hoga jab ke log qabron se nikal kar maidan mein jama honge. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir isay pasand farmate hain, is ki daleel mein bhi bahut si hadithein hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek safar mein the, aap ke as-hab tez tez chal rahe the ke aap ne ba-awaz-e-buland in dono ayaton ki tilawat ki. Sahaba (R.A) ke kaan mein awaz parte hi woh sab apni sawariyan le kar aap ke gird-o-pesh jama ho gaye ke shayad aap kuch aur farmayenge. Aap ne farmaya jante ho yeh kaunsa din hoga? Yeh woh din hoga jis din Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko farmayega ke ae Adam! Jahannam ka hissa nikal. Woh kahenge ae Allah! kitnon mein se kitne? Farmayega har hazar mein se nau sau nannave (999) jahannam ke liye aur ek jannat ke liye. Yeh sunte hi sahaba ke dil dehal gaye, chup lag gayi. Aap ne yeh halat dekh kar farmaya ke gham na karo, khush ho jao, amal karte raho. Uss ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jaan hai, tumhare saath makhlooq ki woh tadaad hai ke jis ke saath ho usay barha de, yani Yajuj Majuj aur Bani Adam mein se jo halak ho gaye aur Iblees ki aulad. Ab sahaba ki ghabrahat kam hui to aap ne farmaya amal karte raho aur khushkhabri suno, uss ki qasam jis ke qabze mein Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki jaan hai, tum to aur logon ke muqable par aise hi ho jaise oont ke pehlu ka ya janwar ke haath ka daagh. Isi riwayat ki aur sanad mein hai ke yeh ayat halat-e-safar mein utri. Is mein hai ke sahaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka woh farman sun kar rone lage, aap ne farmaya qareeb qareeb raho aur theek thaak raho, har nabuwwat ke pehle jahiliyat ka zamana raha hai, wahi is ginti ko poori kar dega warna munafiqon se woh ginti poori hogi. Is mein hai ke aap ne farmaya ke mujhe to umeed hai ke ahl-e-jannat ki chauthai sirf tum hi hoge, yeh sun kar sahaba (R.A) ne Allahu Akbar kaha, irshad hua ke ajab nahin ke tum tihai ho, is par unhon ne phir takbeer kahi, aap ne farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke tum hi nisfan-nisf hoge, unhon ne phir takbeer kahi. Rawi kehte hain mujhe yaad nahin ke phir aap ne do-tihaiyan bhi farmayin ya nahin? Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabuk se wapsi mein Madine ke qareeb pahunch kar aap ne tilawat-e-ayat shuru ki.

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke jinnon aur insaanon se jo halak hue aur riwayat mein hai ke tum toh ek hazaar ajza mein se ek juz hi ho. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is aayat ki tafsir mein hai ke Qayamat wale din Allah Ta'ala Adam A.S ko pukarega woh jawab denge Labbaik Rabbana wa Sa'daik phir aawaz aayegi ke Allah tujhe hukum deta hai ke apni aulad mein se Jahannam ka hissa nikal, poochenge Allah kitna? Hukum hoga har hazaar mein se nau sau nannave (999). Us waqt hamila ke hamal gir jayenge, bachche boodhe ho jayenge, aur log hawas bakhta ho jayenge kisi nashe se nahin balki Allah ke azabon ki sakhti ki wajah se. Yeh sun kar Sahaba ke chehre mutaghayyar ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Yajuj Majuj mein se nau sau nannave aur tum mein se ek. Tum toh aise ho jaise safed rang bail ke chand siyah baal jo uske pehlu mein hon. Ya misl chand safed baalon ke jo siyah rang bail ke pehlu mein hon. Phir farmaya mujhe umeed hai ke tamam Ahl-e-Jannat ki ginti mein tumhari ginti chauthe hisse ki hogi hum ne is par takbeer kahi phir farmaya aadhi tadaad mein baqi sab aur aadhi tadaad sirf tumhari. Aur riwayat mein hai ke tum Allah ke samne nange pairon, nange badan, be-khatna hazir kiye jaoge. Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mard auratein ek sath? Ek dusre par nazrein padengi? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ayesha woh waqt nihayat sakht aur khatarnak hoga (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya dost apne dost ko Qayamat ke din yaad karega? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ayesha teen mauqon par koi kisi ko yaad na karega. Amaal ke tol ke waqt jab tak kami zyadati na maloom ho jaye. Amaal namon ke udaye jaane ke waqt jab tak daayein baayein hath mein na aa jayein. Us waqt jab ke Jahannam mein se ek gardan niklegi jo gher legi aur sakht ghaiz-o-ghazab mein hogi aur kahegi main teen qisam ke logon par musallat ki gayi hoon ek toh woh log jo Allah ke siwa dusron ko pukarte rehte hain, dusre woh jo hisab ke din par imaan nahin late aur teesre har sarkash ziddi mutakabbir par. Phir toh woh unhein samet legi aur chun chun kar apne pet mein pahuncha degi. Jahannam par Pul-e-Sirat hogi jo baal se bareek aur talwar se tez hogi us par aankas aur kaante honge jise Allah chahe pakad legi us par se guzrne wale misl bijli ke honge, misl aankh jhapakne ke, misl hawa ke, misl tez-raftar ghodon aur unton ke. Farishte har taraf khade duayein karte honge ke Allah salamti de, Allah bacha de. Pas baaz toh bilkul sahi salim guzar jayenge, baaz kuch chot kha kar bach jayenge, baaz oundhe munh Jahannam mein gir jayenge. Qayamat ke aasar mein aur uski holnakiyon mein aur bhi bahut si hadeesein hain. Jin ki jagah aur hai. Yahan farmaya Qayamat ka zalzala nihayat khatarnak hai, bahut sakht hai, nihayat mohlik hai, dil dehlane wala aur kaleja udane wala hai. Zalzala ra'b-o-ghabrahat ke waqt dil ke hilne ko kehte hain jaise aayat mein hai ke is maidan-e-jang mein mominon ko mubtala kiya gaya aur sakht jhanjhod diye gaye.

Log bad-hawaas ho jayenge, aise maloom honge jaise koi nashe mein bad-mast ho raha ho. Dar-asal woh nashe mein na honge balkay Allah Ta'ala ke azabon ki sakhti ne unhein behosh kar rakha hoga.

Yeh aayat Nadr bin Harith ke baare mein utri hai is khabees ne kaha tha ke zara batlao to Allah Ta'ala sone ka hai ya chandi ka ya taanbe ka us ke is sawal se aasman larz utha aur us ki khopdi ud gayi. Ek riwayat mein hai ke ek Yahudi ne aisa hi sawal kiya tha usi waqt aasmani kadake ne use halak kar diya.

Azali murda log jo log maut ke baad ki zindagi ke munkir hain aur Allah ko is par qadir nahin maante aur farman-e-Ilahi se hat kar nabiyon ki tabedari ko chhod kar sarkash insanon aur jinnon ki mat-huti karte hain un ki janab-e-Bari Ta'ala tardeed farma raha hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke ek Yahudi ne aisa hi sawal kiya tha usi waqt aasmani kadake ne use halak kar diya.

Pehli paidaish dusri paidaish ki daleel. Mukhalifeen aur munkireen-e-Qayamat ke samne daleel bayan ki jati hai ke agar tumhein dusri baar ki zindagi se inkar hai to hum is ki daleel mein tumhari pehli dafa ki paidaish tumhein yaad dilate hain. Tum apni asliyat par gaur karke dekho ke hum ne tumhein mitti se banaya hai yani tumhare baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko jin ki nasl tum sab ho. Phir tum sab ko zaleel pani ke qatron se paida kiya hai jis ne pehle khoon-e-basta ki shakal ikhtiyar ki phir gosht ka ek lothra bana. Chalis din tak to nutfa apni shakal mein barhta hai phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi is mein khoon ki surkh phatki parti hai, phir chalis din ke baad woh ek gosht ke tukre ki shakal ikhtiyar kar leta hai jis mein koi surat-o-shabih nahin hoti phir Allah Ta'ala use surat inayat farmata hai sar, hath, seena, pait, raanein, paon aur kul aaza bante hain. Kabhi is se pehle hi hamal saqit ho jata hai, kabhi is ke baad bacha gir parta hai. Yeh to tumhare mushahide ki baat hai. Aur kabhi thehar jata hai. Jab is lothre par chalis din guzar jate hain to Allah Ta'ala farishte ko bhejta hai jo use theek-thak aur durust karke is mein rooh phoonk deta hai aur jaise Allah chahta ho khubsurat badsurat mard aurat bana diya jata hai, rizq, ajal, neki, badi usi waqt likh di jati hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain tum mein se har ek ki paidaish is ki maa ke pait mein chalis raat tak jama hoti hai. Phir chalis din tak khoon-e-basta ki surat rehti hai, phir chalis din tak gosht ke lothre ki, phir farishte ko char cheezein likh dene ka hukm de kar bheja jata hai. Rizq, amal, ajal, shaqi ya sa'eed hona likh liya jata hai phir is mein rooh phonki jati hai. Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain nutfe ke raham mein theharte hi farishta puchta hai ke ae Allah yeh makhlooq hoga ya nahin? Agar inkar hua to woh jamta hi nahin. Khoon ki shakal mein raham use kharij kar deta hai aur agar hukm mila ke is ki paidaish ki jayegi to farishta daryaft karta hai ke larka hoga ya larki? Nek hoga ya bad? Ajal kya hai? Asar kya hai? Kahan marega? Phir nutfe se pucha jata hai tere Rabb kaun hai woh kehta hai Allah, pucha jata hai raaziq kaun hai? Kehta hai ke Allah. Phir farishte se kaha jata hai tu ja aur asal kitab mein dekh le wahin is ka haal mil jayega phir woh paida kiya jata hai likhi hui zindagi guzarta hai muqaddar ka rizq pata hai muqarrara jagah chalta phirta hai phir maut aati hai aur dafan kiya jata hai jahan dafan hona muqaddar hai. Phir Hazrat Aamir (R.H) ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi, muzgha hone ke baad chauthi paidaish ki taraf lautaya jata hai aur zi-rooh banta hai. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Asid (R.A) ki marfoo riwayat mein hai ke chalis paintalis din jab nutfe par guzar jate hain to farishta daryaft karta hai ke yeh dozakhi hai ya jannati? Jo jawab diya jata hai likh leta hai phir puchta hai larka hai ya larki?

Jo jawab milta hai likh leta hai phir amal aur asar aur rizq aur ajal likhi jati hai aur sahifa lapet liya jata hai jis mein na kami mumkin hai na ziyadati phir bacha ho kar duniya mein tawallud hota hai na aql hai na samajh. Kamzor hai aur tamam aaza zaeef hain phir Allah Ta'ala barhata rehta hai maa baap ko meharban kar deta hai. Din raat unhein is ki fikr rehti hai takleefein utha kar parwarish karte hain aur Allah Ta'ala parwan charhata hai. Yahan tak ke unfwan-e-jawani ka zamana aata hai khubsurat tanomand ho jata hai baaz toh jawani mein hi chal baste hain baaz burhay phoons ho jate hain ke phir aql-o-khirad kho baithte hain aur bachon ki tarah zaeef ho jate hain. Hafiza, fahm, fikr sab mein futoor par jata hai ilm ke baad be-ilm ho jate hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (ALLAHU-LLAZI KHALAQAKUM MIN DA'FIN SUMMA JA'ALA MIM BA'DI DA'FIN QUWWATAN SUMMA JA'ALA MIM BA'DI QUWWATIN DA'FAN WA SHAYBAH, YAKHLUQU MA YASHAA'U WA HUWAL 'ALEEMUL QADEER - 30. Ar-Rum: 54) Allah ne tumhein kamzori mein paida kiya phir zor diya phir us quwwat-o-taqat ke baad da'f aur barhapa aaya jo kuch woh chahta hai paida karta hai pooray ilm wala aur kamil qudrat wala hai. Musnad-e-Hafiz Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain bacha jab tak bulughat ko na pohanchay us ki nekiyan us ke baap ke ya maa baap ke nam-e-aamal mein likhi jati hain aur burai na us par hoti hai na un par. Bulughat par pohanchte hi qalam us par chalne lagta hai us ke sath ke farishton ko us ki hifazat karne aur usay durust rakhne ka hukum mil jata hai jab woh Islam mein hi chalees saal ki umar ko pohanchta hai toh Allah Ta'ala usay teen balaon se nijat de deta hai junoon aur juzam se aur baras se jab usay Allah Ta'ala ke deen par pachaas saal guzarte hain toh Allah Ta'ala us ke hisab mein takhfeef kar deta hai jab woh saath saal ka hota hai toh Allah Ta'ala apni razamandi ke kamon ki taraf us ki tabiyat ka poora mailan kar deta hai aur usay apni taraf raghib kar deta hai jab woh sattar baras ka ho jata hai toh aasmani farishtay us se mohabbat karne lagte hain aur jab woh assi baras ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ki nekiyan toh likhta hai lekin buraiyon se tajawuz farma leta hai jab woh navvay baras ki umar ko pohanchta hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ke aglay pichlay gunah bakhash deta hai us ke gharanay walon ke liye usay sifarishi aur shafee bana deta hai woh Allah ke haan Ameen-ullah ka khitab pata hai aur zameen mein Allah ke qaidiyon ki tarah rehta hai jab bohat bari nakara umar ko pohanch jata hai jab ke ilm ke baad be-ilm ho jata hai toh jo kuch woh apni sehat aur hosh ke zamanay mein nekiyan kiya karta tha sab us ke nam-e-aamal mein barabar likhi jati hain aur agar koi burai us se ho gayi toh woh nahin likhi jati. Yeh hadith bohat ghareeb hai aur is mein sakht nakarat hai bawajood is ke isay Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) apni musnad mein laye hain mauqoofan bhi aur marfoo'an bhi.

Hazrat Anas R.A se mauqoofan marwi hai aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bin Khattab R.A se az farman-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ phir Hazrat Anas R.A se hi dusri sanad se marfoo'an yahi warid ki hai. Hafiz Abu Bakr bin Bazzar R.H ne bhi ise ba-riwayat Hazrat Anas bin Malik R.A marfoo mein bayan kiya hai (aur musalmanon par Rabb ki meherbani ka taqaza bhi yahi hai. Allah hamari umr mein neki ke sath barkat de, Ameen). Murdon ke zinda kar dene ki ek daleel yeh bayan karke phir dusri daleel bayan farmata hai ke chatyal maidan be-ru'idgi ki khushk aur sakht zameen ko hum aasmani pani se lehlahati aur taro-taza kar dete hain, tarah tarah ke phal phool, meway, danay waghera ke darakhton se sarsabz ho jati hai, qism qism ke darakht ug aate hain aur jahan kuch na tha wahan sab kuch ho jata hai. Murda zameen ek dam zindagi ke kushada saans lene lagti hai, jis jagah dar lagta tha wahan ab rahat-e-rooh aur noor-e-ain aur suroor-e-qalb majood ho jata hai, qism qism ke tarah tarah ke meethe, khatte, khush-zaiqa, mazedar, rang roop wale phal aur mewon se lade hue khubsurat chote bade jhoom jhoom kar bahar ka lutf dikhane lagte hain. Yahi woh murda zameen hai jo kal tak khaak uda rahi thi, aaj dil ka suroor aur aankhon ka noor ban kar apni zindagi ki jawani ka maza de rahi hai. Phoolon ke chote chote pauday dimagh ko makhzan-e-attar bana dete hain, door se naseem ke halke halke jhonke kitne khushgawar maloom hote hain. Sach hai Khaliq, Mudabbir, apni chahat ke mutabiq karne wala, khud-mukhtar hakim-e-haqiqi Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Wahi murdon ko zinda karne wala hai aur uski nishani murda zameen ka zinda hona makhlooq ki nigahon ke samne hai. Woh har inqilab par, har qalb-e-mahiyat par qadir hai, jo chahta hai ho jata hai. Jis kaam ka irada karta hai, farmata hai ho ja. Phir namumkin hai ke woh kehte hi ho na jaye. Yaad rakho Qayamat qatan bila-shak-o-shuba aane wali hi hai aur qabron ke murdon ko woh qudrat wala Allah zinda karke uthane wala hai, woh adam se wajood mein lane par qadir tha aur hai aur rahega. Surah Yaseen mein bhi ba'az logon ke is aitraz ka zikr karke unhein unki pehli paidaish yaad dila kar qail kiya gaya hai, sath hi sabz darakht se aag paida karne ki qalb-e-mahiyat ko bhi daleel mein pesh farmaya gaya hai aur aayatein bhi is bare mein bahut si hain. Hazrat Laqeet bin Aamir R.A jo Abu Razin Uqaili ki kuniyat se mashhoor hain, ek martaba Rasoolullah ﷺ se daryaft karte hain ke kya hum log sab ke sab Qayamat ke din apne Rabb Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ko dekhenge? Aur uski makhlooq mein is dekhne ki misaal koi hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya kya tum sab ke sab chand ko yaksan taur par nahin dekhte? Hum ne kaha haan, farmaya phir Allah to bahut badi azmat wala hai. Aap ﷺ ne phir poocha, Huzoor ﷺ murdon ko dobara zinda karne ki bhi koi misaal duniya mein hai?

Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) farmate hain jo is baat ka yaqeen rakhe ke Allah Ta'ala haq hai aur Qayamat qatan be-shuba aane wali hai aur Allah Ta'ala murdon ko qabron se dobara zinda karega, woh yaqeenan Jannati hai.

Pehli paidaish dusri paidaish ki daleel. Mukhalifeen aur munkireen-e-Qayamat ke samne daleel bayan ki jati hai ke agar tumhein dusri baar ki zindagi se inkar hai to hum is ki daleel mein tumhari pehli dafa ki paidaish tumhein yaad dilate hain. Tum apni asliyat par gaur karke dekho ke hum ne tumhein mitti se banaya hai yani tumhare baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko jin ki nasl tum sab ho. Phir tum sab ko zaleel pani ke qatron se paida kiya hai jis ne pehle khoon-e-basta ki shakal ikhtiyar ki phir gosht ka ek lothra bana. Chalis din tak to nutfa apni shakal mein barhta hai phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi is mein khoon ki surkh phatki parti hai, phir chalis din ke baad woh ek gosht ke tukre ki shakal ikhtiyar kar leta hai jis mein koi surat-o-shabih nahin hoti phir Allah Ta'ala use surat inayat farmata hai sar, hath, seena, pait, raanein, paon aur kul aaza bante hain. Kabhi is se pehle hi hamal saqit ho jata hai, kabhi is ke baad bacha gir parta hai. Yeh to tumhare mushahide ki baat hai. Aur kabhi thehar jata hai. Jab is lothre par chalis din guzar jate hain to Allah Ta'ala farishte ko bhejta hai jo use theek-thak aur durust karke is mein rooh phoonk deta hai aur jaise Allah chahta ho khubsurat badsurat mard aurat bana diya jata hai, rizq, ajal, neki, badi usi waqt likh di jati hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain tum mein se har ek ki paidaish is ki maa ke pait mein chalis raat tak jama hoti hai. Phir chalis din tak khoon-e-basta ki surat rehti hai, phir chalis din tak gosht ke lothre ki, phir farishte ko char cheezein likh dene ka hukm de kar bheja jata hai. Rizq, amal, ajal, shaqi ya sa'eed hona likh liya jata hai phir is mein rooh phonki jati hai. Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain nutfe ke raham mein theharte hi farishta puchta hai ke ae Allah yeh makhlooq hoga ya nahin? Agar inkar hua to woh jamta hi nahin. Khoon ki shakal mein raham use kharij kar deta hai aur agar hukm mila ke is ki paidaish ki jayegi to farishta daryaft karta hai ke larka hoga ya larki? Nek hoga ya bad? Ajal kya hai? Asar kya hai? Kahan marega? Phir nutfe se pucha jata hai tere Rabb kaun hai woh kehta hai Allah, pucha jata hai raaziq kaun hai? Kehta hai ke Allah. Phir farishte se kaha jata hai tu ja aur asal kitab mein dekh le wahin is ka haal mil jayega phir woh paida kiya jata hai likhi hui zindagi guzarta hai muqaddar ka rizq pata hai muqarrara jagah chalta phirta hai phir maut aati hai aur dafan kiya jata hai jahan dafan hona muqaddar hai. Phir Hazrat Aamir (R.H) ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi, muzgha hone ke baad chauthi paidaish ki taraf lautaya jata hai aur zi-rooh banta hai. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Asid (R.A) ki marfoo riwayat mein hai ke chalis paintalis din jab nutfe par guzar jate hain to farishta daryaft karta hai ke yeh dozakhi hai ya jannati? Jo jawab diya jata hai likh leta hai phir puchta hai larka hai ya larki?

Jo jawab milta hai likh leta hai phir amal aur asar aur rizq aur ajal likhi jati hai aur sahifa lapet liya jata hai jis mein na kami mumkin hai na ziyadati phir bacha ho kar duniya mein tawallud hota hai na aql hai na samajh. Kamzor hai aur tamam aaza zaeef hain phir Allah Ta'ala barhata rehta hai maa baap ko meharban kar deta hai. Din raat unhein is ki fikr rehti hai takleefein utha kar parwarish karte hain aur Allah Ta'ala parwan charhata hai. Yahan tak ke unfwan-e-jawani ka zamana aata hai khubsurat tanomand ho jata hai baaz toh jawani mein hi chal baste hain baaz burhay phoons ho jate hain ke phir aql-o-khirad kho baithte hain aur bachon ki tarah zaeef ho jate hain. Hafiza, fahm, fikr sab mein futoor par jata hai ilm ke baad be-ilm ho jate hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (ALLAHU-LLAZI KHALAQAKUM MIN DA'FIN SUMMA JA'ALA MIM BA'DI DA'FIN QUWWATAN SUMMA JA'ALA MIM BA'DI QUWWATIN DA'FAN WA SHAYBAH, YAKHLUQU MA YASHAA'U WA HUWAL 'ALEEMUL QADEER - 30. Ar-Rum: 54) Allah ne tumhein kamzori mein paida kiya phir zor diya phir us quwwat-o-taqat ke baad da'f aur barhapa aaya jo kuch woh chahta hai paida karta hai pooray ilm wala aur kamil qudrat wala hai. Musnad-e-Hafiz Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain bacha jab tak bulughat ko na pohanchay us ki nekiyan us ke baap ke ya maa baap ke nam-e-aamal mein likhi jati hain aur burai na us par hoti hai na un par. Bulughat par pohanchte hi qalam us par chalne lagta hai us ke sath ke farishton ko us ki hifazat karne aur usay durust rakhne ka hukum mil jata hai jab woh Islam mein hi chalees saal ki umar ko pohanchta hai toh Allah Ta'ala usay teen balaon se nijat de deta hai junoon aur juzam se aur baras se jab usay Allah Ta'ala ke deen par pachaas saal guzarte hain toh Allah Ta'ala us ke hisab mein takhfeef kar deta hai jab woh saath saal ka hota hai toh Allah Ta'ala apni razamandi ke kamon ki taraf us ki tabiyat ka poora mailan kar deta hai aur usay apni taraf raghib kar deta hai jab woh sattar baras ka ho jata hai toh aasmani farishtay us se mohabbat karne lagte hain aur jab woh assi baras ka ho jata hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ki nekiyan toh likhta hai lekin buraiyon se tajawuz farma leta hai jab woh navvay baras ki umar ko pohanchta hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ke aglay pichlay gunah bakhash deta hai us ke gharanay walon ke liye usay sifarishi aur shafee bana deta hai woh Allah ke haan Ameen-ullah ka khitab pata hai aur zameen mein Allah ke qaidiyon ki tarah rehta hai jab bohat bari nakara umar ko pohanch jata hai jab ke ilm ke baad be-ilm ho jata hai toh jo kuch woh apni sehat aur hosh ke zamanay mein nekiyan kiya karta tha sab us ke nam-e-aamal mein barabar likhi jati hain aur agar koi burai us se ho gayi toh woh nahin likhi jati. Yeh hadith bohat ghareeb hai aur is mein sakht nakarat hai bawajood is ke isay Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) apni musnad mein laye hain mauqoofan bhi aur marfoo'an bhi.

Hazrat Anas R.A se mauqoofan marwi hai aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bin Khattab R.A se az farman-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ phir Hazrat Anas R.A se hi dusri sanad se marfoo'an yahi warid ki hai. Hafiz Abu Bakr bin Bazzar R.H ne bhi ise ba-riwayat Hazrat Anas bin Malik R.A marfoo mein bayan kiya hai (aur musalmanon par Rabb ki meherbani ka taqaza bhi yahi hai. Allah hamari umr mein neki ke sath barkat de, Ameen). Murdon ke zinda kar dene ki ek daleel yeh bayan karke phir dusri daleel bayan farmata hai ke chatyal maidan be-ru'idgi ki khushk aur sakht zameen ko hum aasmani pani se lehlahati aur taro-taza kar dete hain, tarah tarah ke phal phool, meway, danay waghera ke darakhton se sarsabz ho jati hai, qism qism ke darakht ug aate hain aur jahan kuch na tha wahan sab kuch ho jata hai. Murda zameen ek dam zindagi ke kushada saans lene lagti hai, jis jagah dar lagta tha wahan ab rahat-e-rooh aur noor-e-ain aur suroor-e-qalb majood ho jata hai, qism qism ke tarah tarah ke meethe, khatte, khush-zaiqa, mazedar, rang roop wale phal aur mewon se lade hue khubsurat chote bade jhoom jhoom kar bahar ka lutf dikhane lagte hain. Yahi woh murda zameen hai jo kal tak khaak uda rahi thi, aaj dil ka suroor aur aankhon ka noor ban kar apni zindagi ki jawani ka maza de rahi hai. Phoolon ke chote chote pauday dimagh ko makhzan-e-attar bana dete hain, door se naseem ke halke halke jhonke kitne khushgawar maloom hote hain. Sach hai Khaliq, Mudabbir, apni chahat ke mutabiq karne wala, khud-mukhtar hakim-e-haqiqi Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Wahi murdon ko zinda karne wala hai aur uski nishani murda zameen ka zinda hona makhlooq ki nigahon ke samne hai. Woh har inqilab par, har qalb-e-mahiyat par qadir hai, jo chahta hai ho jata hai. Jis kaam ka irada karta hai, farmata hai ho ja. Phir namumkin hai ke woh kehte hi ho na jaye. Yaad rakho Qayamat qatan bila-shak-o-shuba aane wali hi hai aur qabron ke murdon ko woh qudrat wala Allah zinda karke uthane wala hai, woh adam se wajood mein lane par qadir tha aur hai aur rahega. Surah Yaseen mein bhi ba'az logon ke is aitraz ka zikr karke unhein unki pehli paidaish yaad dila kar qail kiya gaya hai, sath hi sabz darakht se aag paida karne ki qalb-e-mahiyat ko bhi daleel mein pesh farmaya gaya hai aur aayatein bhi is bare mein bahut si hain. Hazrat Laqeet bin Aamir R.A jo Abu Razin Uqaili ki kuniyat se mashhoor hain, ek martaba Rasoolullah ﷺ se daryaft karte hain ke kya hum log sab ke sab Qayamat ke din apne Rabb Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ko dekhenge? Aur uski makhlooq mein is dekhne ki misaal koi hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya kya tum sab ke sab chand ko yaksan taur par nahin dekhte? Hum ne kaha haan, farmaya phir Allah to bahut badi azmat wala hai. Aap ﷺ ne phir poocha, Huzoor ﷺ murdon ko dobara zinda karne ki bhi koi misaal duniya mein hai?

Isi tarah Allah Ta'ala murdon ko zinda karta hai aur makhlooq mein yahi dekhi hui misaal is ka kaafi namoona aur suboot hai (Abu Dawood waghera). Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) farmate hain jo is baat ka yaqeen rakhe ke Allah Ta'ala haq hai aur Qayamat qatan be-shuba aane wali hai aur Allah Ta'ala murdon ko qabron se dobara zinda karega, woh yaqeenan Jannati hai.

Gumrah jahil muqallid log: Chunke oopar ki aayaton mein gumrah jahil muqallidon ka haal bayan farmaya tha, yahan un ke murshidon aur peeron ka haal bayan farma rahe hain ke woh be-aqli aur be-daleeli se sirf raye qiyas aur khwahish-e-nafsani se Allah ke baare mein kalam karte rehte hain, haq se a'raaz karte hain, takabbur se gardan pher lete hain, haq ko qabool karne se be-parwahi ke saath inkar kar jaate hain. Jaise Firauniyon ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke khule mojizon ko dekh kar bhi be-parwahi ki aur na maane. Aur aayat mein hai jab un se Allah ki wahi ki tabedari ko kaha jaata hai aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke farman ki taraf bulaya jaata hai to tu dekhe ga ke ae Rasool (ﷺ) yeh munafiq tujh se door chale jaya karte hain. Surah Munafiqoon mein irshad hua ke jab un se kaha jaata hai ke aao aur apne liye Rasool (ﷺ) se istighfar karwao to woh apne sar ghuma kar ghamand mein aa kar be-niyazi se inkar kar jaate hain. Hazrat Luqman (R.H) ne apne sahibzade ko nasihat karte hue farmaya aayat (WALA TUSA'IR KHADDAKA LINNASI WALA TAMSHI FIL ARDI MARAHAN INNALLAHA LA YUHIBBU KULLA MUKHTALIN FAKHOOR) (Surah Luqman: 18) logon se apne rukhsar na phula diya kar yani apne aap ko bada samajh kar un se takabbur na kar. Aur aayat mein hai hamari aayatein sun kar yeh takabbur se munh pher leta hai. Liyudilla ka laam yeh to laam-e-aaqibat hai ya laam-e-ta'leel hai, is liye ke basa auqat is ka maqsood dusron ko gumrah karna nahin hota aur mumkin hai ke is se murad mu'anid aur inkar hi ho aur ho sakta hai ke yeh matlab ho ke hum ne ise aisa bad-akhlaq is liye bana diya hai ke yeh gumrahon ka sardar ban jaaye. Is ke liye duniya mein bhi zillat-o-khwari hai jo is ke takabbur ka badla hai. Yeh yahan takabbur kar ke bada banna chahta tha hum ise aur chota kar denge, yahan bhi apni chahat mein nakam aur be-murad rahe ga. Aur aakhirat ke din bhi jahannam ki aag ka luqma hoga. Ise bator daant-dupat ke kaha jaaye ga ke yeh tere a'maal ka natija hai, Allah ki zaat zulm se paak hai. Jaise farman hai ke farishton se kaha jaaye ga ke ise pakad lo aur ghaseet kar jahannam mein le jao aur is ke sar par aag jaise paani ki dhaar bahao. Le ab apni izzat aur takabbur ka badla leta ja. Yehi woh hai jis se umr bhar shak-shuba mein raha. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) farmate hain mujhe yeh riwayat pahunchi hai ke ek din mein woh sattar sattar martaba aag mein jal kar bhur-bhura ho jaaye ga. Phir zinda kiya jaaye ga phir jalaya jaaye ga (A'uzubillahi min zalik).

Shak ke maare log "harf" ke ma'ani shak ke ek taraf ke hain. Goya woh deen ke ek kinare khade ho jate hain, faida hua toh phule nahin samate, nuqsan dekha bhaag khade hue. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein (Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi) hai ke a'raab hijrat karke Madine pahunchte the, ab agar baal-bachche hue, janwaron mein barkat hui toh kehte yeh deen bada achha hai aur agar na hue toh kehte yeh deen toh nihayat bura hai. Ibn Hatim mein aap se marvi hai ke a'raab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aate, Islam qabool karte, wapas jakar agar apne yahan barish, pani paate, janwaron mein, ghar-baar mein barkat dekhte toh itminan se kehte bada achha deen hai aur agar iske khilaf dekhte toh jhat se bak dete ke is deen mein siwaye nuqsan ke aur kuch nahin. Is par yeh aayat utri. Barwayat-e-Aufi Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se manqool hai ke aise log bhi the jo Madine pahunchte hi agar unke yahan ladka hota ya unki oontni bachcha deti toh unhein rahat hui toh khush ho jate aur unki tareefein karne lagte aur agar koi bala, musibat aa gayi, Madine ki hawa muwafiq na aayi, ghar mein ladki paida ho gayi, sadqe ka maal mayassar na hua toh shaitani waswase mein aa jate aur saaf keh dete ke is deen mein toh mushkil hi mushkil hai. Abdur Rahman ka bayan hai ke yeh halat munafiqon ki hai. Duniya agar mil gayi toh deen se khush hain, jahan na mili ya imtihan aa gaya foran palla jhaad liya karte hain, murtad kafir ho jate hain. Yeh poore badnaseeb hain, duniya-o-akhirat dono barbad kar lete hain, is se zyada aur barbadi kya hoti? Jin thakron, buton aur buzurgon se yeh madad mangte hain, jin se faryad karte hain, jin ke paas apni hajatein lekar jate hain, jin se roziyan mangte hain woh toh mahaz aajiz hain, nafa-nuqsan unke hath hi nahin. Sab se badi gumrahi yahi hai. Duniya mein bhi inki ibadat se nuqsan nafe se peshtar hi ho jata hai. Aur akhirat mein un se jo nuqsan pahunchega uska kehna hi kya hai? Yeh but toh unke nihayat bure wali aur nihayat bure sathi sabit honge. Ya yeh matlab ke aisa karne wale khud bahut hi bad aur bade hi bure hain lekin pehli tafsir zyada achhi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein (Ibn Abbas R.A se marvi) hai ke a'raab hijrat karke Madine pahunchte the, ab agar baal-bachche hue, janwaron mein barkat hui toh kehte yeh deen bada achha hai aur agar na hue toh kehte yeh deen toh nihayat bura hai. Ibn Hatim mein aap se marvi hai ke a'raab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aate, Islam qabool karte, wapas jakar agar apne yahan barish, pani paate, janwaron mein, ghar-baar mein barkat dekhte toh itminan se kehte bada achha deen hai aur agar iske khilaf dekhte toh jhat se bak dete ke is deen mein siwaye nuqsan ke aur kuch nahin. Is par yeh aayat utri. Barwayat-e-Aufi Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se manqool hai ke aise log bhi the jo Madine pahunchte hi agar unke yahan ladka hota ya unki oontni bachcha deti toh unhein rahat hui toh khush ho jate aur unki tareefein karne lagte aur agar koi bala, musibat aa gayi, Madine ki hawa muwafiq na aayi, ghar mein ladki paida ho gayi, sadqe ka maal mayassar na hua toh shaitani waswase mein aa jate aur saaf keh dete ke is deen mein toh mushkil hi mushkil hai. Abdur Rahman ka bayan hai ke yeh halat munafiqon ki hai. Duniya agar mil gayi toh deen se khush hain, jahan na mili ya imtihan aa gaya foran palla jhaad liya karte hain, murtad kafir ho jate hain. Yeh poore badnaseeb hain, duniya-o-akhirat dono barbad kar lete hain, is se zyada aur barbadi kya hoti? Jin thakron, buton aur buzurgon se yeh madad mangte hain, jin se faryad karte hain, jin ke paas apni hajatein lekar jate hain, jin se roziyan mangte hain woh toh mahaz aajiz hain, nafa-nuqsan unke hath hi nahin. Sab se badi gumrahi yahi hai. Duniya mein bhi inki ibadat se nuqsan nafe se peshtar hi ho jata hai. Aur akhirat mein un se jo nuqsan pahunchega uska kehna hi kya hai? Yeh but toh unke nihayat bure wali aur nihayat bure sathi sabit honge. Ya yeh matlab ke aisa karne wale khud bahut hi bad aur bade hi bure hain lekin pehli tafsir zyada achhi hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Yaqeen ke maalik log, bure logon ka bayan karke bhale logon ka zikr ho raha hai jin ke dilon mein yaqeen ka noor hai aur jin ke a'maal mein sunnat ka zuhoor hai. Bhalaion ke khwahan, buraiyon se gurezan hain. Yeh buland mehalat mein, aali darjaat mein honge kyunke yeh raah-yafta hain. In ke ilawa sab log hawas-bakhta hain. Ab jo chahe kare, jo chahe rakhe dhare.

Mukhalifeen-e-Nabi (ﷺ) halak hon yani jo yeh jaan raha hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ki madad na duniya mein karega na aakhirat mein woh yaqeen maane ke us ka yeh khayal mehez khayal hai. Aap (ﷺ) ki madad ho kar hi rahegi chahe aisa shakhs apne gusse mein haar hi jaye balkay usay chahiye ke apne makaan ki chhat mein rassi baandh kar apne galay mein phanda daal kar apne aap ko halak kar de. Namumkin hai ke woh cheez yani Allah ki madad us ke Nabi ke liye na aaye go yeh jal jal kar mar jayen magar un ki khayal aara'iyan ghalat saabit ho kar rahengi. Yeh matlab bhi ho sakta hai ke us ki samajh ke khilaf ho kar hi rahega. Allah ki imdaad aasman se nazil hogi. Haan agar us ke bas mein ho to ek rassi latka kar aasman par charh jaye aur is utarti hui madad-e-aasmani ko kaat de. Lekin pehla ma'ani zyada zahir hai aur is mein un ki poori bebasi aur namuradi ka suboot hai ke Allah apne deen ko, apni kitaab ko, apne Nabi ko taraqqi dega hi chunke yeh log usay dekh nahin sakte is liye unhein chahiye ke yeh mar jayen, apne aap ko halak kar daalein. Jaise farman hai aayat (Inna lanansuru rusulana wallazina aamanu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yauma yaqumul-ashhad) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 51). Hum apne rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki madad karte hi hain duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Yahan farmaya ke yeh phansi par latak kar dekh le ke shaan-e-Muhammadi ko kis tarah kam kar sakta hai? Apne seenay ki aag ko kis tarah bujha sakta hai? Is Quran ko hum ne utara hai jis ki aayatein alfaaz aur ma'ani ke lihaaz se bohat hi wazeh hain. Allah ki taraf se us ke bandon par yeh hujjat hai. Hidayat-o-gumrahi Allah ke haath mein hai us ki hikmat wohi jaanta hai koi us se baaz purs nahin kar sakta woh sab ka haakim hai, woh rehmaton wala, adl wala, ghalbay wala, hikmat wala, azmat wala, aur ilm wala hai. Koi us par mukhtar nahin jo chahe kare sab se hisaab lene wala wohi hai aur woh bhi bohat jald.

Mukhtalif mazhabon ka faisla roz-e-Qayamat hoga. Sabieen ka bayan ma'a ikhtilaf Surah Baqarah ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Yahan farmata hai ke in mukhtalif mazhab walon ka faisla Qayamat ke din saaf ho jayega. Allah Ta'ala iman walon ko Jannat dega aur kuffar ko Jahannam wasil karega. Sab ke aqwal-o-af'al zahir-o-batin Allah par ayan hain.

Chand, suraj, sitaray sab sajda-rez. Mustahiq-e-ibadat sirf Wahdahu La-Sharika Allah hai, uski azmat ke samne har cheez sar jhukaye hue hai, khwah ba-khushi khwah be-khushi. Har cheez ka sajda apni waza mein hai. Chunancha Quran ne saye ka dayen bayen Allah ke samne sar-ba-sajood hona bhi Ayat (A-wa lam yarau ila ma khalaqallahu min shai-in yatafayya-u zilaluhu anil-yamini wash-shama-ili sujjadan lillahi wa hum dakhirun) (16-An-Nahl: 48) mein bayan farmaya hai. Aasmanon ke farishtay, zameen ke haiwan, insan, jinnat, parind, charind, sab uske samne sar-ba-sajood hain aur uski tasbeeh aur hamd kar rahe hain. Suraj, chand, sitaray bhi uske samne sajday mein giray hue hain. In teenon cheezon ko alag is liye bayan kiya gaya ke baaz log inki parastish karte hain, halankeh woh khud Allah ke samne jhukay hue hain. Is liye farmaya suraj chand ko sajday na karo, usay sajday karo jo inka Khaliq hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se poocha, jantay ho ke yeh suraj kahan jata hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke Allah ko ilm hai aur uske Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko. Aap ne farmaya yeh Arsh talay jakar Allah ko sajda karta hai, phir us se ijazat talab karta hai, waqt aa raha hai ke us se ek din keh diya jayega ke jahan se aaya hai wahin wapas chala ja. Sunan Abi Dawood, Nasai, Ibn Majah, aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein grahan ki hadith mein hai ke suraj, chand Allah ki makhlooq hain, woh kisi ki maut ya paidaish se grahan mein nahin aatay, balkeh Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein se jis par tajalli dalta hai to woh uske samne jhuk jata hai. Abul Aliyah (R.H) farmatay hain suraj, chand aur kul sitaray ghuroob ho kar sajday mein jatay hain aur Allah se ijazat mang kar dahini taraf se laut kar phir apne matla mein pohanchtay hain. Paharon aur darakhton ka sajda inke saye ka dayen bayen parna hai. Ek shakhs ne Nabi Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se apna khwab bayan kiya ke main ne dekha hai ke goya main ek darakht ke peechay namaz parh raha hoon. Main jab sajday mein gaya to woh darakht bhi sajday mein gaya aur main ne suna ke woh apne sajday mein yeh parh raha tha: Dua (Allahumma uktub li biha indaka ajran, wa da' anni biha wizran, waj'alha li indaka zukhra, wa taqabbalha minni kama taqabbaltaha min abdika Dawood). Yani, Aye Allah! Is sajday ki wajah se mere liye apne paas ajr-o-sawab likh aur mere gunah maaf farma aur mere liye isay zakheera-e-akhirat kar aur isay qabool farma jaisay ke tu ne apne banday Dawood (A.S) ka sajda qabool farmaya tha. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka bayan hai ke phir main ne dekha ke ek din Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sajday ki ayat parhi, sajda kiya aur yahi dua aap ne apne is sajday mein parhi jisay main sun raha tha (Tirmidhi waghera). Tamam haiwanat bhi usay sajda karte hain.

Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain apne janwar ki peeth ko apna mimbar na bana liya karo, bahut si sawariyan apne sawar se zyada achi hoti hain aur zyada zikr-e-Allah karne wali hoti hain aur aksar insan bhi apni khushi se ibadat-e-Ilahi baja late hain aur sajde karte hain. Haan woh bhi hain jo is se mehroom hain, takabbur karte hain, sarkashi karte hain. Allah jise zaleel kare use azeez kaun kar sakta hai? Rabb fa'il-e-khud mukhtar hai.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Ali (R.A) se kisi ne kaha yahan ek shakhs hai jo Allah ke iradon aur uski mashiyat ko nahin manta. Aap (R.A) ne use farmaya: Ae shakhs! Bata teri paidaish Allah Ta'ala ne teri chahat ke mutabiq ki ya apni? Usne kaha: Apni chahat ke mutabiq. Farmaya: Yeh bhi bata ke jab tu chahta hai mareez ho jata hai ya jab Allah chahta hai? Usne kaha: Jab woh chahta hai. Poocha: Phir tujhe shifa teri chahat se hoti hai ya Allah ke irade se? Jawab diya: Allah ke irade se. Farmaya: Acha yeh bhi bata ke ab woh jahan chahega tujhe le jayega ya jahan tu chahega? Kaha: Jahan woh chahe. Farmaya: Phir kya baat baqi reh gayi? Sun! Agar tu is ke khilaf jawab deta to Wallah main tera sar uda deta.

Muslim Shareef mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain jab insan sajde ki ayat parh kar sajda karta hai to shaitan alag hat kar rone lagta hai ke afsos! Ibn-e-Adam ko sajde ka hukum mila usne sajda kar liya jannati ho gaya, main ne inkar kar diya jahannami ban gaya.

Hazrat Uqba bin Amir (R.A) ne ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) se poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Surah Hajj ko aur tamam suraton par yeh fazeelat mili ke is mein do ayatein sajde ki hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Haan, aur jo in dono par sajda na kare use chahiye ke use parhe hi nahin. (Tirmidhi waghera). Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) farmate hain yeh hadith qawi nahin lekin Imam sahab (R.H) ka yeh qaul qabil-e-ghaur hai kyunke is ke rawi Ibn-e-Lahi'ah (R.H) ne apni sama'at ki is mein tasreeh kar di hai aur un par bari jarh-o-tadlees ki hai jo is se uth jati hai.

Abu Dawood mein farman-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ) hai ke Surah Hajj ko Quran ki aur suraton par yeh fazeelat di gayi hai is mein do sajde hain. Imam Abu Dawood (R.H) farmate hain is sanad se to yeh hadith mustanad nahin lekin aur sanad se yeh musnad bhi bayan ki gayi hai magar sahih nahin.

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Hudaibiya mein is surat ki tilawat ki aur do baar sajda kiya aur farmaya: Ise in sajdion se fazeelat di gayi hai. (Abu Bakr bin Adi). Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne pooray Quran mein pandrah sajde parhaye, teen mufassal mein, do Surah Hajj mein. (Ibn-e-Majah waghera). Yeh sab riwayatein is baat ko pooray tor par mazboot kar deti hain.

Momin-o-Kafir ki misaal. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) qasam kha kar farmate thay ke yeh aayat Hazrat Hamza (R.A) aur un ke muqable mein Badr ke din jo do kafir aaye thay aur Utba aur us ke do sathiyon ke bare mein utri hai. (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) farmate hain Qayamat ke din main sab se pehle Allah ke samne apni hujjat sabit karne ke liye ghutnon ke bal gir jaunga. Hazrat Qais farmate hain inhi ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai, Badr ke din yeh log ek dusre ke samne aaye thay, Ali aur Hamza (R.A) aur Ubaida aur Shaiba aur Utba aur Waleed. Aur qaul hai ke murad Musalman aur Ahl-e-Kitab hain. Ahl-e-Kitab kehte thay hamara Nabi tumhare Nabi se aur hamari Kitab tumhari Kitab se pehle hai is liye hum Allah se ba-nisbat tumhare zyada qareeb hain. Musalman kehte thay ke hamari Kitab tumhari Kitab ka faisla karti hai aur hamare Nabi Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain is liye tum se hum aula hain, pas Allah ne Islam ko ghalib kiya aur yeh aayat utri. Qatada (R.H) farmate hain murad is se saccha manne wale aur jhutlane wale hain. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain is aayat mein Momin-o-Kafir ki misaal hai jo Qayamat mein mukhtalif thay. Ikrama (R.H) farmate hain murad Jannat-Dozakh ka qaul hai, Dozakh ki maang thi ke mujhe saza ki cheez bana aur Jannat ki aarzu thi ke mujhe Rahmat bana. Mujahid (R.H) ka qaul in tamam aqwal mein shamil hai aur Badr ka waqia bhi is ke zimn mein aa sakta hai, Momin Allah ke deen ka ghalba chahte thay aur kuffar noor-e-iman ke bujhane, haq ko past karne aur batil ke ubharne ki fikr mein thay. Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) bhi is ko mukhtar batlate hain aur yeh hai bhi bahut accha, chunancha is ke baad hi hai ke kuffar ke liye aag ke tukre alag alag muqarrar kar diye jayenge. Yeh tanbe ki surat honge jo bahut hi hararat pahunchata hai, phir upar se garm ubalte hue pani ka tareera dala jayega, jis se un ki aanten aur charbi ghul jayegi aur khaal bhi jhulas kar jhad jayegi. Tirmidhi mein hai ke is garm aag jaise pani se un ki aanten waghera pet se nikal kar pairon par gir padengi, phir jaise thay waise ho jayenge phir yahi hoga. Abdullah bin Sari (R.H) farmate hain farishta is dolche ko us ke kadon se tham kar layega, us ke munh mein dalna chahega yeh ghabra kar munh pher lega, toh farishta us ke mathe par lohe ka hathoda marega jis se us ka sar phat jayega, wahin se is garm aag pani ko dalega jo seedha pet mein pahunchega. Rasool-Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain in hathodon mein jin se dozakhiyon ki thukai hogi agar ek zameen par la kar rakh diya jaye toh tamam insaan aur jinnat mil kar bhi use utha nahin sakte. (Musnad). Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain agar woh kisi bade pahad par maar diya jaye toh woh reza reza ho jaye, jahannami us se tukre tukre ho jayenge phir jaise thay waise hi kar diye jayenge, agar 'Asaq ka jo jahannamiyon ki ghiza hai ek dol dunya mein baha diya jaye toh tamam ahl-e-dunya badbu ke mare halak ho jayen.

(Musnad-e-Ahmad) Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ke is ke lagte hi ek ek uzw-e-badan jhad jayega aur haye-waye ka ghul mach jayega jab kabhi wahan se nikal jana chahenge wahin lota diye jayenge. Hazrat Salman (R.A) farmate hain jahannam ki aag sakht siyah bahut andhere wali hai is ke shole bhi roshan nahin na is ke angare roshni wale hain phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Hazrat Zaid (R.H) ka qaul hai jahannami is mein saans bhi na le sakenge. Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayaz (R.H) farmate hain wallah unhein chhootne ki to aas hi nahin rahegi pairon mein bojhal beriyan hain hathon mein mazboot hathkadiyan hain aag ke shole unhein is qadar uncha kar dete hain ke goya bahar nikal jayenge lekin phir farishton ke hathon se gurz kha kar teh mein utar jate hain. Un se kaha jayega ke ab jalne ka maza chakho. Jaise farman hai un se kaha jayega is aag ka azaab bardasht karo jise aaj tak jhutlate rahe. Zabani bhi aur apne aamal se bhi.

Jannat ke mahalaat-o-baghaat upar dozakhiyon ka, un ki sazaon ka, un ke tauq-o-zanjeer ka, un ke jalne jhulsne ka, un ke aag ke libaas ka zikr karke ab Jannat ka, wahan ki nematon ka aur wahan ke rehne walon ka haal bayan farma raha hai. Allah hamein apni sazaon se bachaye aur jazaon se nawaze, Ameen! Farmata hai imaan aur nek amal ke badle Jannat mil gayi jahan ke mahalaat aur baghaat ke charon taraf paani ki nehrein lehrein maar rahi hongi, jahan chahenge wahin khud-ba-khud un ka rukh ho jaya karega, sone ke zewaron se saje hue honge, motiyon mein tul rahe honge. Muttafiq Alaih hadith mein hai, momin ka zewar wahan tak pahunchega jahan tak wuzu ka paani pahunchta hai. Ka'ab Ahbar (R.H) farmate hain ke Jannat mein ek farishta hai ke jis ka naam bhi mujhe maloom hai, woh apni paidaish se mominon ke liye zewar bana raha hai aur Qayamat tak isi kaam mein rahega, agar un mein se ek kangan bhi duniya mein zahir ho jaye to suraj ki roshni isi tarah jaati rahe jis tarah us ke nikalne se chand ki roshni jaati rehti hai. Dozakhiyon ke kapron ka zikr upar ho chuka hai, jannatiyon ke kapron ka zikr ho raha hai ke woh narm chamkile reshmi kapre pehne hue honge, jaise Surah Dahr mein hai ke un ke libaas sabz reshmi honge, chandi ke kangan honge aur sharab-e-tahoor ke jaam par jaam pee rahe honge. Yeh hai tumhari jaza aur yeh tumhare baar aur sa'i ka natija. Sahih hadith mein hai, resham tum na pehno, jo ise duniya mein pehan lega woh Aakhirat ke din is se mehroom rahega. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) farmate hain, jo is din reshmi libaas se mehroom raha woh Jannat mein na jayega kyunke Jannat walon ka yahi libaas hai. Un ko paak baat sikha di gayi. Jaise farmaan hain aayat (TAHIYYATUHUM FEEHA SALAAM) (14. Ibrahim: 23). Ab imaan-daar ba-hukm-e-Ilahi Jannat mein jayenge jahan un ka tohfa aapas mein salaam hoga. Aur aayat mein hai har darwaze se farishte un ke paas aayenge aur salaam karke kahenge tumhare sabr ka kya hi achha anjaam hua. Aur jagah farmaya aayat (LA YASMA'OONA FEEHA LAGHWAN WALA TA'THEEMA, ILLA QEELAN SALAAMAN SALAAMA) (56. Al-Waqi'ah: 25-26). Wahan koi laghw baat aur ranj dene wali baat na sunenge bajuz salaam aur salamti ke. Pas unhein woh makaan de diya gaya jahan sirf dil lubhane wali aawazein aur salaam hi salaam sunte hain. Jaise farmaan hai wahan mubarak salamat ki aawazein hi aayengi, bar-khilaf dozakhiyon ke ke har waqt daant-dupat sunte hain, jhirke jaate hain, sarzanish ki ja rahi hai ke aise azaab bardasht karo waghera. Aur unhein woh jagah di gayi ke yeh nihaal-nihaal ho gaye aur be-sakhta un ki zabanon se Allah ki hamd ada hone lagi. Kyunke be-shumar be-nazeer rehmatein paalein. Sahih hadith mein hai ke jaise be-qasd-o-be-takalluf saans aata jaata rehta hai isi tarah behishti-yon ko tasbeeh-o-hamd ka ilhaam hoga.

Ba'az mufassireen ka qaul hai ke Tayyib kalam se murad Quran-e-Kareem hai aur La ilaha illallah hai, hadith ke wird aur azkar hain aur Sirat-e-Hamid se murad Islami rasta hai. Yeh tafsir bhi pehli tafsir ke khilaf nahin. Wallahu A'lam.

Masjid-e-Haram se rokne wale Allah Ta'ala kafiron ke is fe'l ki tardeed karta hai jo woh musalmanon ko Masjid-e-Haram se rokte thay, wahan unhein ahkam-e-hajj ada karne se baaz rakhte thay, bawajood is ke Auliya-e-Allah ke hone ka da'wa karte thay. Halankeh Auliya woh hain jin ke dilon mein Allah ka dar ho. Is se maloom hota hai ke yeh zikr Madine Sharif ka hai. Jaise Surah Baqarah ki aayat (Yas'alunaka 'anish-shahril harami...) mein hai. Yahan farmaya ke bawajood kufr ke phir yeh bhi fe'l hai ke Allah ki raah se aur Masjid-e-Haram se musalmanon ko rokte hain jo darhaqiqat is ke ahl hain. Yehi tarteeb is aayat ki hai (Alladhina amanu wa tatma'innu qulubuhum bidhikrillahi...), yani un ki sifat yeh hai ke un ke dil zikr-e-Allah se mutma'in ho jate hain. Masjid-e-Haram jo Allah ne sab ke liye yaksan taur par ba-hurmat banayi hai, muqeem aur musafir ke huqooq mein koi kami ziyadati nahin rakhi. Ahl-e-Makkah Masjid-e-Haram mein utar sakte hain aur bahar wale bhi. Wahan ki manzilon mein wahan ke bashinday aur beroon-e-mumalik ke log sab ek hi haq rakhte hain. Is maslay mein Imam Shafi'i (Rahimahullah) toh farmane lage Makkah ki haveliyan malkiyat mein layi ja sakti hain, virsay mein bat sakti hain aur kiraye par bhi di ja sakti hain. Daleel yeh di ke Usama bin Zaid (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke kal aap apne hi makan mein utrenge? Toh aap ne jawab diya ke Aqeel ne hamare liye kaun si haveli chhori hai? Phir farmaya kafir musalman ka virs nahin hota aur na musalman kafir ka. Aur daleel yeh hai ke Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne Hazrat Safwan bin Umayyah ka makan char hazar dirham mein khareed kar wahan jail khana banaya tha. Ta'oos aur Amr bin Dinar bhi is maslay mein Imam sahab ke ham-nawa hain. Imam Ishaq bin Rahuyah is ke khilaf kehte hain ke virsay mein bat nahin sakte na kiraye par diye ja sakte hain. Aslaf mein se ek jama'at yeh kehti hai, Mujahid aur Ata ka yehi maslak hai. Is ki daleel Ibn-e-Majah ki yeh hadith hai, Hazrat Alqama bin Fazala farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein, Siddiqi aur Farooqi khilafat mein Makkah ki haveliyan azaad aur be-malkiyat istemaal ki jati rahin, agar zaroorat hoti toh rehte warna auron ko basne ke liye de dete. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain na toh Makkah Sharif ke makanon ka bechna jaiz hai na un ka kiraya lena. Hazrat Ata bhi Haram mein kiraya lene ko mana karte thay. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) Makkah Sharif ke gharon ke darwaze rakhne se rokte thay kyunke sehan mein haaji log thehra karte thay. Sab se pehle ghar ka darwaza Suhail bin Amr ne banaya, Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne usi waqt unhein hazri ka hukum bheja, unhon ne aakar kaha mujhe maaf farmaya jaye, main saudagar shakhs hoon, main ne zarooratan yeh darwaze banaye hain taake mere janwar mere bas mein rahein. Aap ne farmaya phir khair hum ise tere liye jaiz rakhte hain. Aur riwayat mein hukum-e-Farooqi in alfaaz mein marwi hai ke ahl-e-Makkah apne makanon ke darwaze na rakho taake bahar ke log jahan chahein thehrein.

Ata farmate hain shehri aur ghair-watani in mein barabar hain jahan chahein utrein. Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain Makkah Sharif ke log gharon ka kiraya khane wala apne pet mein aag bharne wala hai. Imam Ahmad (R.H) ne in donon ke darmiyan ka maslak pasand farmaya yani malkiyat ko aur virse ko to jaiz bataya haan kiraya ko najayaz kaha hai is se daleelon mein jama ho jati hai. Wallahu A'lam. Bil-ilhad mein "ba" zaid hai jaise tanbutu bid-duhn mein. Aur A'sha ke sher (Zaminat birizqi ayalina armahuna al-kh), mein yani hamare gharane ki roziyan hamare nezon par mauquf hain al-kh, aur sheron ke ashaar mein "ba" ka aise mauqon par zaid aana musta'mal hua hai lekin is se bhi umda baat yeh hai ke hum kahein ke yahan ka fe'l baham ke ma'ni ka mutazammin hai is liye "ba" ke sath muta'addi hua hai. Ilhad se murad kabira sharmanak gunah hai. Bizulm se murad qasdan hai ta'wil ki ro se na hona hai. Aur ma'ni shirk ke ghair-Allah ki ibadat ke bhi kiye gaye hain. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke haram mein Allah ke haram kiye hue kaam ko halal samajh lena jaise gunah qatl-e-beja zulm-o-sitam waghera. Aise log dardnak azabon ke sazawar hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) jo bhi yahan bura kaam kare yeh haram sharif ki khusoosiyat hai ke ghair-watani log jab kisi badkaam ka irada bhi kar lein to bhi unhein saza hoti hai chahe use amlan na karein. Ibn Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain agar koi shakhs Adan mein ho aur haram mein ilhad-o-zulm ka irada rakhta ho to bhi Allah use dardnak azab ka maza chakhaye ga. Hazrat Shu'ba (R.H) farmate hain us ne to is ko marfu' bayan kiya tha lekin main ise marfu' nahin karta. Is ki aur sanad bhi hai jo sahih hai aur mauquf hona ba-nisbat marfu' hone ke zyada theek hai umuman qaul Ibn Mas'ud (R.A) se hi marvi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur riwayat mein hai kisi par burai ke sirf se burai nahin likhi jati lekin agar door daraz maslan Adan mein baith kar bhi yahan ke kisi shakhs ke qatl ka irada kare to Allah use dardnak azab mein mubtala kare ga. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain haan ya nahin kehne par yahan qasmein khana bhi ilhad mein dakhil hai. Sa'eed bin Jubair (R.H) ka farman hai ke apne khadim ko yahan gali dena bhi ilhad mein hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai amir shakhs ka yahan aakar tijarat karna. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Makkah mein anaaj ka bechna. Ibn Habib bin Abu Thabit farmate hain garan faroshi ke liye anaaj ko yahan rok rakhna. Ibn Abi Hatim mein bhi farman-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se yahi manqool hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh aayat Abdullah bin Unais ke bare mein utri hai use Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek muhajir aur ek ansar ke sath bheja tha ek martaba har ek apne apne nasab name par fakhr karne laga us ne gusse mein aakar ansari ko qatl kar diya aur Makkah ki taraf bhag khada hua aur deen-e-Islam chhod baitha. To matlab yeh hoga ke jo ilhad ke baad Makkah ki panah le. In aasar se goya maloom hota hai ke yeh sab kaam ilhad mein se hain lekin haqiqatan yeh in sab se zyada ahem baat hai balkeh is se badi cheez par is mein tanbeeh hai.

Isi liye jab hathi walon ne Baitullah Sharif ki kharabi ka irada kiya to Allah Ta'ala ne un par parindon ke ghool ke ghool bhej diye jinhon ne un par kankariyan phenk kar un ka bhas ura diya aur woh dusron ke liye ba'is-e-ibrat bana diye gaye. Chunancha hadith mein hai ke ek lashkar is Baitullah ke ghazwe ke irade se aayega jab woh Baida mein pahunchenge to sab ke sab ma'a awwal-o-akhir ke dhansa diye jayenge, al-kh. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) farmate hain aap yahan ilhad karne se bachein main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke yahan ek Quraishi ilhad karega us ke gunah agar tamam jinn-o-ins ke gunahon se tole jayen to bhi barh jayen dekho khayal rakho tum wohi na ban jana. (Musnad Ahmad) Aur riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke nasihat aap ne unhein Hatim mein baith kar ki thi.

Masjid-e-Haram ki awwalin bunyad tauheed. Yahan mushrikeen ko mutanabbeh kiya jata hai ke woh ghar jis ki bunyad awwal din se Allah ki tauheed par rakhi gayi hai tum ne is mein shirk jaari kar diya. Is ghar ke baani Khalilullah (A.S) hain, sab se pehle aap ne hi ise banaya. Aanhuzoor (ﷺ) se Abu Zar (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) sab se pehle kaun si masjid banayi gayi? Farmaya Masjid-e-Haram. Main ne kaha phir? Farmaya Bait-ul-Muqaddas. Main ne kaha in dono ke darmiyan kis qadar muddat ka fasla hai? Farmaya chalis saal ka. Allah ka farman hai aayat (Inna awwala baitin wudi'a linnasi lallazi bi bakkata mubarakan wa hudallil 'alamin) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 96), do aayaton tak. Aur aayat mein hai hum ne Ibrahim aur Ismail (A.S) se wada kar liya ke mere ghar ko paak rakhna al-kh. Baitullah Sharif ki bina ka kul zikr hai hum pehle likh chuke hain is liye yahan dobara likhne ki zaroorat nahin. Yahan farmaya ise sirf mere naam par bana aur ise paak rakh yani shirk waghera se aur ise khaas kar de un ke liye jo muwahhid hain. Tawaf woh ibadat hai jo saari zameen par bajuz Baitullah ke mayassar hi nahin, na-jaiz hai. Phir tawaf ke sath namaz ko milaya, qayam, ruku, sajde ka zikr farmaya is liye ke jis tarah tawaf is ke sath makhsoos hai namaz ka qibla bhi yahi hai. Haan is ki halat mein ke insaan ko maloom na ho ya jihad mein ho ya safar mein ho nafl namaz parh raha ho to beshak qibla ki taraf munh na hone ki halat mein bhi namaz ho jayegi, Wallahu A'lam. Aur yeh hukum mila ke is ghar ke hajj ki taraf tamam insaanon ko bula. Mazkoor hai ke aap ne us waqt arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala meri aawaz un tak kaise pahunchegi? Jawab mila ke aap ke zimme sirf pukarna hai, aawaz pahunchana mere zimme hai. Aap ne Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ya Safa pahari par, Abu Qais pahar par khare ho kar nida ki ke logo! Tumhare Rabb ne apna ek ghar banaya hai pas tum is ka hajj karo. Pahar jhuk gaye aur aap ki aawaz saari duniya mein goonj gayi. Yahan tak ke baap ki peeth mein aur maa ke pet mein jo the unhein bhi sunayi di. Har patthar, darakht aur har us shakhs ne jis ki qismat mein hajj karna likha tha ba-aawaz Labbaik pukara. Bahut se salaf se yeh manqool hai, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya paidal log bhi aayenge aur sawariyon par sawar bhi aayenge. Is se ba'az hazraat ne istidlal kiya hai ke jise taqat ho us ke liye paidal hajj karna sawari par hajj karne se afzal hai is liye ke pehle paidal walon ka zikr hai phir sawaron ka. To un ki taraf tawajjah zyada hui aur un ki himmat ki qadr-dani ki gayi. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain meri yeh tamanna reh gayi ke kaash ke main paidal hajj karta. Is liye ke farman-e-Ilahi mein paidal walon ka zikr hai.

Lekin aksar buzurgon ka qaul hai ke sawari par afzal hai kyunke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bawajood kamal-e-qudrat-o-quwwat ke pa-piyada hajj nahin kiya toh sawari par hajj karna Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki poori iqtida hai. Phir farmaya door daraz se hajj ke liye aayenge. Khalilullah (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki dua bhi yahi thi ke aayat (Faj'al af'idatan minan-nasi tahwi ilaihim) logon ke dilon ko ae Allah tu in ki taraf mutawajjeh kar de. Aaj dekh lo woh kaunsa musalman hai jis ka dil Ka'be ki ziyarat ka mushtaq na ho? Aur jis ke dil mein tawaf ki tamannayen tadap na rahi hon. (Allah Ta'ala hamain naseeb farmaye).

Lekin aksar buzurgon ka qaul hai ke sawari par afzal hai kyunke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bawajood kamal-e-qudrat-o-quwwat ke pa-piyada hajj nahin kiya toh sawari par hajj karna Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki poori iqtida hai. Phir farmaya door daraz se hajj ke liye aayenge. Khalilullah (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki dua bhi yahi thi ke aayat (Faj'al af'idatan minan-nasi tahwi ilaihim) logon ke dilon ko ae Allah tu in ki taraf mutawajjeh kar de. Aaj dekh lo woh kaunsa musalman hai jis ka dil Ka'be ki ziyarat ka mushtaq na ho? Aur jis ke dil mein tawaf ki tamannayen tadap na rahi hon. (Allah Ta'ala hamain naseeb farmaye).

Duniya aur aakhirat ke fawaid hasil karne ke liye aayen. Allah ki raza ke sath hi dunyawi mufad tijarat waghera ka faida uthayen. Jaise farmaya aayat (Laisa 'alaikum junahun an tabtaghu fadlan mir-rabbikum, fa-iza afadtum min 'Arafatin fazkurullaha 'indal-mash'aril-harami, wazkuru-hu kama hadakum, wa-in kuntum min qablihi lamined-dallin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 198). Mausam-e-Hajj mein tijarat karna mamnoo nahin. Muqarrara dinon se murad Zil-Hajj ka pehla ashra hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai kisi din ka amal Allah ke nazdeek in dinon ke amal se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya jihad bhi nahin, bajuz us mujahid ke amal ke jis ne apni jaan-o-maal Allah ki rah mein qurban kar diya ho (Sahih Bukhari). Main ne is hadith ko is ki tamam sanadon ke sath ek mustaqil kitab mein jama kar diya hai. Chunancha ek riwayat mein hai kisi din ka amal Allah ke nazdeek in dinon se bada aur pyara nahin, pas tum in das dinon mein La ilaha illallah aur Alhamdulillah bakasrat padha karo. Inhi dinon ki qasam aayat (Wa layalin 'ashr) ki aayat mein hai. Ba'az salaf kehte hain aayat (Wa wa'adna Musa thalathina laylatan wa atmam-naha bi-'ashrin fatamma miqatu rabbihi arba'ina laylatan) (Surah Al-A'raf: 142) se bhi murad yahi din hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) aur Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) in dinon bazaar mein aate aur takbeer pukarte, bazaar wale bhi aap ke sath takbeer padhne lagte. Inhi das dinon mein 'Arafah ka din hai jis din ke rozay ki nisbat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke guzishta aur aayinda do saal ke gunah maaf ho jate hain (Sahih Muslim Sharif). Inhi das dinon mein qurbani ka din yani Baqra Eid ka din hai jis ka naam Islam mein Hajj-e-Akbar ka din hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh sab dinon se afzal hai. Al-gharaz saare saal mein aisi fazeelat ke din aur nahin jaise ke hadith-e-sharif mein hai. Yeh das din Ramadan Sharif ke aakhri das dinon se bhi afzal hain. Kyunke namaz, roza, sadqa waghera jo Ramadan ke is aakhri ashray mein hota hai woh sab in dinon mein bhi hota hai, mazeed bar-aan in mein fareeza-e-Hajj ada hota hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Ramadan Sharif ke aakhri din afzal hain kyunke inhi mein Lailatul-Qadr hai jo ek hazar mahinon se behtar hai. Teesra qaul darmiyana hai ke din to yeh afzal aur raatein Ramadan-ul-Mubarak ke aakhri das dinon ki afzal hain. Is qaul ke maan lene se mukhtalif dalail mein jama ho jati hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ayyam-e-Ma'lumat ki tafseer mein ek dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh qurbani ka din aur us ke baad ke teen din hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) aur Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H) se yahi marwi hai aur ek riwayat se Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Teesra qaul yeh hai ke Baqra Eid aur us ke baad ke do din. Aur Ayyam-e-Ma'dudat se Baqra Eid aur us ke baad ke teen din. Is ki asnaad Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) tak sahih hai.

Suddi R.H bhi yahi kehte hain, Imam Malik R.H ka bhi yahi mazhab hai aur is ki aur is se pehle ke qaul ki ta'eed farman-e-Bari Ayat (عَلٰي مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَهِيْمَةِ الْاَنْعَامِ) (22-Al-Hajj: 28) se hoti hai kyunke is se murad janwaron ki qurbani ke waqt Allah ka naam lena hai. Chautha qaul yeh hai ke yeh Arafah ka din, Baqra Eid ka din aur is ke baad ka ek din hai, Imam Abu Hanifa R.H ka mazhab yahi hai. Hazrat Aslam se marwi hai ke murad yaum-e-nahr aur ayyam-e-tashreeq hain. Baheematal-An'aam se murad oont, gaye aur bakri hain. Jaise Surah Al-An'aam ki Ayat (ثَمٰنِيَةَ اَزْوَاجٍ ۚ مِنَ الضَّاْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ الْمَعْزِ اثْنَيْنِ ۭقُلْ ءٰۗالذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ اَمِ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ اَمَّا اشْـتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَرْحَامُ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ ۭ نَبِّـــــُٔـوْنِيْ بِعِلْمٍ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ) (6-Al-An'aam: 143) mein mufassal maujood hai. Lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Aksar buzurgon ka mazhab hai ke yeh rukhsat hai ya istihbab hai. Chunancha Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab qurbani ki to hukum diya ke har oont ke gosht ka ek tukda nikal kar pakaliya jaye, phir aap ne woh gosht khaya aur shorba piya. Imam Malik R.H farmate hain main ise pasand karta hoon ke qurbani ka gosht qurbani karne wala kha le kyunke Allah ka farman hai. Ibrahim R.H farmate hain ke mushrik log apni qurbani ka gosht nahin khate the, is ke bar-khilaf musalmanon ko is ke gosht ke khane ki ijazat di gayi, ab jo chahe khaye jo chahe na khaye. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke mushrik log apni qurbaniyon ka gosht nahin khate the, is ke bar-khilaf musalmanon ko is gosht ke khane ki ijazat di gayi, ab jo chahe khaye jo chahe na khaye. Hazrat Mujahid R.H aur Hazrat Ata R.H se bhi isi tarah manqool hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain yahan ka yeh hukum Ayat (وَاِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَاصْطَادُوْا ۭوَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَـنَاٰنُ قَوْمٍ اَنْ صَدُّوْكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اَنْ تَعْتَدُوْا) (5-Al-Ma'idah: 2) ki tarah hai, yani jab tum ehram se farigh ho jao to shikar khelo. Aur Surah Jumu'ah mein farman hai Ayat (فَاِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلٰوةُ فَانْتَشِرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَابْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِ اللّٰهِ وَاذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ) (62-Al-Jumu'ah: 10) jab namaz poori ho jaye to zameen mein phail jao. Matlab yeh hai ke in dono ayaton mein hukum hai shikar karne ka aur zameen mein rozi talash karne ke liye phail jane ka, lekin yeh hukum wajoobi aur farzi nahin, isi tarah apni qurbani ke gosht ko khane ka hukum bhi zaroori aur wajib nahin. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi is qaul ko pasand farmate hain. Baaz logon ka khayal hai ke qurbani ke gosht ke do hisse kar diye jayen, ek hissa khud qurbani karne wale ka, doosra hissa faqeer fuqara ka. Baaz kehte hain teen karne chahiye, tihai apna, tihai hadiya dene ke liye aur tihai sadqa karne ke liye.

Pehle qaul wale upar ki aayat ki sanad late hain aur dusre qaul wale aayat (وَاَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّ ۭ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ 36؀) (Surah Al-Hajj: 36) ko daleel mein pesh karte hain is ka poora bayan aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Ikrimah (R.H) farmate hain aayat (Al-Ba'is-ul-Faqir) se matlab woh bebas insaan hai jo ehtiyaaj hone par bhi sawaal se bachta ho. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jo dast-e-sawaal daraz na karta ho, kam beenai wala ho, ahkaam-e-hajj phir woh ehram khol dalein, sar mundwa lein, kapde pehan lein, naakhun katwa dalein, wagaira ahkaam-e-hajj poore kar lein. Nazrein poori kar lein, hajj ki qurbani ki aur jo ho. Pas jo shakhs hajj ke liye nikla us ke zimme tawaf-e-Baitullah, tawaf-e-Safa Marwa, Arafat ke maidan mein jana, Muzdalifa ki hazri, shaitanon ko kankar marna wagaira sab kuch laazim hai. In tamam ahkaam ko poore karein aur sahih taur par baja layein aur Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf karein jo Youm-un-Nahr ko wajib hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain hajj ka aakhri kaam tawaf hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi kiya jab aap das Zil-Hajj ko Mina ki taraf wapas aaye to sab se pehle shaitanon ko saat saat kankariyan marein. Phir qurbani ki, phir sar mundwaya, phir laut kar Baitullah aakar tawaf-e-Baitullah kiya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Bukhari-o-Muslim mein marwi hai ke logon ko hukm kiya gaya hai ke un ka aakhri kaam tawaf-e-Baitullah ho. Haan albatta ha'iza aurton ko riayat kar di gayi hai. Bait-ul-Atiq ke lafz se istidlal karke farmaya gaya hai ke tawaf karne wale ko Hateem bhi apne tawaf ke andar le lena chahiye. Is liye ke woh bhi asal Baitullah Sharif mein se hai, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki bina mein yeh dakhil tha go Quraish ne naya banate waqt ise bahar chhod diya lekin is ki wajah bhi kharch ki kami thi na ke aur kuch. Is liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hateem ke peeche se tawaf kiya aur farma bhi diya ke Hateem Baitullah Sharif mein dakhil hai. Aur aap ne dono shami ruknon ko haath nahin lagaya na bosa diya kyunke woh bina-e-Ibrahimi ke mutabiq poore nahin. Is aayat ke utarne ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hateem ke peeche se tawaf kiya. Pehle is tarah ki imarat thi ke yeh andar tha isi liye ise purana ghar kaha gaya, yahi sab se pehla Allah ka ghar hai aur wajah yeh bhi hai ke yeh toofan-e-Nooh mein salamat raha. Aur yeh bhi wajah hai ke koi sarkash is par ghalib nahin aa saka. Yeh un sab ki dastburd se azaad hai jis ne bhi is se bura qasd kiya woh tabah hua. Allah ne ise sarkashon ke tasallut se azaad kar liya hai. Tirmidhi mein isi tarah ki ek marfoo hadith bhi hai jo Hasan Ghareeb hai aur ek aur sanad se mursalan bhi marwi hai.

Duniya aur aakhirat ke fawaid hasil karne ke liye aayen. Allah ki raza ke sath hi dunyawi mufad tijarat waghera ka faida uthayen. Jaise farmaya aayat (Laisa 'alaikum junahun an tabtaghu fadlan mir-rabbikum, fa-iza afadtum min 'Arafatin fazkurullaha 'indal-mash'aril-harami, wazkuru-hu kama hadakum, wa-in kuntum min qablihi lamined-dallin) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 198). Mausam-e-Hajj mein tijarat karna mamnoo nahin. Muqarrara dinon se murad Zil-Hajj ka pehla ashra hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai kisi din ka amal Allah ke nazdeek in dinon ke amal se afzal nahin. Logon ne poocha jihad bhi nahin? Farmaya jihad bhi nahin, bajuz us mujahid ke amal ke jis ne apni jaan-o-maal Allah ki rah mein qurban kar diya ho (Sahih Bukhari). Main ne is hadith ko is ki tamam sanadon ke sath ek mustaqil kitab mein jama kar diya hai. Chunancha ek riwayat mein hai kisi din ka amal Allah ke nazdeek in dinon se bada aur pyara nahin, pas tum in das dinon mein La ilaha illallah aur Alhamdulillah bakasrat padha karo. Inhi dinon ki qasam aayat (Wa layalin 'ashr) ki aayat mein hai. Ba'az salaf kehte hain aayat (Wa wa'adna Musa thalathina laylatan wa atmam-naha bi-'ashrin fatamma miqatu rabbihi arba'ina laylatan) (Surah Al-A'raf: 142) se bhi murad yahi din hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) aur Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) in dinon bazaar mein aate aur takbeer pukarte, bazaar wale bhi aap ke sath takbeer padhne lagte. Inhi das dinon mein 'Arafah ka din hai jis din ke rozay ki nisbat Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke guzishta aur aayinda do saal ke gunah maaf ho jate hain (Sahih Muslim Sharif). Inhi das dinon mein qurbani ka din yani Baqra Eid ka din hai jis ka naam Islam mein Hajj-e-Akbar ka din hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Allah ke nazdeek yeh sab dinon se afzal hai. Al-gharaz saare saal mein aisi fazeelat ke din aur nahin jaise ke hadith-e-sharif mein hai. Yeh das din Ramadan Sharif ke aakhri das dinon se bhi afzal hain. Kyunke namaz, roza, sadqa waghera jo Ramadan ke is aakhri ashray mein hota hai woh sab in dinon mein bhi hota hai, mazeed bar-aan in mein fareeza-e-Hajj ada hota hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Ramadan Sharif ke aakhri din afzal hain kyunke inhi mein Lailatul-Qadr hai jo ek hazar mahinon se behtar hai. Teesra qaul darmiyana hai ke din to yeh afzal aur raatein Ramadan-ul-Mubarak ke aakhri das dinon ki afzal hain. Is qaul ke maan lene se mukhtalif dalail mein jama ho jati hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ayyam-e-Ma'lumat ki tafseer mein ek dusra qaul yeh hai ke yeh qurbani ka din aur us ke baad ke teen din hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) aur Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H) se yahi marwi hai aur ek riwayat se Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ka mazhab bhi yahi hai. Teesra qaul yeh hai ke Baqra Eid aur us ke baad ke do din. Aur Ayyam-e-Ma'dudat se Baqra Eid aur us ke baad ke teen din. Is ki asnaad Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) tak sahih hai.

Suddi R.H bhi yahi kehte hain, Imam Malik R.H ka bhi yahi mazhab hai aur is ki aur is se pehle ke qaul ki ta'eed farman-e-Bari Ayat (عَلٰي مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَهِيْمَةِ الْاَنْعَامِ) (22-Al-Hajj: 28) se hoti hai kyunke is se murad janwaron ki qurbani ke waqt Allah ka naam lena hai. Chautha qaul yeh hai ke yeh Arafah ka din, Baqra Eid ka din aur is ke baad ka ek din hai, Imam Abu Hanifa R.H ka mazhab yahi hai. Hazrat Aslam se marwi hai ke murad yaum-e-nahr aur ayyam-e-tashreeq hain. Baheematal-An'aam se murad oont, gaye aur bakri hain. Jaise Surah Al-An'aam ki Ayat (ثَمٰنِيَةَ اَزْوَاجٍ ۚ مِنَ الضَّاْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ الْمَعْزِ اثْنَيْنِ ۭقُلْ ءٰۗالذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ اَمِ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ اَمَّا اشْـتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَرْحَامُ الْاُنْثَيَيْنِ ۭ نَبِّـــــُٔـوْنِيْ بِعِلْمٍ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ) (6-Al-An'aam: 143) mein mufassal maujood hai. Lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Aksar buzurgon ka mazhab hai ke yeh rukhsat hai ya istihbab hai. Chunancha Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab qurbani ki to hukum diya ke har oont ke gosht ka ek tukda nikal kar pakaliya jaye, phir aap ne woh gosht khaya aur shorba piya. Imam Malik R.H farmate hain main ise pasand karta hoon ke qurbani ka gosht qurbani karne wala kha le kyunke Allah ka farman hai. Ibrahim R.H farmate hain ke mushrik log apni qurbani ka gosht nahin khate the, is ke bar-khilaf musalmanon ko is ke gosht ke khane ki ijazat di gayi, ab jo chahe khaye jo chahe na khaye. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain ke mushrik log apni qurbaniyon ka gosht nahin khate the, is ke bar-khilaf musalmanon ko is gosht ke khane ki ijazat di gayi, ab jo chahe khaye jo chahe na khaye. Hazrat Mujahid R.H aur Hazrat Ata R.H se bhi isi tarah manqool hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain yahan ka yeh hukum Ayat (وَاِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَاصْطَادُوْا ۭوَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَـنَاٰنُ قَوْمٍ اَنْ صَدُّوْكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اَنْ تَعْتَدُوْا) (5-Al-Ma'idah: 2) ki tarah hai, yani jab tum ehram se farigh ho jao to shikar khelo. Aur Surah Jumu'ah mein farman hai Ayat (فَاِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلٰوةُ فَانْتَشِرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَابْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِ اللّٰهِ وَاذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُوْنَ) (62-Al-Jumu'ah: 10) jab namaz poori ho jaye to zameen mein phail jao. Matlab yeh hai ke in dono ayaton mein hukum hai shikar karne ka aur zameen mein rozi talash karne ke liye phail jane ka, lekin yeh hukum wajoobi aur farzi nahin, isi tarah apni qurbani ke gosht ko khane ka hukum bhi zaroori aur wajib nahin. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H bhi is qaul ko pasand farmate hain. Baaz logon ka khayal hai ke qurbani ke gosht ke do hisse kar diye jayen, ek hissa khud qurbani karne wale ka, doosra hissa faqeer fuqara ka. Baaz kehte hain teen karne chahiye, tihai apna, tihai hadiya dene ke liye aur tihai sadqa karne ke liye.

Pehle qaul wale upar ki aayat ki sanad late hain aur dusre qaul wale aayat (وَاَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّ ۭ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ 36؀) (Surah Al-Hajj: 36) ko daleel mein pesh karte hain is ka poora bayan aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Ikrimah (R.H) farmate hain aayat (Al-Ba'is-ul-Faqir) se matlab woh bebas insaan hai jo ehtiyaaj hone par bhi sawaal se bachta ho. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain jo dast-e-sawaal daraz na karta ho, kam beenai wala ho, ahkaam-e-hajj phir woh ehram khol dalein, sar mundwa lein, kapde pehan lein, naakhun katwa dalein, wagaira ahkaam-e-hajj poore kar lein. Nazrein poori kar lein, hajj ki qurbani ki aur jo ho. Pas jo shakhs hajj ke liye nikla us ke zimme tawaf-e-Baitullah, tawaf-e-Safa Marwa, Arafat ke maidan mein jana, Muzdalifa ki hazri, shaitanon ko kankar marna wagaira sab kuch laazim hai. In tamam ahkaam ko poore karein aur sahih taur par baja layein aur Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf karein jo Youm-un-Nahr ko wajib hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain hajj ka aakhri kaam tawaf hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bhi kiya jab aap das Zil-Hajj ko Mina ki taraf wapas aaye to sab se pehle shaitanon ko saat saat kankariyan marein. Phir qurbani ki, phir sar mundwaya, phir laut kar Baitullah aakar tawaf-e-Baitullah kiya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Bukhari-o-Muslim mein marwi hai ke logon ko hukm kiya gaya hai ke un ka aakhri kaam tawaf-e-Baitullah ho. Haan albatta ha'iza aurton ko riayat kar di gayi hai. Bait-ul-Atiq ke lafz se istidlal karke farmaya gaya hai ke tawaf karne wale ko Hateem bhi apne tawaf ke andar le lena chahiye. Is liye ke woh bhi asal Baitullah Sharif mein se hai, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki bina mein yeh dakhil tha go Quraish ne naya banate waqt ise bahar chhod diya lekin is ki wajah bhi kharch ki kami thi na ke aur kuch. Is liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hateem ke peeche se tawaf kiya aur farma bhi diya ke Hateem Baitullah Sharif mein dakhil hai. Aur aap ne dono shami ruknon ko haath nahin lagaya na bosa diya kyunke woh bina-e-Ibrahimi ke mutabiq poore nahin. Is aayat ke utarne ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hateem ke peeche se tawaf kiya. Pehle is tarah ki imarat thi ke yeh andar tha isi liye ise purana ghar kaha gaya, yahi sab se pehla Allah ka ghar hai aur wajah yeh bhi hai ke yeh toofan-e-Nooh mein salamat raha. Aur yeh bhi wajah hai ke koi sarkash is par ghalib nahin aa saka. Yeh un sab ki dastburd se azaad hai jis ne bhi is se bura qasd kiya woh tabah hua. Allah ne ise sarkashon ke tasallut se azaad kar liya hai. Tirmidhi mein isi tarah ki ek marfoo hadith bhi hai jo Hasan Ghareeb hai aur ek aur sanad se mursalan bhi marwi hai.

But-parasti ki gandagi se door raho. Farmata hai yeh toh thay ahkam-e-hajj aur un par jo jaza milti hai us ka bayan. Ab aur suno jo shakhs hurmat-e-Ilahi ki izzat kare yani gunahon se aur haram kamon se bache, un ke karne se apne aap ko roke aur un se bhaga rahe us ke liye Allah ke paas bada ajar hai. Jis tarah nekiyon ke karne par ajar hai isi tarah buraiyon ke chhodne par bhi sawab hai. Makkah, hajj, umrah bhi hurmat-e-Ilahi hain. Tumhare liye chopaye sab halal hain, haan jo haram thay woh tumhare samne bayan ho chuke hain. Yeh jo mushrikon ne baheera, saiba, waseela aur haam naam rakh chhore hain yeh Allah ne nahin batlaye. Allah ko jo haram karna tha bayan farma chuka jaise murdar janwar, waqt-e-zibah baha hua khoon, suar ka gosht, Allah ke siwa dusre ke naam par mashhoor kiya hua, gala ghuta hua waghera. Tumhein chahiye ke but-parasti ki gandagi se door raho, "min" yahan par bayan-e-jins ke liye hai. Aur jhooti baat se bacho. Is ayat mein shirk ke sath jhoot ko mila diya jaise ayat (Qul innama harrama rabbiya al-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batana wal-ithma wal-baghya bighayri al-haqqi wa an tushriku billahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan wa an taqulu 'ala Allahi ma la ta'lamun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 33) yani mere Rab ne gande kamon ko haram kar diya khwah woh zahir hon khwah posheeda. Aur gunah ko, sarkashi ko aur be-ilmi ke sath Allah par baatein banane ko. Isi mein jhooti gawahi bhi dakhil hai. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) ne poocha kya main tumhein sab se bada kabeera gunah bataoon? Sahaba ne kaha irshad ho, farmaya Allah ke sath shareek karna, maa baap ki nafarmani karna, phir takiya se alag hat kar farmaya aur jhoot bolna aur jhooti shahadat dena. Ise baar baar farmate rahe yahan tak ke hum ne kaha kaash ke aap ab na farmate. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne apne khutbe mein khade ho kar teen baar farmaya jhooti gawahi Allah ke sath shirk karne ke barabar kar di gayi, phir aap ne mandarja bala fiqra tilawat farmaya. Aur riwayat mein hai ke subah ki namaz ke baad aap ne khade ho kar yeh farmaya. Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) ka yeh farman bhi marwi hai Allah ke deen ko khuloos ke sath tham lo, batil se hat kar haq ki taraf aa jao. Is ke sath kisi ko shareek thairane walon mein na bano. Phir mushrik ki tabahi ki misaal bayan farmayi ke jaise koi aasman se gir pade pas ya toh use parind hi uchak le jayenge ya hawa kisi halakat ke door daraz gaddhe mein pahuncha degi. Chunancha kafir ki rooh ko le kar jab farishtay aasman ki taraf chadh-te hain toh us ke liye aasman ke darwaze nahin khulte aur wahin se woh phenk di jati hai isi ka bayan is ayat mein hai. Yeh hadith poori tafseel ke sath Surah Ibrahim mein guzar chuki hai, Surah An'am mein un mushrikon ki ek aur misaal bayan farmayi hai yeh us ki misl ke hai jise shaitan bawla bana de, al-kh.
