Qurbani ke janwar aur hujjaj Allah ke shaa'ir ki, jin mein qurbani ke janwar bhi shamil hain, hurmat-o-izzat bayan ho rahi hai ke ahkam-e-Ilahi par amal karna Allah ke farman ki tauqeer karna hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain: Yani qurbani ke janwaron ko farba aur umda karna. Sahl ka bayan hai ke hum qurbani ke janwaron ko paal kar unhein farba aur umda karte thay, tamam musalmanon ka yahi dastoor tha (Bukhari Sharif). Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke do siyah rang ke janwaron ke khoon se ek umda safed rang janwar ka khoon Allah ko zyada mehboob hai (Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Majah). Pas agarcheh aur rangat ke janwar bhi jaiz hain lekin safed rang janwar afzal hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne do mendhay chit-kabray baray baray seengon walay apni qurbani mein zibah kiye. Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain, Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek mendha bara seeng wala chit-kabra zibah kiya jis ke munh par, aankhon ke paas aur pairon par siyah rang tha (Sunan). Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) isay sahih kehte hain. Ibn Majah waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne do mendhay bohat motay tazay, chiknay, chit-kabray, khasi zibah kiye. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne hukum farmaya ke hum qurbani ke liye janwar khareedte waqt us ki aankhon ko aur kaanon ko achi tarah dekh bhaal liya karein. Aur aagay se katay huay kaan walay, peechay se katay huay kaan walay, lambai mein chiray huay kaan walay ya soorakh dar kaan walay ki qurbani na karein (Ahmad, Ahl-e-Sunan). Isay Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) sahih kehte hain. Isi tarah Huzoor (ﷺ) ne seeng tootay huay aur kaan katay huay janwar ki qurbani se mana farmaya hai. Is ki sharah mein Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyib (R.H) farmate hain jab ke aadha ya aadhay se zyada kaan ya seeng na ho. Baaz ahl-e-lughat kehte hain agar oopar se kisi janwar ka seeng toota hua ho to usay arabi mein qasma kehte aur jab neechay ka hissa toota hua ho to usay azb kehte. Aur hadith mein lafz azb hai aur kaan ka kuch hissa kat gaya ho to usay bhi arabi mein azb kehte hain. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain aisay janwar ki qurbani go jaiz hai lekin karahat ke sath. Imam Ahmad (R.H) farmate hain ke jaiz hi nahin (bazahir yahi qaul mutabiq-e-hadith hai). Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain agar seeng se khoon jaari hai to jaiz nahin warna jaiz hai, Wallahu A'lam. Huzoor (ﷺ) ki hadith hai ke chaar qisam ke aib-dar janwar qurbani mein jaiz nahin: kana janwar jis ka bhenga-pan zahir ho, aur woh beemar janwar jis ki beemari khuli hui ho, aur woh langra jis ka langra-pan zahir ho, aur woh dubla patla mareel janwar jo gooday ke baghair ka ho gaya ho (Ahmad, Ahl-e-Sunan). Isay Imam Tirmidhi sahih kehte hain. Yeh uyub woh hain jin se janwar ghat jata hai. Is ka gosht naqis ho jata hai aur bakriyan charti chugti rehti hain aur yeh bojh apni kamzori ke chara-poora nahin pata, isi liye is hadith ke mutabiq Imam Shafi'i waghera ke nazdeek is ki qurbani na-jaiz hai. Haan, beemar janwar ke baray mein jis ki beemari khatarnak darjay ki na ho, bohat kam ho, Imam Sahab ke dono qaul hain.

Abu Dawood mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mana farmaya bilkul seeng kate janwar, seeng toote janwar aur kaane janwar se aur bilkul kamzor janwar se jo hamesha hi rewar ke peeche reh jata ho bajah kamzori ke ya bajah zyada umr ke aur langre janwar se. Pas in kul uyub wale janwaron ki qurbani najaiz hai. Haan agar qurbani ke liye sahih salim be-aib janwar muqarrar kar dene ke baad ittefaqan us mein koi aisi baat aajaye maslan loola langra waghera ho jaye to Hazrat Imam Shafi (R.H) ke nazdeek us ki qurbani bila-shuba jaiz hai, Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) is ke khilaf hain. Imam Shafi (R.H) ki daleel woh hadith hai jo Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Abu Saeed (R.A) se marwi hai ke main ne qurbani ke liye janwar khareeda us par ek bhediye ne hamla kiya aur us ki raan ka boota tod liya, main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se waqia bayan kiya to Aap ne farmaya tum isi janwar ki qurbani kar sakte ho. Pas khareedte waqt janwar ka farba hona, tayyar hona, be-aib hona chahiye jaise Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka hukum hai ke aankh kaan dekh liya karo. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne ek nihayat umda oont qurbani ke liye namzad kiya, logon ne us ki qeemat teen sau ashrafi lagayin to Aap ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se masla daryaft kiya agar Aap ijazat dein to main ise bech doon aur us ki qeemat se aur janwar bahut se khareed loon aur unhein rah-e-Lillah qurban karoon, Aap ne mana farma diya aur hukum diya ke isi ko fi sabeelillah zibah karo. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain qurbani ke oont Sha'air-e-Allah mein se hain. Muhammad bin Abi Musa (R.A) farmate hain Arafat mein theharna aur Muzdalifa aur Rami-e-Jamar aur sar mundwana aur qurbani ke oont yeh sab Sha'air-e-Allah hain. Ibn Umar (R.A) farmate hain in sab se badh kar Baitullah Sharif hai. Phir farmata hai in janwaron ke baalon mein, oon mein tumhare liye fawaid hain, in par tum sawar hote ho, in ki khalein tumhare liye kar-e-aamad hain. Yeh sab ek muqarrara waqt tak. Yani jab tak ise rah-e-Lillah namzad nahin kiya. In ka doodh piyo, in se naslein hasil karo, jab qurbani ke liye muqarrar kar diya phir woh Allah ki cheez ho gaya. Buzurg kehte hain agar zaroorat ho to ab bhi sawari ki ijazat hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke ek shakhs ko apni qurbani ka janwar hankte hue dekh kar Aap ne farmaya is par sawar ho jao, us ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ise qurbani ki niyat kar chuka hoon. Aap ne dusri ya teesri baar farmaya afsos baith kyun nahin jata. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai jab zaroorat aur haajat ho to sawar ho jaya karo. Ek shakhs ki qurbani ki oontni ne bacha diya to Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne use hukum diya ke is ko doodh pet bhar kar pee lene de phir agar bach rahe to khair, tu apne kaam mein la aur qurbani wale din ise aur is bache ko dono ko ba-naam-e-Allah zibah kar de. Phir farmata hai in ki qurban-gah Baitullah Sharif hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Hadyan balighal ka'bah) (5. Al-Ma'idah: 95) aur aayat mein (Wal-hadyi ma'koofan an yablugha mahillah) (48. Al-Fath: 25).

(Al-Fath: 25) Bait-ul-Atiq ke ma'ani is se pehle abhi abhi bayan ho chuke hain, falhamdulillah. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, Baitullah ka tawaf karne wala ehram se halal ho jata hai. Daleel mein yehi aayat tilawat farmayi.

Qurbani ke janwar aur hujjaj Allah ke shaa'ir ki, jin mein qurbani ke janwar bhi shamil hain, hurmat-o-izzat bayan ho rahi hai ke ahkam-e-Ilahi par amal karna Allah ke farman ki tauqeer karna hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain: Yani qurbani ke janwaron ko farba aur umda karna. Sahl ka bayan hai ke hum qurbani ke janwaron ko paal kar unhein farba aur umda karte thay, tamam musalmanon ka yahi dastoor tha (Bukhari Sharif). Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke do siyah rang ke janwaron ke khoon se ek umda safed rang janwar ka khoon Allah ko zyada mehboob hai (Musnad Ahmad, Ibn Majah). Pas agarcheh aur rangat ke janwar bhi jaiz hain lekin safed rang janwar afzal hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne do mendhay chit-kabray baray baray seengon walay apni qurbani mein zibah kiye. Abu Saeed (R.A) farmate hain, Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek mendha bara seeng wala chit-kabra zibah kiya jis ke munh par, aankhon ke paas aur pairon par siyah rang tha (Sunan). Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) isay sahih kehte hain. Ibn Majah waghera mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne do mendhay bohat motay tazay, chiknay, chit-kabray, khasi zibah kiye. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne hukum farmaya ke hum qurbani ke liye janwar khareedte waqt us ki aankhon ko aur kaanon ko achi tarah dekh bhaal liya karein. Aur aagay se katay huay kaan walay, peechay se katay huay kaan walay, lambai mein chiray huay kaan walay ya soorakh dar kaan walay ki qurbani na karein (Ahmad, Ahl-e-Sunan). Isay Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) sahih kehte hain. Isi tarah Huzoor (ﷺ) ne seeng tootay huay aur kaan katay huay janwar ki qurbani se mana farmaya hai. Is ki sharah mein Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyib (R.H) farmate hain jab ke aadha ya aadhay se zyada kaan ya seeng na ho. Baaz ahl-e-lughat kehte hain agar oopar se kisi janwar ka seeng toota hua ho to usay arabi mein qasma kehte aur jab neechay ka hissa toota hua ho to usay azb kehte. Aur hadith mein lafz azb hai aur kaan ka kuch hissa kat gaya ho to usay bhi arabi mein azb kehte hain. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) farmate hain aisay janwar ki qurbani go jaiz hai lekin karahat ke sath. Imam Ahmad (R.H) farmate hain ke jaiz hi nahin (bazahir yahi qaul mutabiq-e-hadith hai). Imam Malik (R.H) farmate hain agar seeng se khoon jaari hai to jaiz nahin warna jaiz hai, Wallahu A'lam. Huzoor (ﷺ) ki hadith hai ke chaar qisam ke aib-dar janwar qurbani mein jaiz nahin: kana janwar jis ka bhenga-pan zahir ho, aur woh beemar janwar jis ki beemari khuli hui ho, aur woh langra jis ka langra-pan zahir ho, aur woh dubla patla mareel janwar jo gooday ke baghair ka ho gaya ho (Ahmad, Ahl-e-Sunan). Isay Imam Tirmidhi sahih kehte hain. Yeh uyub woh hain jin se janwar ghat jata hai. Is ka gosht naqis ho jata hai aur bakriyan charti chugti rehti hain aur yeh bojh apni kamzori ke chara-poora nahin pata, isi liye is hadith ke mutabiq Imam Shafi'i waghera ke nazdeek is ki qurbani na-jaiz hai. Haan, beemar janwar ke baray mein jis ki beemari khatarnak darjay ki na ho, bohat kam ho, Imam Sahab ke dono qaul hain.

Qurbani har ummat par farz qarar di gayi. Farman hai ke kul ummaton mein, har mazhab mein, har giroh ko hum ne qurbani ka hukum diya tha. Un ke liye ek din eid ka muqarrar tha. Woh bhi Allah ke naam zabiha karte the. Sab ke sab Makkah Sharif mein apni qurbaniyan bhejte the. Taake qurbani ke chopaye janwaron ke zibah karne ke waqt Allah ka naam zikr karein. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas do mendhay chit-kabray bade bade singon wale laye gaye, aap ne unhein lita kar un ki gardan par paon rakh kar Bismillah Wallahu Akbar padh kar zibah kiya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Sahaba (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke yeh qurbaniyan kya hain? Aap ne jawab diya tumhare baap Ibrahim (A.S) ki sunnat. Poocha hamein is mein kya milta hai? Farmaya har baal ke badle ek neki. Daryaft kiya aur "oon" ka kya hukum hai? Farmaya un ke rooyen ke badle ek neki. Isay Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (Rahimahullah / R.H) bhi laye hain. Tum sab ka Allah ek hai, go shariat ke baaz ahkaam adl-badal hote rahe lekin tauheed mein, Allah ki yaganat mein, kisi rasool ko kisi nek ummat ko ikhtilaf nahin hua. Sab Allah ki tauheed, usi ki ibadat ki taraf tamam jahan ko bulate rahe. Sab par awwal wahi yahi nazil hoti rahi. Pas tum sab us ki taraf jhuk jao, us ke ho kar raho, us ke ahkaam ki pabandi karo, us ki itaat mein istehkam karo. Jo log mutma'in hain, jo mutawaze hain, jo taqway wale hain, jo zulm se bezar hain, mazloomi ki halat mein badla lene ke khugar nahin, marzi-e-Maula, raza-e-Rabb par razi hain unhein khushkhabriyaan suna dein, woh mubarakbad ke qabil hain. Jo zikr-e-Ilahi sunte hain dil narm, aur khauf-e-Ilahi se pur kar ke Rabb ki taraf jhuk jate hain, kathan kamon par sabr karte hain, museebaton par sabr karte hain. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah / R.H) farmate hain wallah agar tum ne sabr-o-bardasht ki aadat na dali to tum barbad kar diye jaoge. Wa-l-muqimi ki qira'at izafat ke sath to jamhoor ki hai. Lekin Ibn-e-Sumayfa ne Wa-l-muqimeena padha hai aur As-Salati ka zabar padha hai. Imam Hasan ne padha to hai noon ke hazf aur izafat ke sath lekin As-Salati ka zabar padha hai aur farmate hain ke noon ka hazf yahan par ba-wajah-e-takhfeef ke hai kyunke agar ba-wajah-e-izafat mana jaye to is ka zabar lazim hai. Aur ho sakta hai ke ba-wajah-e-qurb ke ho. Matlab yeh hai ke fareeza-e-Ilahi ke paband hain aur Allah ka haq ada karne wale hain aur Allah ka diya hua dete rehte hain, apne gharane ke logon ko, faqiron mohtajon ko aur tamam makhlooq ko jo bhi zaroorat mand hon sab ke sath sulook-o-ehsan se pesh aate hain. Allah ki hudood ki hifazat karte hain munafiqon ki tarah nahin ke ek kaam karein to ek ko chhod dein. Surah Bara'at mein bhi yahi sifatein bayan farmayi hain aur wahin poori tafsir bhi bihamdillah hum kar aaye hain.

Sha'air-e-Allah kya hain? Yeh bhi Allah Ta'ala ka ehsan hai ke usne janwar paida kiye aur unhein apne naam par qurban karne aur apne ghar bator-e-qurbani ke pahunchane ka hukum farmaya aur unhein Sha'air-e-Allah qarar diya aur hukum farmaya aayat (Yaa ayyuhallazina aamanu laa tuhillu sha'aairallahi walash-shahrul harami walal hadya walal qalaaa'ida wa laaa aam-minal baytal harama yabtaghuna fadlam mir-rabbihim wa ridwana) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 2). Na toh Allah ke in azmat wale nishanat ki be-adabi karo na hurmat wale mahinon ki gustakhi karo. Lehaza har oont, gaye jo qurbani ke liye muqarrar kar diya jaye, woh badan mein dakhil hai. Go baaz logon ne sirf oont ko hi badan kaha hai lekin sahih yeh hai ke oont toh hai hi, gaye bhi is mein shamil hai. Hadith mein hai ke jis tarah oont saat admiyon ki taraf se qurban ho sakta hai isi tarah gaye bhi. Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) se Sahih Muslim Sharif mein riwayat hai ke hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke hum oont mein saat shareek ho jayen aur gaye mein bhi saat aadmi shirkat kar lein. Imam Ishaq bin Rahuyah wagaira toh farmate hain in dono janwaron mein das-das aadmi shareek ho sakte hain, Musnad Ahmad aur Sunan Nasai mein aisi hadith bhi aayi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Phir farmaya in janwaron mein tumhara ukhrawi nafa hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Baqra Eid wale din insan ka koi amal Allah ke nazdeek qurbani se zyada pasandida nahin. Janwar Qayamat ke din apne seengon, khuron aur baalon samet insan ki nekiyon mein pesh kiya jayega. Yaad rakho qurbani ke khoon ka qatra zameen par girne se pehle Allah ke haan pahunch jata hai, pas thande dil se qurbaniyan karo (Ibn Majah, Tirmidhi). Hazrat Sufyan Thawri (R.H) toh qarz utha kar bhi qurbani kiya karte the aur logon ke daryaft karne par farmate ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai is mein tumhara bhala hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain kisi kharch ka fazl Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek ba-nisbat us kharch ke jo Baqra Eid wale din ki qurbani par kiya jaye hargiz afzal nahin (Daraqutni). Pas Allah farmata hai tumhare liye in janwaron mein sawab hai, nafa hai, zaroorat ke waqt doodh pee sakte ho, sawar ho sakte ho, phir in ki qurbani ke waqt apna naam padhne ki hidayat karta hai. Hazrat Jabir (R.A) farmate hain main ne Eid-ul-Adha ki namaz Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath padhi, namaz se faraghat paate hi samne mendha laya gaya jise aap ne dua (Bismillahi Wallahu Akbar) padh kar zibah kiya phir kaha ae Allah yeh meri taraf se hai aur meri ummat mein se jo qurbani na kar sake us ki taraf se hai (Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi). Farmate hain Eid wale din aap ke paas do mendhe laye gaye, unhein qibla rukh kar ke aap ne dua (Wajjahtu wajhiya lillazi fataras-samawati wal-ardi hanifan wa ma ana minal mushrikin, inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi Rabbil Aalamin, la sharika lahu wa bizalika umirtu wa ana awwalul muslimin, Allahumma minka wa laka an Muhammadin wa ummatihi) padh kar Bismillahi Wallahu Akbar keh kar zibah kar dala.

Hazrat Abu Rafi R.A farmate hain ke qurbani ke mauqe par Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) do mendhe mote mote taze tayyar umda bade singon wale chitkabre kharidte, jab namaz padh kar khutbe se faraghat paate ek janwar aap ke paas laya jata aap wahin eidgah mein hi khud apne hath se use zibah karte aur farmate Allah Ta'ala yeh meri sari ummat ki taraf se hai jo bhi tauheed-o-sunnat ka gawah hai phir dusra janwar hazir kiya jata jise zibah kar ke farmate yeh Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Aal-e-Muhammad ki taraf se hai phir dono ka gosht maskeenon ko bhi dete aur aap aur aap ke ghar wale bhi khate. (Ahmad, Ibn Majah). Sawaf ke ma'ani Ibn Abbas R.A ne oont ko teen pairon par khada kar ke us ka bayan hath bandh kar dua (Bismillah wallahu Akbar la ilaha illallahu Allahumma minka wa laka) padh kar use nahr karne ke kiye hain. Hazrat Ibn Umar R.A ne ek shakhs ko dekha ke us ne apne oont ko qurbani karne ke liye bithaya hai to aap ne farmaya ise khada kar de aur us ka pair bandh kar use nahr kar yahi sunnat hai Abul Qasim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki. Hazrat Jabir R.A farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke sahaba oont ka ek paon bandh kar teen paon par khada kar ke hi nahr karte the. (Abu Dawood). Hazrat Salim bin Abdullah R.A ne Sulaiman bin Abdul Malik se farmaya tha ke bayin taraf se nahr kiya karo. Hajjat-ul-Wida ka bayan karte hue Hazrat Jabir R.A farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tressath oont apne dast-e-mubarak se nahr kiye aap ke hath mein harba tha jis se aap zakhmi kar rahe the. Ibn Masood R.A ki qirat mein sawafin hai yani khade kar ke paon bandh kar. Sawaf ke ma'ani khalis ke bhi kiye gaye hain yani jis tarah jahiliyat ke zamane mein Allah ke sath dusron ko bhi sharik karte the tum na karo, sirf Allah Wahid ke naam par hi qurbaniyan karo. Phir jab yeh zameen par gir paden yani nahr ho jayen thande pad jayen to khud khao auron ko bhi khilao neza marte hi tukde kaatne shuru na karo jab tak rooh na nikal jaye aur thanda na pad jaye. Chunancha ek hadith mein bhi aaya hai ke roohon ke nikalne mein jaldi na karo. Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne har cheez ke sath sulook karna likh diya hai dushmanon ko maidan-e-jang mein qatl karte waqt bhi nek sulook rakho aur janwaron ko zibah karte waqt bhi achi tarah se narmi ke sath zibah karo chhuri tez kar liya karo aur janwar ko takleef na diya karo. Farman hai ke janwar mein jab tak jaan hai aur us ke jism ka koi hissa kaat liya jaye to us ka khana haram hai. (Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi). Phir farmaya ise khud khao, ba'az salaf to farmate hain yeh khana mubah hai. Imam Malik R.H farmate hain mustahab hai aur log kehte hain wajib hai. Aur maskeenon ko bhi do khwah woh gharon mein baithne wale hon khwah woh dar-ba-dar sawal karne wale. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke qani' to woh hai jo sabr se ghar mein baitha rahe aur mu'tarr woh hai jo sawal to na kare lekin apni aajizi maskeeni ka izhar kare. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke qani' woh hai jo maskeen ho aane jane wala.

Aur Mu'tar se murad dost aur natwan log aur woh padosi jo go maaldar hon lekin tumhare yahan jo aaye jaye use woh dekhte hon. Woh bhi hain jo tama' rakhte hon aur woh bhi jo ameer faqeer majood hon. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Qani' se murad Ahl-e-Makkah hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ka farman hai ke Qani' se murad toh sail hai kyunke woh apna hath sawal ke liye daraz karta hai. Aur Mu'tar se murad woh jo her-pher kare ke kuch mil jaye. Baaz logon ka khayal hai ke qurbani ke gosht ke teen hisse karne chahiye. Tihai apne khane ko, tihai doston ke dene ko, tihai sadqa karne ko. Hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain main ne tumhein qurbani ke gosht ko jama karke rakhne se mana farmadiya tha ke teen din se zyada tak na roka jaye ab main ijazat deta hoon ke khao jama karo jis tarah chaho. Aur riwayat mein hai ke khao jama karo aur sadqa karo. Aur riwayat mein hai khao aur khilao aur rah-e-Lillah do. Baaz log kehte hain qurbani karne wala aadha gosht aap khaye aur baqi sadqa karde kyunke Quran ne farmaya hai khud khao aur mohtaj faqeer ko khilao. Aur hadith mein bhi hai ke khao, jama, zakheera karo aur rah-e-Lillah do. Ab jo shakhs apni qurbani ka sara gosht khud hi kha jaye toh ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke us par kuch harj nahin. Baaz kehte hain us par waisi hi qurbani ya us ki qeemat ki adaigi hai, baaz kehte hain aadhi qeemat de, baaz aadha gosht. Baaz kehte hain us ke ajza mein se chote se chote juz ki qeemat us ke zimme hai baqi maaf hai. Khaal ke bare mein Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hadith hai ke khao aur fi-Lillah do aur us ke chamron se faida uthao lekin unhein becho nahin. Baaz ulama ne bechne ki rukhsat di hai. Baaz kehte hain gareebon mein taqseem kardiye jayen. (Masla) Bara bin Aazib (R.A) kehte hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya sab se pehle hamein is din namaz-e-Eid ada karni chahiye phir laut kar qurbaniyan karni chahiyein jo aisa kare us ne sunnat ki adaigi ki. Aur jis ne namaz se pehle hi qurbani karli us ne goya apne walon ke liye gosht jama karliya use qurbani se koi lagao nahin (Bukhari, Muslim). Isi liye Imam Shafi'i (R.H) aur ulama ki ek jamaat ka khayal hai ke qurbani ka awwal waqt us waqt hota hai jab suraj nikal aaye aur itna waqt guzar jaye ke namaz ho le aur do khutbe ho lein. Imam Ahmad (R.H) ke nazdeek us ke baad ka itna waqt bhi ke Imam zibah karle. Kyunke Sahih Muslim mein hai Imam jab tak qurbani na kare tum qurbani na karo. Imam Abu Hanifa (R.H) ke nazdeek toh gaon walon par Eid ki namaz hi nahin is liye kehte hain ke woh tulu-e-fajr ke baad hi qurbani kar sakte hain, haan shehri log jab tak Imam namaz se farigh na ho le qurbani na karein, Wallahu A'lam. Phir yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke sirf Eid wale din hi qurbani karna mashroo hai aur qaul hai ke shehar walon ke liye toh yahi hai kyunke yahan qurbaniyan aasani se mil jati hain. Lekin gaon walon ke liye Eid ka din aur us ke baad ke Ayyam-e-Tashreeq.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke daswein aur gyarhwein tareekh sab ke liye qurbani ki hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Eid ke baad ke do din. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Eid ka din aur us ke baad ke teen din jo Ayyam-e-Tashreeq ke hain. Imam Shafi'i (R.H) ka mazhab yahi hai kyunke Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'im (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Ayyam-e-Tashreeq sab qurbani ke hain (Ahmad, Ibn-e-Hibban). Kaha gaya hai ke qurbani ke din Zil-Hajj ke khatme tak hain lekin yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Phir farmata hai ke isi wajah se hum ne in janwaron ko tumhara farman-bardar aur zer-e-asar kar diya hai ke tum chaho sawari lo, jab chaho doodh nikal lo, jab chaho zibah karke gosht kha lo. Jaise Surah Yaseen mein aayat (Awalam yarau) se (Afala tashkurun) tak bayan hua hai. Yahi farman yahan hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki is ne'amat ka shukr ada karo aur nashukri, na-qadri na karo.

Qurbani par Allah Ta'ala ki kibriyai bayan karo. Irshad hota hai ke qurbaniyon ke waqt Allah ka naam barai se liya jaye. Isi liye qurbaniyan muqarrar hui hain ke Khaliq-o-Raziq use mana jaye na ke qurbaniyon ke gosht-o-khoon se Allah ko koi nafa hota ho. Allah Ta'ala sari makhlooq se ghani aur kul bandon se beniaz hai. Jahiliyat ki bewakoofiyon mein ek yeh bhi thi ke qurbani ke janwar ka gosht apne buton ke samne rakh dete the aur un par khoon ka chheenta dete the. Yeh bhi dastoor tha ke Baitullah Sharif par qurbani ke khoon chhirakte, musalman ho kar Sahaba R.A ne aisa karne ke bare mein sawal kiya jis par yeh aayat utri ke Allah toh taqwa ko dekhta hai isi ko qabool farmata hai aur isi par badla inayat farmata hai. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhari sooraton ko nahin dekhta na uski nazrein tumhare maal par hain balkeh uski nigahain tumhare dilon par aur tumhare aamal par hain. Aur hadith mein hai ke khairat-o-sadaqa sail ke haath mein pare us se pehle Allah ke haath mein chala jata hai. Qurbani ke janwar ke khoon ka qatra zameen par tapke us se pehle Allah ke haan pahunch jata hai. Iska matlab yahi hai ke khoon ka qatra alag hote hi qurbani maqbool ho jati hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aamir Sha'bi se qurbani ki khalon ki nisbat poocha gaya toh farmaya Allah ko gosht-o-khoon nahin pahunchta agar chaho bech do, agar chaho khud rakh lo, agar chaho rah-e-Lillah de do. Isi liye Allah Ta'ala ne in janwaron ko tumhare qabze mein diya hai, ke tum Allah ke deen aur uski shariat ki rah pa kar uski marzi ke kaam karo aur namarzi ke kamon se ruk jao. Aur uski azmat-o-kibriyai bayan karo. Jo log nek-kar hain, hudood-e-Allah ke paband hain, shariat ke aamil hain, rasoolon ki sadaqat tasleem karte hain woh mustahiq-e-mubarakbad aur laiq-e-khushkhabri hain. (Masla) Imam Abu Hanifa, Malik, Thauri ka qaul hai ke jis ke paas nisab-e-zakat jitna maal ho us par qurbani wajib hai. Imam Abu Hanifa ke nazdeek yeh shart bhi hai ke woh apne ghar mein muqeem ho. Chunancha ek sahih hadith mein hai ke jise wus'at ho aur qurbani na kare toh woh hamari eidgah ke qareeb bhi na aaye. Is riwayat mein gharabat hai aur Imam Ahmad R.H ise munkar batate hain. Ibn-e-Umar R.A farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ barabar das saal qurbani karte rahe. (Tirmidhi) Imam Shafi R.H aur Hazrat Ahmad R.H ka mazhab hai ke qurbani wajib-o-farz nahin balkeh mustahab hai. Kyunke hadith mein aaya hai ke maal mein zakat ke siwa aur koi farziyat nahin. Yeh bhi riwayat pehle bayan ho chuki hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apni tamam ummat ki taraf se qurbani ki pas wujoob saqit ho gaya. Hazrat Abu Shuraiha R.H farmate hain main Hazrat Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Umar R.A ke pados mein rehta tha. Yeh dono buzurg qurbani nahin karte the is dar se ke log unki iqtida karenge. Baaz log kehte hain qurbani sunnat-e-kifaya hai, jab ke mohalle mein se ya gali mein se ya ghar mein se kisi ek ne kar li baqi sab ne aisa na kiya. Is liye ke maqsood sirf shiar ka zahir karna hai.

Tirmidhi waghera mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne maidan-e-Arafat mein farmaya har ghar walon par har saal qurbani hai aur 'Atirah hai, jaante ho 'Atirah kya hai? Wohi jise tum Rajabiyah kehte ho. Is ki sanad mein kalam kiya gaya hai. Hazrat Abu Ayyub (R.A) farmate hain Sahaba (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki maujudgi mein apne poore ghar ki taraf se ek bakri rah-e-Lillah zibah kar diya karte the aur khud bhi khate, auron ko bhi khilate. Phir logon ne is mein woh kar liya jo tum dekh rahe ho. (Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah). Hazrat Abdullah bin Hisham apni aur apne tamam ghar walon ki taraf se ek bakri ki qurbani kiya karte the. (Bukhari). Ab qurbani ke janwar ki umr ka bayan mulahiza ho. Sahih Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain na zibah karo magar musinnah, bajuz is surat ke ke woh tum par bhari pad jaye to phir bher ka bacha bhi chhe mah ka zibah kar sakte ho. Zuhri to kehte hain ke jaza'ah yani chhe mah ka koi janwar qurbani mein kaam hi nahin aa sakta aur is ke bilmuqabil Auza'i ka mazhab hai ke har janwar ka jaza'ah kafi hai. Lekin yeh dono qaul ifrat wale hain. Jamhoor ka mazhab yeh hai ke oont, gaye, bakri to woh jaiz hai jo thani ho. Aur bher ka chhe mah ka bhi jaiz hai. Oont to thani hota hai jab panch saal poore karke chhatte mein lag jaye. Aur gaye jab do saal poore karke teesre mein lag jaye aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke teen guzar kar chauthe mein lag gaya ho. Aur bakri ka thani woh hai jo do saal guzar chuka ho aur jaza'ah kehte hain use jo saal bhar ka ho gaya ho aur kaha gaya hai jo das mah ka ho. Ek qaul hai jo aath mah ka ho, ek qaul hai jo chhe mah ka ho, is se kam muddat ka koi qaul nahin. Is se kam umr wale ko hamal kehte hain. Jab tak ke us ki peeth par baal khade hon aur baal let jayein aur dono janib jhuk jayein to use jaza'ah kaha jata hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Allah Ta'ala apni taraf se khabar de raha hai ke jo us ke banday us par bharosa rakhein us ki taraf jhuktay rahein unhein woh apni amaan naseeb farmata hai, shareeron ki buraiyan dushmanon ki badiyan khud hi un se door kar deta hai, apni madad un par nazil farmata hai, apni hifazat mein unhein rakhta hai. Jaisay farman hai aayat (ALAYSA ALLAHU BIKAFIN 'ABDAHU WA YUKHAWWIFUNAKA BILLADHINA MIN DUNIHI WA MAN YUDLILILLAHU FAMA LAHU MIN HADIN) (Surah Az-Zumar: 36) yani kya Allah apne banday ko kaafi nahin? Aur aayat mein (WA MAN YATAWAKKAL 'ALALLAHI FAHUWA HASBUHU INNALLAHA BALIGHU AMRIHI QAD JA'ALALLAHU LIKULLI SHAY'IN QADRA) (Surah At-Talaq: 3) jo Allah par bharosa rakhay Allah aap usay kaafi hai al-kh, dagha baaz nashukray Allah ki mohabbat se mehroom hain apne ahd-o-paiman pooray na karne walay Allah ki na'amaton ke munkir Allah ke pyaar se door hain.

Hukm-e-Jihad sadir hua. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) kehte hain jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke as-haab Madine se bhi nikale jane lage aur kuffar-e-Makkah se charh dore tab jihad ki ijazat ki yeh aayat utri. Bohat se salaf se manqool hai ke jihad ki yeh pehli aayat hai jo Quran mein utri. Isi se baaz buzurgon ne istidlal kiya hai ke yeh Surah Madani hai. Jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah Sharif se hijrat ki, Abu Bakr (R.A) ki zaban se nikla ke afsos! In kuffar ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko watan se nikala, yaqeenan yeh tabah honge. Phir yeh aayat utri to Siddiq (R.A) ne jaan liya ke jang ho kar rahegi. Allah apne momin bandon ki madad par qadir hai. Agar chahe to be-lare bhare unhein ghalib kar de lekin woh aazmana chahta hai, isi liye hukm diya ke in kuffar ki gardanein maro. Al-kh, aur aayat mein hai, farmaya aayat (QATILUHUM YU'AZZIBHUMULLAHU BI-AYDIKUM WA YUKHZIHIM WA YANSURKUM 'ALAYHIM WA YASHFI SUDURA QAWMIN MU'MININ) (9. At-Tawbah: 14). In se laro, Allah unhein tumhare hathon saza de ga aur ruswa kare ga aur un par tumhein ghalib kare ga aur mominon ke hosle nikalne ka mauqa de ga ke un ke kaleje thande ho jayen, sath hi jise chahe ga taufiq-e-tawbah de ga, Allah ilm-o-hikmat wala hai. Aur aayat mein hai (AM HASIBTUM AN TUTRAKU WA LAMMA YA'LAMILLAHULLAZINA JAHADU MINKUM WA LAM YATTAKHIZU MIN DUNI-LLAHI WA LA RASULIHI WA LAL MU'MININA WALIJAH, WALLAHU KHABIRUM BIMA TA'MALUN) (9. At-Tawbah: 16). Yani kya tum ne yeh soch rakha hai ke tum chor diye jaoge halankeh ab tak to woh khul kar samne nahin aaye jo mujahid hain, Allah, Rasool aur musalmanon ke siwa kisi se dosti aur yaganat nahin karte. Samajh lo ke Allah tumhare a'maal se ba-khabar hai. Aur aayat mein hai, kya tum ne yeh guman kiya hai ke tum jannat mein chale jaoge halankeh ab tak mujahideen aur sabireen dusron se mumtaz nahin huye. Aur aayat mein farmaya hai aayat (WA LANABLUWANNAKUM HATTA NA'LAMAL MUJAHIDINA MINKUM WAS-SABIRINA WA NABLUWA AKHBARAKUM) (47. Muhammad: 31). Hum tumhein yaqeenan aazmayenge yahan tak ke tum mein se ghazi aur sabr karne wale hamare samne numaya ho jayen. Is bare mein aur bhi bohat si aayatein hain. Phir farmaya Allah un ki madad par qadir hai. Aur yahi hua bhi ke Allah ne apne lashkar ko duniya par ghalib kar diya. Jihad ko shariat ne jis waqt mashroo farmaya woh waqt bhi is ke liye bilkul munasib aur nihayat theek tha. Jab tak Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Makkah mein rahe, musalman bohat hi kamzor the, tadaad mein bhi das ke muqable mein ek ba-mushkil baithta. Chunancha jab Lailatul-Aqaba mein ansariyon ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath par bai'at ki to unhon ne kaha ke agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hukm dein to is waqt Mina mein jitne mushrikeen jama hain un par shab-khoon maren. Lekin aap ne farmaya mujhe abhi is ka hukm nahin diya gaya. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh buzurg sirf isi 800 se kuch upar the.

Jab mushrikon ki baghawat barh gayi, jab woh sarkashi mein had se guzar gaye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sakht eizayein dete dete ab aap ke qatl karne ke darpay ho gaye, aap ko jalawatan karne ke mansoobay ganthne lage. Isi tarah Sahaba-e-Kiram par museebaton ke pahar tor diye. Be-baini-o-dogosh watan, maal asbaab, apnon ghairon ko chor kar jahan jis ka mauqa bana ghabra kar chal diya, kuch toh Habsha pahunche kuch Madine gaye. Yahan tak ke khud Aftab-e-Risalat ka tulu bhi Madine Sharif mein hua. Ahl-e-Madina Muhammadi jhande tale josh-o-kharosh se jama, lashkari surat murattab ho gayi. Kuch Musalman ek jhande tale dikhayi dene lage, qadam tikane ki jagah mil gayi. Ab dushmanan-e-Deen se Jihad ke ahkaam nazil hue toh pas sab se pehle yahi aayat utri. Is mein bayan farmaya gaya ke yeh Musalman mazloom hain, un ke ghar-baar un se chheen liye gaye hain, be-wajah ghar se be-ghar kar diye gaye hain, Makkah se nikal diye gaye, Madine mein be-saro-samani mein pahunche. Un ka jurm bajuz is ke siwa na tha ke sirf Allah ke parastar thay, Rabb ko ek maante thay, apne Parwardigar sirf Allah ko jaante thay. Yeh istisna munqata hai, go mushrikeen ke nazdeek toh yeh amr itna bara jurm hai jo hargiz kisi surat se maafi ke qabil nahin. Farman hai aayat (Yukhrijuna ar-Rasula wa iyyakum an tu'minu billahi Rabbikum, in kuntum kharajtum jihadan fi sabili wabtigha'a mardati) (Surah Al-Mumtahanah: 1) tumhein aur hamare Rasool ko sirf is bina par nikalte hain ke tum Allah par iman rakhte ho jo tumhara haqeeqi Parwardigar hai. Khandaqon walon ke qisse mein farmaya aayat (Wa ma naqamu minhum illa an yu'minu billahil-Azizil-Hamid) yani darasal un ka koi qasoor na tha siwaye is ke ke woh Allah Ta'ala Ghalib, Meharban, Zi-Ehsan par iman laye thay. Musalman Sahaba khandaq khodte hue apne rajaz mein keh rahe thay: Sher (Allahumma law la anta ma-htadaina, wa la tasaddaqna wa la sallaina, fa-anzilanna sakinatan 'alaina, wa thabbitil-aqdama in laqaina, innal-ula qad baghaw 'alaina, idha aradu fitnatan abaina). Khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi un ki muwafiqat mein thay aur qafiya ka aakhri harf aap bhi un ke sath ada karte aur 'abaina' kehte hue khoob buland aawaz karte. Phir farmata hai agar Allah Ta'ala ek ka ilaj dusre se na karta, agar har seer par sawa seer na hota toh zameen mein shar-o-fasaad mach jata, har qawi har kamzor ko nigal jata. Isai aabidon ke chote ibadat khanon ko 'Sawami' kehte hain. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke Sabi mazhab ke logon ke ibadat khanon ka naam hai aur baaz kehte hain Majusion ke aatish kadon ko Sawami kehte hain. Maqamil kehte hain yeh woh ghar hain jo raston par hote hain. 'Biya' un se bare makanat hote hain, yeh bhi Nasraniyon ke aabidon ke ibadat khane hote hain. Baaz kehte hain yeh Yahudiyon ke kanisa hain. 'Salawat' ke bhi ek ma'ani toh yahi kiye gaye hain. Baaz kehte hain murad girja hain. Baaz ka qaul hai Sabi logon ka ibadat khana.

Raston par jo ibadat ke ghar Ahl-e-Kitab ke hon unhein salawat kaha jata hai aur musalmanon ke hon unhein masajid. Feeha ki zameer ka marja masajid hai is liye ke sab se pehle yahi lafz hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad yeh sab jaghein hain yani tarik-ud-dunya logon ke sawame, nasraniyon ke biya, yahudiyon ke salawat aur musalmanon ki masajid jin mein Allah ka naam khoob liya jata hai. Baaz ulama ka bayan hai ke is ayat mein aqal se aksar ki taraf ki taraqqi ki sanat rakhi gayi hai, pas sab se zyada abad sab se bada ibadat ghar jahan ke abidon ka qasd sahih, niyat nek, amal-e-saleh hai woh masajid hain. Phir farmaya Allah apne deen ke madadgaron ka khud madadgar hai jaise farman hai ayat (Yaa-ayyuhallazina aamanu in tansurullaha yansurkum wa yusabbit aqdamakum) (Surah Muhammad: 7) yani agar ae musalmano! tum Allah ke deen ki imdad karoge to Allah tumhari madad farmaye ga aur tumhein sabit qadmi ata farmaye ga. Kuffar par afsos hai aur un ke aamal gharat hain. Phir apne do wasf bayan farmaye qawi hona ke sari makhlooq ko paida kar diya, izzat wala hona ke sab us ke matahat, har ek us ke samne zaleel-o-past, sab us ki madad ke mohtaj, woh sab se beniyaaz, jise woh madad de woh ghalib, jis par se us ki madad hat jaye woh maghloob. Farmata hai ayat (Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna li-ibadinal mursaleen) (Surah As-Saffat: 171) yani hum ne to pehle se hi apne rasoolon se wada kar liya hai ke un ki yaqeeni taur par madad ki jaye gi aur yeh ke hamara lashkar hi ghalib aaye ga. Aur ayat mein hai ayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli innallaha qawiyyun aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadila: 21) Khuda keh chuka hai ke main aur mera rasool ghalib hain. Beshak Allah Ta'ala quwwat-o-izzat wala hai.

Hukm-e-Jihad sadir hua. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) kehte hain jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aap ke as-haab Madine se bhi nikale jane lage aur kuffar-e-Makkah se charh dore tab jihad ki ijazat ki yeh aayat utri. Bohat se salaf se manqool hai ke jihad ki yeh pehli aayat hai jo Quran mein utri. Isi se baaz buzurgon ne istidlal kiya hai ke yeh Surah Madani hai. Jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah Sharif se hijrat ki, Abu Bakr (R.A) ki zaban se nikla ke afsos! In kuffar ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko watan se nikala, yaqeenan yeh tabah honge. Phir yeh aayat utri to Siddiq (R.A) ne jaan liya ke jang ho kar rahegi. Allah apne momin bandon ki madad par qadir hai. Agar chahe to be-lare bhare unhein ghalib kar de lekin woh aazmana chahta hai, isi liye hukm diya ke in kuffar ki gardanein maro. Al-kh, aur aayat mein hai, farmaya aayat (QATILUHUM YU'AZZIBHUMULLAHU BI-AYDIKUM WA YUKHZIHIM WA YANSURKUM 'ALAYHIM WA YASHFI SUDURA QAWMIN MU'MININ) (9. At-Tawbah: 14). In se laro, Allah unhein tumhare hathon saza de ga aur ruswa kare ga aur un par tumhein ghalib kare ga aur mominon ke hosle nikalne ka mauqa de ga ke un ke kaleje thande ho jayen, sath hi jise chahe ga taufiq-e-tawbah de ga, Allah ilm-o-hikmat wala hai. Aur aayat mein hai (AM HASIBTUM AN TUTRAKU WA LAMMA YA'LAMILLAHULLAZINA JAHADU MINKUM WA LAM YATTAKHIZU MIN DUNI-LLAHI WA LA RASULIHI WA LAL MU'MININA WALIJAH, WALLAHU KHABIRUM BIMA TA'MALUN) (9. At-Tawbah: 16). Yani kya tum ne yeh soch rakha hai ke tum chor diye jaoge halankeh ab tak to woh khul kar samne nahin aaye jo mujahid hain, Allah, Rasool aur musalmanon ke siwa kisi se dosti aur yaganat nahin karte. Samajh lo ke Allah tumhare a'maal se ba-khabar hai. Aur aayat mein hai, kya tum ne yeh guman kiya hai ke tum jannat mein chale jaoge halankeh ab tak mujahideen aur sabireen dusron se mumtaz nahin huye. Aur aayat mein farmaya hai aayat (WA LANABLUWANNAKUM HATTA NA'LAMAL MUJAHIDINA MINKUM WAS-SABIRINA WA NABLUWA AKHBARAKUM) (47. Muhammad: 31). Hum tumhein yaqeenan aazmayenge yahan tak ke tum mein se ghazi aur sabr karne wale hamare samne numaya ho jayen. Is bare mein aur bhi bohat si aayatein hain. Phir farmaya Allah un ki madad par qadir hai. Aur yahi hua bhi ke Allah ne apne lashkar ko duniya par ghalib kar diya. Jihad ko shariat ne jis waqt mashroo farmaya woh waqt bhi is ke liye bilkul munasib aur nihayat theek tha. Jab tak Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Makkah mein rahe, musalman bohat hi kamzor the, tadaad mein bhi das ke muqable mein ek ba-mushkil baithta. Chunancha jab Lailatul-Aqaba mein ansariyon ne Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath par bai'at ki to unhon ne kaha ke agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hukm dein to is waqt Mina mein jitne mushrikeen jama hain un par shab-khoon maren. Lekin aap ne farmaya mujhe abhi is ka hukm nahin diya gaya. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh buzurg sirf isi 800 se kuch upar the.

Jab mushrikon ki baghawat barh gayi, jab woh sarkashi mein had se guzar gaye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sakht eizayein dete dete ab aap ke qatl karne ke darpay ho gaye, aap ko jalawatan karne ke mansoobay ganthne lage. Isi tarah Sahaba-e-Kiram par museebaton ke pahar tor diye. Be-baini-o-dogosh watan, maal asbaab, apnon ghairon ko chor kar jahan jis ka mauqa bana ghabra kar chal diya, kuch toh Habsha pahunche kuch Madine gaye. Yahan tak ke khud Aftab-e-Risalat ka tulu bhi Madine Sharif mein hua. Ahl-e-Madina Muhammadi jhande tale josh-o-kharosh se jama, lashkari surat murattab ho gayi. Kuch Musalman ek jhande tale dikhayi dene lage, qadam tikane ki jagah mil gayi. Ab dushmanan-e-Deen se Jihad ke ahkaam nazil hue toh pas sab se pehle yahi aayat utri. Is mein bayan farmaya gaya ke yeh Musalman mazloom hain, un ke ghar-baar un se chheen liye gaye hain, be-wajah ghar se be-ghar kar diye gaye hain, Makkah se nikal diye gaye, Madine mein be-saro-samani mein pahunche. Un ka jurm bajuz is ke siwa na tha ke sirf Allah ke parastar thay, Rabb ko ek maante thay, apne Parwardigar sirf Allah ko jaante thay. Yeh istisna munqata hai, go mushrikeen ke nazdeek toh yeh amr itna bara jurm hai jo hargiz kisi surat se maafi ke qabil nahin. Farman hai aayat (Yukhrijuna ar-Rasula wa iyyakum an tu'minu billahi Rabbikum, in kuntum kharajtum jihadan fi sabili wabtigha'a mardati) (Surah Al-Mumtahanah: 1) tumhein aur hamare Rasool ko sirf is bina par nikalte hain ke tum Allah par iman rakhte ho jo tumhara haqeeqi Parwardigar hai. Khandaqon walon ke qisse mein farmaya aayat (Wa ma naqamu minhum illa an yu'minu billahil-Azizil-Hamid) yani darasal un ka koi qasoor na tha siwaye is ke ke woh Allah Ta'ala Ghalib, Meharban, Zi-Ehsan par iman laye thay. Musalman Sahaba khandaq khodte hue apne rajaz mein keh rahe thay: Sher (Allahumma law la anta ma-htadaina, wa la tasaddaqna wa la sallaina, fa-anzilanna sakinatan 'alaina, wa thabbitil-aqdama in laqaina, innal-ula qad baghaw 'alaina, idha aradu fitnatan abaina). Khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi un ki muwafiqat mein thay aur qafiya ka aakhri harf aap bhi un ke sath ada karte aur 'abaina' kehte hue khoob buland aawaz karte. Phir farmata hai agar Allah Ta'ala ek ka ilaj dusre se na karta, agar har seer par sawa seer na hota toh zameen mein shar-o-fasaad mach jata, har qawi har kamzor ko nigal jata. Isai aabidon ke chote ibadat khanon ko 'Sawami' kehte hain. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke Sabi mazhab ke logon ke ibadat khanon ka naam hai aur baaz kehte hain Majusion ke aatish kadon ko Sawami kehte hain. Maqamil kehte hain yeh woh ghar hain jo raston par hote hain. 'Biya' un se bare makanat hote hain, yeh bhi Nasraniyon ke aabidon ke ibadat khane hote hain. Baaz kehte hain yeh Yahudiyon ke kanisa hain. 'Salawat' ke bhi ek ma'ani toh yahi kiye gaye hain. Baaz kehte hain murad girja hain. Baaz ka qaul hai Sabi logon ka ibadat khana.

Raston par jo ibadat ke ghar Ahl-e-Kitab ke hon unhein salawat kaha jata hai aur musalmanon ke hon unhein masajid. Feeha ki zameer ka marja masajid hai is liye ke sab se pehle yahi lafz hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke murad yeh sab jaghein hain yani tarik-ud-dunya logon ke sawame, nasraniyon ke biya, yahudiyon ke salawat aur musalmanon ki masajid jin mein Allah ka naam khoob liya jata hai. Baaz ulama ka bayan hai ke is ayat mein aqal se aksar ki taraf ki taraqqi ki sanat rakhi gayi hai, pas sab se zyada abad sab se bada ibadat ghar jahan ke abidon ka qasd sahih, niyat nek, amal-e-saleh hai woh masajid hain. Phir farmaya Allah apne deen ke madadgaron ka khud madadgar hai jaise farman hai ayat (Yaa-ayyuhallazina aamanu in tansurullaha yansurkum wa yusabbit aqdamakum) (Surah Muhammad: 7) yani agar ae musalmano! tum Allah ke deen ki imdad karoge to Allah tumhari madad farmaye ga aur tumhein sabit qadmi ata farmaye ga. Kuffar par afsos hai aur un ke aamal gharat hain. Phir apne do wasf bayan farmaye qawi hona ke sari makhlooq ko paida kar diya, izzat wala hona ke sab us ke matahat, har ek us ke samne zaleel-o-past, sab us ki madad ke mohtaj, woh sab se beniyaaz, jise woh madad de woh ghalib, jis par se us ki madad hat jaye woh maghloob. Farmata hai ayat (Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna li-ibadinal mursaleen) (Surah As-Saffat: 171) yani hum ne to pehle se hi apne rasoolon se wada kar liya hai ke un ki yaqeeni taur par madad ki jaye gi aur yeh ke hamara lashkar hi ghalib aaye ga. Aur ayat mein hai ayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli innallaha qawiyyun aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadila: 21) Khuda keh chuka hai ke main aur mera rasool ghalib hain. Beshak Allah Ta'ala quwwat-o-izzat wala hai.

Pabandi-e-Ahkamat ki takeed. Hazrat Usman (R.A) farmate hain yeh aayat hamare bare mein utri hai. Hum be-sabab kharij-e-watan kiye gaye thay, phir hamein Allah ne saltanat di, hum ne namaz-o-roza ki pabandi ki, bhale ahkam diye aur burai se rokna jaari rakha. Pas yeh aayat mere aur mere sathiyon ke bare mein hai. Abul Aliyah (R.H) farmate hain murad is se Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hain. Khalifa-e-Rasool Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) ne apne khutbe mein is aayat ki tilawat farma kar farmaya is mein badshahon ka bayan hi nahin balkay badshah-o-ra'aya donon ka bayan hai. Badshah par to yeh hai ke huqooq-e-Ilahi tum se barabar le, Allah ke haq ki kotahi ke bare mein tumhein pakre aur ek ka haq dusre se dilwaye aur jahan tak mumkin ho tumhein Sirat-e-Mustaqeem samjhata rahe. Tum par is ka yeh haq hai ke zahir-o-batin khushi khushi is ki ita'at guzari karo. Atiyah (R.H) farmate hain isi aayat ka mazmoon aayat (Wa'adallahu-l-lazina amanu minkum wa 'amilus-salihati layastakhlifannahum fil-ardi kamastakhlafal-lazina min qablihim) (Surah An-Nur: 55) mein hai. Kamon ka anjam Allah ke hath hai. Umda natija parhezgaron ka hoga. Har neki ka badla usi ke han hai.

Kafiron ki hujjat bazi bahut purani bimari hai. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli deta hai ke munkiron ka inkar aap ke sath koi nayi cheez nahin. Nuh (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se le kar Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) tak ke kul ambiya ka inkar kuffar barabar karte chale aaye hain. Dalail samne thay, haq samne tha lekin munkiron ne maan kar na mana. Main ne kafiron ko mohlat di ke yeh soch samajh lein, apne anjam par gaur kar lein. Lekin jab woh apni namak harami se baaz na aaye to aakhir-kar mere azabon mein giraftar hue, dekh le ke meri pakar kaisi be-panah sabit hui, kis qadar dardnak anjam hua. Salaf se manqool hai ke Firaun ke hukmrani ke da'we aur Allah ki pakar ke darmiyan chalis saal ka arsa tha. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala har zalim ko dheel deta hai phir jab pakarta hai to chhutkara nahin hota. Phir aap ne aayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ اَخْذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَآ اَخَذَ الْقُرٰي وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ۭ اِنَّ اَخْذَهٗٓ اَلِيْمٌ شَدِيْدٌ) (Surah Hud: 102) tilawat ki, phir farmaya ke kayi ek bastiyon wale zalimon ko jinhon ne rasoolon ki takzeeb ki thi hum ne garat kar diya. Jin ke mahlaat khandhar bane pare hain, ondhay giray hue hain, un ki manzilein veeran ho gayin, un ki abadiyan veeran ho gayin, un ke kunwein khali pare hain, jo kal tak abad thay aaj khali hain, un ke chuna gach mahal jo door se safed chamakte hue dikhayi dete thay, jo buland-o-bala aur pukhta thay woh aaj veeran pare hain, wahan ullu bol raha hai, un ki mazbooti unhein na bacha saki, un ki khubsurti aur payidari bekar sabit hui. Rabb ke azab ne tehas-nehas kar diya jaise farman hai aayat (اَيْنَ مَا تَكُوْنُوْا يُدْرِكْكُّمُ الْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِيْ بُرُوْجٍ مُّشَـيَّدَةٍ) (Surah An-Nisa: 78) yani go tum chuna gach pakkay qilon mein mehfooz ho lekin maut wahan bhi tumhein chhorne ki nahin. Kya woh khud zameen mein chalay phiray nahin ya kabhi gaur-o-fikr bhi nahin kiya ke kuch ibrat hasil hoti? Imam Ibn Abi Dunya Kitab-ut-Tafakkur wal-Ibar mein riwayat laye hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke paas wahi bheji ke ae Musa! lohay ki na'lain pehan kar, lohay ki lakri le kar zameen mein chal phir kar aasar-o-ibrat ko dekh, woh khatam na honge yahan tak ke teri lohay ki jootiyan tukray-tukray ho jayein aur lohay ki lakri bhi toot-phoot jaye. Isi kitab mein ba'az danishmandon ka qaul hai ke wa'z ke sath apne dil ko zinda kar. Aur gaur-o-fikr ke sath usay noorani kar aur zuhd aur duniya se bachne ke sath usay maar de aur yaqeen ke sath usay qawi kar le aur maut ke zikr se usay zaleel kar de aur fana ke yaqeen se usay sabr de. Duniya ki musibatein us ke samne rakh kar us ki aankhein khol de, zamane ki tangi usay dikha, usay dehshat-nak bana de, dinon ke ulat-pher usay samjha kar bedar kar de. Guzishta waqiyat se usay ibrat-nak bana. Aglon ke qissay usay suna kar hoshiyar rakh. Un ke shehron mein aur un ki sawaneh mein usay gaur-o-fikr karne ka aadi bana.

Aur dekh ke gunahgaron ke sath is ka mamla kya hua kis tarah woh loot-poot kar diye gaye. Pas yahan bhi yahi farman hai ke aglon ke waqiyat samne rakh kar dilon ko samajhdar banao un ki halakat ke sache afsane sun kar ibrat hasil karo. Sun lo aankhein hi andhi nahin hotin balkay sab se bura andha pan dil ka hai go aankhein sahih salim majood hon. Dil ke andhe pan ki wajah se na to ibrat hasil hoti hai na khair-o-shar ki tameez hoti hai. Abu Muhammad bin Jiyara Andalusi ne jin ka inteqal 510 Hijri mein hua hai is mazmoon ko apne chand ashaar mein khoob nibhaya hai woh farmate hain: Ae woh shakhs jo gunahon mein lazzat pa raha hai kya apne budhape aur nafs ki burai se bhi tu be-khabar hai? Agar nasihat asar nahin karti to kya dekhne sunne se bhi ibrat hasil nahin hoti? Sun le aankhein aur kaan apna kaam na karein to itna bura nahin jitna bura yeh hai ke waqiyat se sabaq na hasil kiya jaye. Yaad rakh na to duniya baqi rahe gi na aasman na suraj chand. Go ji na chahe magar duniya se tum ko ek roz badil-e-nakhwasta kooch karna hi pare ga. Kya ameer ho kya ghareeb kya shehri ho ya dehati.

Rabb ke azab ne tehas-nehas kar diya jaise farman hai aayat (اَيْنَ مَا تَكُوْنُوْا يُدْرِكْكُّمُ الْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِيْ بُرُوْجٍ مُّشَـيَّدَةٍ) (Surah An-Nisa: 78) yani go tum chuna gach pakkay qilon mein mehfooz ho lekin maut wahan bhi tumhein chhorne ki nahin. Kya woh khud zameen mein chalay phiray nahin ya kabhi gaur-o-fikr bhi nahin kiya ke kuch ibrat hasil hoti? Imam Ibn Abi Dunya Kitab-ut-Tafakkur wal-Ibar mein riwayat laye hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke paas wahi bheji ke ae Musa! lohay ki na'lain pehan kar, lohay ki lakri le kar zameen mein chal phir kar aasar-o-ibrat ko dekh, woh khatam na honge yahan tak ke teri lohay ki jootiyan tukray-tukray ho jayein aur lohay ki lakri bhi toot-phoot jaye. Isi kitab mein ba'az danishmandon ka qaul hai ke wa'z ke sath apne dil ko zinda kar. Aur gaur-o-fikr ke sath usay noorani kar aur zuhd aur duniya se bachne ke sath usay maar de aur yaqeen ke sath usay qawi kar le aur maut ke zikr se usay zaleel kar de aur fana ke yaqeen se usay sabr de. Duniya ki musibatein us ke samne rakh kar us ki aankhein khol de, zamane ki tangi usay dikha, usay dehshat-nak bana de, dinon ke ulat-pher usay samjha kar bedar kar de. Guzishta waqiyat se usay ibrat-nak bana. Aglon ke qissay usay suna kar hoshiyar rakh. Un ke shehron mein aur un ki sawaneh mein usay gaur-o-fikr karne ka aadi bana.

Aur dekh ke gunahgaron ke sath is ka mamla kya hua kis tarah woh loot-poot kar diye gaye. Pas yahan bhi yahi farman hai ke aglon ke waqiyat samne rakh kar dilon ko samajhdar banao un ki halakat ke sache afsane sun kar ibrat hasil karo. Sun lo aankhein hi andhi nahin hotin balkay sab se bura andha pan dil ka hai go aankhein sahih salim majood hon. Dil ke andhe pan ki wajah se na to ibrat hasil hoti hai na khair-o-shar ki tameez hoti hai. Abu Muhammad bin Jiyara Andalusi ne jin ka inteqal 510 Hijri mein hua hai is mazmoon ko apne chand ashaar mein khoob nibhaya hai woh farmate hain: Ae woh shakhs jo gunahon mein lazzat pa raha hai kya apne budhape aur nafs ki burai se bhi tu be-khabar hai? Agar nasihat asar nahin karti to kya dekhne sunne se bhi ibrat hasil nahin hoti? Sun le aankhein aur kaan apna kaam na karein to itna bura nahin jitna bura yeh hai ke waqiyat se sabaq na hasil kiya jaye. Yaad rakh na to duniya baqi rahe gi na aasman na suraj chand. Go ji na chahe magar duniya se tum ko ek roz badil-e-nakhwasta kooch karna hi pare ga. Kya ameer ho kya ghareeb kya shehri ho ya dehati.

Zara sabr, azab ka shauq pura hoga. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farma raha hai ke yeh mulhid kuffar Allah ko, uske Rasool ko aur Qayamat ke din ko jhutlane wale tujh se azab talab karne mein jaldi kar rahe hain ke jald in azabon ko kyun nahin barpa kar diya jata jin se hamain har waqt daraya dhamkaya ja raha hai. Chunancha woh Allah se bhi kehte thay ke Ilahi agar yeh teri taraf se haq hai to hum par aasman se sang-bari kar ya aur kisi tarah ka dard-naak azab bhej. Kehte thay ke hisab ke din se pehle hi hamara mamla saaf karde. Allah farmata hai yaad rakho Allah ka wada atal hai, Qayamat aur azab aakar hi rahenge. Auliya-e-Allah ki izzat aur aada-e-Allah ki zillat yaqeeni aur hokar rehne wali hai. Asma'i kehte hain main Abu Amr bin Ala ke paas tha ke Amr bin Ubaid aaya aur kehne laga ke ae Abu Amr kya Allah Ta'ala apne wade ka khilaf karta hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin, usne usi waqt azab ki ek aayat tilawat ki, is par aap ne farmaya kya tu ajami hai? Sun Arab mein wa'ad ka yani achi baat se wada-khilafi ko bura fe'l samjha jata hai lekin al-ee'ad ka yani saza ke ahkaam ka rad-o-badal ya maafi buri nahin samjhi jati balkay woh karam-o-rahm samjha jata hai. Dekho shayar kehta hai: (Fa-inni wa in au'adtuhu au wa'adtuhu, lamukhlifu ee'adi wa munjizu mau'idi) Main kisi ko saza kahun ya us se inaam ka wada karun, to yeh to ho sakta hai ke main apni dhamki ke khilaf kar jaun balkay qatan hargiz saza na dun lekin apna wada to zaroor pura karke hi rahunga. Al-garaz saza ka wada karke saza na karna yeh wada-khilafi nahin. Lekin rahmat-o-inaam ka wada karke phir rok lena yeh buri sifat hai jis se Allah ki zaat paak hai. Phir farmata hai ke ek ek din Allah ke nazdeek tumhare hazar hazar dinon ke barabar hai, yeh ba-aitibar uske hilm aur bardbari ke hai kyunke use ilm hai ke woh har waqt in ki giraft par qadir hai is liye ujlat kya hai? Go kitni hi se mohlat mil jaye, go kitni hi se rassi daraz ho jaye lekin jab chahega saans lene ki bhi mohlat na dega aur pakad lega. Isi liye uske baad hi farman hota hai bahut si bastiyon ke log zulm par kamar kase hue thay, main ne bhi chashm-poshi kar rakhi thi. Jab mast ho gaye to achanak giraft kar li, sab majboor hain, sab ko mere hi samne hazir hona hai, sab ka lautna meri hi taraf hai. Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain fuqra musalman maldar musalmanon se aadha din pehle jannat mein jayenge yani paanch sau baras pehle. Aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se pucha gaya aadhe din ki miqdar kya hai? Farmaya kya tu ne Quran nahin padha? Main ne kaha haan, to yahi aayat sunayi. Yani Allah ke haan ek din ek hazar saal ka hai. Abu Dawood ki Kitab-ul-Malahim ke aakhir mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe Allah Ta'ala ki zaat se umeed hai ke woh meri ummat ko aadhe din tak to zaroor mu'akhar rakhega. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) se pucha gaya aadha din kitne arsay ka hoga? Aap ne farmaya paanch sau saal ka.

Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ko parh kar farmane lage yeh un dinon mein se hain jin mein Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya (Ibn-e-Jarir). Balkeh Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ne Kitab-ur-Radd-e-Alal-Jahmiyah mein is baat ko khule lafz mein bayan kiya hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh aayat misl-e-aayat (Yudabbirul amra minas samaai ilal ardhi summa ya'ruju ilaihi fi yaumin kana miqdaruhu alfa sanatin mimma ta'uddun) (Surah As-Sajdah: 5) ke hai, yani Allah Ta'ala kaam ki tadbeer aasman se zameen ki taraf karta hai, phir us ki taraf charh jata hai. Ek hi din mein jis ki miqdar tumhari ginti ke aitbar se ek hazar saal ki hai. Imam Muhammad bin Sirin (R.H) ek nau-muslim Ahl-e-Kitab se naqal karte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen chhe din mein paida kiya aur ek din tere Rab ke nazdeek misl-e-ek hazar saal ke hai jo ginte ho. Allah ne duniya ki ajal chhe din ki ki hai, saatwein din Qayamat hai aur ek ek din misl-e-hazar hazar saal ke hai, pas chhe din toh guzar gaye aur ab tum saatwein din mein ho, ab toh bilkul us hamila ki tarah hai jo poore dinon mein ho aur na jaane kab bacha ho jaye.

Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is aayat ko parh kar farmane lage yeh un dinon mein se hain jin mein Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya (Ibn-e-Jarir). Balkeh Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) ne Kitab-ur-Radd-e-Alal-Jahmiyah mein is baat ko khule lafz mein bayan kiya hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh aayat misl-e-aayat (Yudabbirul amra minas samaai ilal ardhi summa ya'ruju ilaihi fi yaumin kana miqdaruhu alfa sanatin mimma ta'uddun) (Surah As-Sajdah: 5) ke hai, yani Allah Ta'ala kaam ki tadbeer aasman se zameen ki taraf karta hai, phir us ki taraf charh jata hai. Ek hi din mein jis ki miqdar tumhari ginti ke aitbar se ek hazar saal ki hai. Imam Muhammad bin Sirin (R.H) ek nau-muslim Ahl-e-Kitab se naqal karte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen chhe din mein paida kiya aur ek din tere Rab ke nazdeek misl-e-ek hazar saal ke hai jo ginte ho. Allah ne duniya ki ajal chhe din ki ki hai, saatwein din Qayamat hai aur ek ek din misl-e-hazar hazar saal ke hai, pas chhe din toh guzar gaye aur ab tum saatwein din mein ho, ab toh bilkul us hamila ki tarah hai jo poore dinon mein ho aur na jaane kab bacha ho jaye.

Ita'at-e-Ilahi se rokne walon ka hashr: Chunke kuffar azab manga karte the aur is ki jaldi machate rehte the, un ke jawab mein elan karaya ja raha hai ke logo! Main toh Allah ka bheja hua aya hoon ke tumhein Rabb ke azabon se jo tumhare aage hain chaukanna kar doon, tumhara hisab mere zimme nahin. Azab Allah ke bas mein hai, chahe ab laye chahe der se laye. Mujhe kya maloom ke tum mein kis ki qismat mein hidayat hai aur kaun Allah ki rahmat se mehroom rehne wala hai. Chahat Allah ki hi poori honi hai, hukumat usi ke hath hai, mukhtar aur karta dharta wahi hai, kisi ko us ke samne choon-chara ki majal nahin, woh bahut jald hisab lene wala hai. Meri haisiyat toh sirf ek agah karne wale ki hai. Jin ke dilon mein yaqeen-o-iman hai aur us ki shahadat un ke a'amal se bhi sabit hai, un ke kul gunah ma'afi ke laiq hain aur un ki kul nekiyan qadardani ke qabil hain. Rizq-e-Kareem se murad Jannat hai. Jo log auron ko bhi Allah ki rah se, ita'at-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se rokte hain woh jahannami hain, sakht azabon aur tez aag ke indhan hain, Allah hamein bachaye. Aur ayat mein hai ke aise kuffar ko un ke fasad ke badle azab par azab hain.

Shaitan ka tasarruf ghalat hai. Yahan par aksar mufassireen ne Gharaniq ka qissa naqal kiya hai aur yeh bhi ke is waqiye ki wajah se aksar Muhajireen-e-Habash yeh samajh kar ke mushrikeen-e-Makkah ab musalman ho gaye wapas Makkah aa gaye. Lekin yeh riwayat har sanad se mursal hai. Kisi sahih sanad se musnad marwi nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Chunancha Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah Shareef mein Surah An-Najm ki tilawat farmayi. Jab yeh aayatein aap parh rahe thay aayat (اَفَرَءَيْتُمُ اللّٰتَ وَالْعُزّٰى 19؀ۙ) (53-An-Najm: 19) to Shaitan ne aap ki zaban-e-mubarak par yeh alfaaz daale ke (Tilkal Gharaniqul 'Ula wa inna shafa'atahunna laturja). Pas mushrikeen khush ho gaye ke aaj to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamare maboodon ki tareef ki jo is se pehle aap ne kabhi nahin ki. Chunancha idhar Huzoor ne sajda kiya udhar woh sab bhi sajde mein gir pare. Is par yeh aayat utri. Ise Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne bhi riwayat kiya hai, yeh mursal hai. Musnad Bazzar mein bhi is ke zikr ke baad hai ke sirf isi sanad se hi yeh muttasilan marwi hai. Sirf Umayyah bin Khalid hi ise wasl karte hain, woh mashhoor thiqa hain. Yeh sirf tareeq-e-Kalbi se hi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne ise do sanadon se liya hai lekin dono mursal hain, Ibn-e-Jareer mein bhi mursal hai. Qatadah (R.H) kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke paas namaz parhte hue Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko oongh aa gayi aur Shaitan ne aap ki zaban par dala, Arabi (Wa inna shafa'ataha laturja wa innaha la ma'al Gharaniqil 'Ula) niklwadiya. Mushrikeen ne in lafzon ko pakar liya aur Shaitan ne yeh baat phaila di. Is par yeh aayat utri aur ise zaleel hona para. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Surah Najm nazil hui aur mushrikeen keh rahe thay ke agar yeh shakhs hamare maboodon ka achhe lafzon mein zikr kare to hum ise aur is ke sathiyon ko chhorein, magar is ka to yeh haal hai ke Yahood-o-Nasara aur jo log is ke mukhalif hain, is sab se zyada galiyon aur burai se hamare maboodon ka zikr karta hai. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur aap ke as-haab par sakht masaib tore ja rahe thay. Aap ko un ki hidayat ki lalach thi. Jab Surah Najm ki tilawat aap ne shuru ki aur (Wa lahu al-untha) tak parha to Shaitan ne buton ke zikr ke waqt yeh kalmaat daal diye, Arabi (Wa innahunna lahunal Gharaniqul 'Ula wa inna shafa'atahunna lahiya allati turja). Yeh Shaitan ki muqaffa ibarat thi. Har mushrik ke dil mein yeh kalme baith gaye aur ek ek ko yaad ho gaye, yahan tak ke yeh mashhoor ho gaya ke Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Surah ke khatme par sajda kiya to saare musalman aur mushrikeen bhi sajde mein gir pare. Haan, Waleed bin Mugheerah chunke bahut hi boorha tha is liye us ne ek mutthi mitti ki bhar kar oonchi le ja kar us ko apne mathay se laga liya. Ab har ek ko ta'ajjub maloom hone laga kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath dono fareeq sajde mein shamil thay. Musalmanon ko ta'ajjub tha ke yeh log iman to laye nahin, yaqeen nahin, phir hamare sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sajde par sajda inhone kaise kiya?

Shaitan ne jo alfaaz mushrikon ke kanon mein phoonke thay woh musalmanon ne sune hi na thay, idhar un ke dilon mein khushi ho rahi thi kyunke Shaitan ne is tarah aawaz mein aawaz milayi ke mushrikeen is mein koi tameez hi na kar sakte thay. Woh to sab ko isi yaqeen par pakka kar chuka tha ke khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi surat ki in dono aayaton ko tilawat farmaya hai. Pas dar-asal mushrikeen ka sajda apne ko tha. Shaitan ne is waqiye ko itna phaila diya ke muhajireen-e-Habsha ke kanon mein bhi yeh baat pahunchi. Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) aur un ke sathiyon ne jab suna ke ahl-e-Makkah musalman ho gaye hain, balkay unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath namaz padhi aur Waleed bin Mugheera sajda na kar saka to us ne mitti ki ek mutthi utha kar us par sar tikaliya. Musalman ab pooray amn aur itminan se hain to unhon ne wahan se wapsi ki thani aur khushi khushi Makkah pahunche. Un ke pahunchne se pehle Shaitan ke un alfaaz ki qal'i khul chuki thi, Allah ne un alfaaz ko hata diya tha aur apna kalam mehfooz kar diya tha. Yahan mushrikeen ki aatish-e-adawat aur bhadak uthi thi aur unhon ne musalmanon par naye masaib ke badal barsane shuru kar diye thay. Yeh riwayat bhi mursal hai. Baihaqi ki kitab Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi yeh riwayat hai, Imam Muhammad Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) bhi ise apni Seerat mein laye hain lekin yeh sanadein mursalat aur munqata'aat hain, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Baghawi (R.H) ne apni tafseer mein yeh sab kuch Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera ke kalam se isi tarah ki riwayatein warid ki hain. Phir khud hi ek sawal warid kiya hai ke jab Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke bachao ka zimmedar muhafiz khud Allah Ta'ala hai to aisi baat kaise waqay ho gayi. Phir bohat se jawab diye hain jin mein ek lateef jawab yeh bhi hai ke Shaitan ne yeh alfaaz logon ke kanon mein daale aur unhein wahm dala ke yeh alfaaz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke munh se nikle hain, haqeeqat mein aisa na tha, yeh sirf shaitani harkat thi na ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aawaz. Wallahu A'lam. Aur bhi isi qisam ke bohat se jawab mutakallimeen ne diye hain. Qazi Ayaz (R.H) ne bhi Shifa mein ise chheda hai aur un ke jawab ka mahasil yeh hai ke Allah ka apna farman is baat ka suboot hai ke Shaitan ka tasarruf Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par namumkin hai. Magar jab ke woh aarzoo karta hai al-kh, is mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasalli farmayi gayi hai ke aap is par pareshan khatir na hon, agle nabiyon rasoolon par bhi aise ittefaqat aaye. Bukhari mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se hai ke is ki aarzoo mein jab Nabi baat karta hai to Shaitan us ki baat mein bol shamil kar deta hai, pas Shaitan ke dale huye ko batil kar ke phir Allah Ta'ala apni aayat ko mohkam karta hai. Mujahid kehte hain 'tamanni' ka ma'ni 'qala' ke hain, 'amniyatahu' ke ma'ni 'qara'atahu' ke hain, 'illa amani' ka matlab yeh hai ke padhte hain likhte nahin. Baghawi (R.H) aur aksar mufassireen kehte hain 'tamanni' ke ma'ni 'tala' ke hain yani jab Kitabullah padhta hai to Shaitan us ki tilawat mein kuch daal deta hai, chunancha Hazrat Usman (R.A) ki madh mein shayar ne kaha hai:
She'r: (Tamanna Kitaballahi awwala lailatihi wa aakhiraha laqa hamamal maqadir).
Yahan bhi lafz 'tamanni' padhne ke ma'ni mein hai.

Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) kehte hain yeh qaul bahut qareeb ki ta'weel wala hai. Naskh ke haqeeqi ma'ani lughatan azala aur raf' ke ma'ani hatane aur mita dene ke hain yani Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala shaitan ke ilqa ko batil kar deta hai. Jibraeel (A.S) ba-hukm-e-Ilahi shaitan ki ziyadti ko mita dete hain aur Allah ki aayatein mazboot reh jaati hain. Allah Ta'ala tamam kaamon ka janne wala hai. Koi makhfi baat bhi koi raaz bhi us par posheeda nahin, woh Hakeem hai uska kaam hikmat se khali nahin. Yeh is liye ke jin ke dilon mein shak, shirk, kufr aur nifaq hai, un ke liye yeh fitna ban jaye. Chunancha mushrikeen ne ise Allah ki taraf se maan liya halankeh woh alfaaz shaitani thay. Lehaza beemar dil walon se murad munafiq hain aur sakht dil walon se murad mushrik hain. Yeh bhi qaul hai ke murad Yahood hain. Zalim haq se bahut door nikal gaye hain. Woh seedhe raaste se gum ho gaye hain aur jinhein sahih ilm diya gaya hai jis se woh haq-o-batil mein tameez kar lete hain unhein is baat ke bilkul haq hone ka aur minjanib-e-Allah hone ka sahih yaqeen ho jaye aur woh kamil-ul-imaan ban jayen aur samajh lein ke beshak yeh Allah ka kalam hai jabhi toh is qadar is ki hifazat, diyanat aur nigahdasht hai. Ke kisi janib se kisi tareeq se is mein batil ki aamezish nahin ho sakti. Hakeem-o-Hameed Allah ki taraf se nazil shuda hai pas unke dil tasdeeq se pur ho jate hain, jhuk kar raghbat se mutawajjeh ho jate hain, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ki rehbari duniya mein haq aur hidayat ki taraf karta hai, Sirat-e-Mustaqeem samjha deta hai aur aakhirat mein azabon se bacha kar buland darjon mein pahunchata hai aur ne'matein naseeb farmata hai.

Baghawi (R.H) aur aksar mufassireen kehte hain 'tamanni' ke ma'ni 'tala' ke hain yani jab Kitabullah padhta hai to Shaitan us ki tilawat mein kuch daal deta hai, chunancha Hazrat Usman (R.A) ki madh mein shayar ne kaha hai:
She'r: (Tamanna Kitaballahi awwala lailatihi wa aakhiraha laqa hamamal maqadir).
Yahan bhi lafz 'tamanni' padhne ke ma'ni mein hai.

Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) kehte hain yeh qaul bahut qareeb ki ta'weel wala hai. Naskh ke haqeeqi ma'ani lughatan azala aur raf' ke ma'ani hatane aur mita dene ke hain yani Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala shaitan ke ilqa ko batil kar deta hai. Jibraeel (A.S) ba-hukm-e-Ilahi shaitan ki ziyadti ko mita dete hain aur Allah ki aayatein mazboot reh jaati hain. Allah Ta'ala tamam kaamon ka janne wala hai. Koi makhfi baat bhi koi raaz bhi us par posheeda nahin, woh Hakeem hai uska kaam hikmat se khali nahin. Yeh is liye ke jin ke dilon mein shak, shirk, kufr aur nifaq hai, un ke liye yeh fitna ban jaye. Chunancha mushrikeen ne ise Allah ki taraf se maan liya halankeh woh alfaaz shaitani thay. Lehaza beemar dil walon se murad munafiq hain aur sakht dil walon se murad mushrik hain. Yeh bhi qaul hai ke murad Yahood hain. Zalim haq se bahut door nikal gaye hain. Woh seedhe raaste se gum ho gaye hain aur jinhein sahih ilm diya gaya hai jis se woh haq-o-batil mein tameez kar lete hain unhein is baat ke bilkul haq hone ka aur minjanib-e-Allah hone ka sahih yaqeen ho jaye aur woh kamil-ul-imaan ban jayen aur samajh lein ke beshak yeh Allah ka kalam hai jabhi toh is qadar is ki hifazat, diyanat aur nigahdasht hai. Ke kisi janib se kisi tareeq se is mein batil ki aamezish nahin ho sakti. Hakeem-o-Hameed Allah ki taraf se nazil shuda hai pas unke dil tasdeeq se pur ho jate hain, jhuk kar raghbat se mutawajjeh ho jate hain, Allah Ta'ala imandaron ki rehbari duniya mein haq aur hidayat ki taraf karta hai, Sirat-e-Mustaqeem samjha deta hai aur aakhirat mein azabon se bacha kar buland darjon mein pahunchata hai aur ne'matein naseeb farmata hai.

Shaitan ka tasarruf ghalat hai. Yahan par aksar mufassireen ne Gharaniq ka qissa naqal kiya hai aur yeh bhi ke is waqiye ki wajah se aksar Muhajireen-e-Habash yeh samajh kar ke mushrikeen-e-Makkah ab musalman ho gaye wapas Makkah aa gaye. Lekin yeh riwayat har sanad se mursal hai. Kisi sahih sanad se musnad marwi nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Chunancha Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Makkah Shareef mein Surah An-Najm ki tilawat farmayi. Jab yeh aayatein aap parh rahe thay aayat (اَفَرَءَيْتُمُ اللّٰتَ وَالْعُزّٰى 19؀ۙ) (53-An-Najm: 19) to Shaitan ne aap ki zaban-e-mubarak par yeh alfaaz daale ke (Tilkal Gharaniqul 'Ula wa inna shafa'atahunna laturja). Pas mushrikeen khush ho gaye ke aaj to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamare maboodon ki tareef ki jo is se pehle aap ne kabhi nahin ki. Chunancha idhar Huzoor ne sajda kiya udhar woh sab bhi sajde mein gir pare. Is par yeh aayat utri. Ise Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne bhi riwayat kiya hai, yeh mursal hai. Musnad Bazzar mein bhi is ke zikr ke baad hai ke sirf isi sanad se hi yeh muttasilan marwi hai. Sirf Umayyah bin Khalid hi ise wasl karte hain, woh mashhoor thiqa hain. Yeh sirf tareeq-e-Kalbi se hi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ne ise do sanadon se liya hai lekin dono mursal hain, Ibn-e-Jareer mein bhi mursal hai. Qatadah (R.H) kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke paas namaz parhte hue Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko oongh aa gayi aur Shaitan ne aap ki zaban par dala, Arabi (Wa inna shafa'ataha laturja wa innaha la ma'al Gharaniqil 'Ula) niklwadiya. Mushrikeen ne in lafzon ko pakar liya aur Shaitan ne yeh baat phaila di. Is par yeh aayat utri aur ise zaleel hona para. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Surah Najm nazil hui aur mushrikeen keh rahe thay ke agar yeh shakhs hamare maboodon ka achhe lafzon mein zikr kare to hum ise aur is ke sathiyon ko chhorein, magar is ka to yeh haal hai ke Yahood-o-Nasara aur jo log is ke mukhalif hain, is sab se zyada galiyon aur burai se hamare maboodon ka zikr karta hai. Us waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par aur aap ke as-haab par sakht masaib tore ja rahe thay. Aap ko un ki hidayat ki lalach thi. Jab Surah Najm ki tilawat aap ne shuru ki aur (Wa lahu al-untha) tak parha to Shaitan ne buton ke zikr ke waqt yeh kalmaat daal diye, Arabi (Wa innahunna lahunal Gharaniqul 'Ula wa inna shafa'atahunna lahiya allati turja). Yeh Shaitan ki muqaffa ibarat thi. Har mushrik ke dil mein yeh kalme baith gaye aur ek ek ko yaad ho gaye, yahan tak ke yeh mashhoor ho gaya ke Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Surah ke khatme par sajda kiya to saare musalman aur mushrikeen bhi sajde mein gir pare. Haan, Waleed bin Mugheerah chunke bahut hi boorha tha is liye us ne ek mutthi mitti ki bhar kar oonchi le ja kar us ko apne mathay se laga liya. Ab har ek ko ta'ajjub maloom hone laga kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath dono fareeq sajde mein shamil thay. Musalmanon ko ta'ajjub tha ke yeh log iman to laye nahin, yaqeen nahin, phir hamare sath Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sajde par sajda inhone kaise kiya?

Shaitan ne jo alfaaz mushrikon ke kanon mein phoonke thay woh musalmanon ne sune hi na thay, idhar un ke dilon mein khushi ho rahi thi kyunke Shaitan ne is tarah aawaz mein aawaz milayi ke mushrikeen is mein koi tameez hi na kar sakte thay. Woh to sab ko isi yaqeen par pakka kar chuka tha ke khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi surat ki in dono aayaton ko tilawat farmaya hai. Pas dar-asal mushrikeen ka sajda apne ko tha. Shaitan ne is waqiye ko itna phaila diya ke muhajireen-e-Habsha ke kanon mein bhi yeh baat pahunchi. Usman bin Maz'oon (R.A) aur un ke sathiyon ne jab suna ke ahl-e-Makkah musalman ho gaye hain, balkay unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath namaz padhi aur Waleed bin Mugheera sajda na kar saka to us ne mitti ki ek mutthi utha kar us par sar tikaliya. Musalman ab pooray amn aur itminan se hain to unhon ne wahan se wapsi ki thani aur khushi khushi Makkah pahunche. Un ke pahunchne se pehle Shaitan ke un alfaaz ki qal'i khul chuki thi, Allah ne un alfaaz ko hata diya tha aur apna kalam mehfooz kar diya tha. Yahan mushrikeen ki aatish-e-adawat aur bhadak uthi thi aur unhon ne musalmanon par naye masaib ke badal barsane shuru kar diye thay. Yeh riwayat bhi mursal hai. Baihaqi ki kitab Dala'il-un-Nubuwwah mein bhi yeh riwayat hai, Imam Muhammad Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) bhi ise apni Seerat mein laye hain lekin yeh sanadein mursalat aur munqata'aat hain, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Baghawi (R.H) ne apni tafseer mein yeh sab kuch Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera ke kalam se isi tarah ki riwayatein warid ki hain. Phir khud hi ek sawal warid kiya hai ke jab Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke bachao ka zimmedar muhafiz khud Allah Ta'ala hai to aisi baat kaise waqay ho gayi. Phir bohat se jawab diye hain jin mein ek lateef jawab yeh bhi hai ke Shaitan ne yeh alfaaz logon ke kanon mein daale aur unhein wahm dala ke yeh alfaaz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke munh se nikle hain, haqeeqat mein aisa na tha, yeh sirf shaitani harkat thi na ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aawaz. Wallahu A'lam. Aur bhi isi qisam ke bohat se jawab mutakallimeen ne diye hain. Qazi Ayaz (R.H) ne bhi Shifa mein ise chheda hai aur un ke jawab ka mahasil yeh hai ke Allah ka apna farman is baat ka suboot hai ke Shaitan ka tasarruf Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par namumkin hai. Magar jab ke woh aarzoo karta hai al-kh, is mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasalli farmayi gayi hai ke aap is par pareshan khatir na hon, agle nabiyon rasoolon par bhi aise ittefaqat aaye. Bukhari mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se hai ke is ki aarzoo mein jab Nabi baat karta hai to Shaitan us ki baat mein bol shamil kar deta hai, pas Shaitan ke dale huye ko batil kar ke phir Allah Ta'ala apni aayat ko mohkam karta hai. Mujahid kehte hain 'tamanni' ka ma'ni 'qala' ke hain, 'amniyatahu' ke ma'ni 'qara'atahu' ke hain, 'illa amani' ka matlab yeh hai ke padhte hain likhte nahin. She'r: (Tamanna Kitaballahi awwala lailatihi wa aakhiraha laqa hamamal maqadir).
Yahan bhi lafz 'tamanni' padhne ke ma'ni mein hai.

Kafiron ke dil se shak-o-shuba nahin jayega yani kafiron ko jo shak-o-shuba Allah ki is wahi yani Quran mein hai woh un ke dilon se nahin jayega. Shaitan yeh ghalat guman Qayamat tak un ke dilon se na nikalne dega. Qayamat aur is ke azab un ke paas nagahan aa jayenge. Is waqt yeh mehez beshoor honge jo mohlat unhein mil rahi hai is se yeh maghroor ho gaye. Jis qoum ke paas Allah ke azab aaye isi halat mein aaye ke woh un se nidar balkay beparwah ho gaye the. Allah ke azabon se ghafil wahi hote hain jo pooray fasiq aur elaniya mujrim hon. Ya unhein bekhabar din azab pohanchay jo din un ke liye manhoos sabit hoga. Baaz ka qaul hai ke is se murad Youm-e-Badr hai aur baaz ne kaha hai murad is se Qayamat ka din hai yahi qaul sahih hai go Badr ka din bhi un ke liye azab-e-Allah ka din tha. Is din sirf Allah ki badshahat hogi jaise aur ayat mein hai Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din ka malik hai. Aur ayat mein hai us din Rahman ka hi mulk hoga aur woh din kafiron par nihayat hi garan guzrega. Faislay khud Allah karega. Jin ke dilon mein Allah par iman, Rasool ki sadaqat aur iman ke mutabiq jin ke aamal the jin ke dil aur amal mein muwafiqat thi. Jin ki zabanen dil ke manind thin woh Jannat ki nematon mein mala-maal honge jo nematein na fana hon na ghaten na bigren na kam hon. Jin ke dilon mein haqaniyat se kufr tha, jo haq ko jhutlate the, nabiyon ke khilaf karte the, itba-e-haq se takabbur karte the un ke takabbur ke badlay unhein zaleel karne wale azab honge. Jaise farman hai ayat (Innal-lazina yastakbiruna an ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhireen) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 60). Jo log meri ibadaton se sarkashi karte hain woh zaleel ho kar Jahannam mein dakhil honge.

Allah Ta'ala ka behtareen rizq paane wale log yani jo shakhs apna watan, apne ahl-o-ayal, apne dost ahbab chhod kar Allah ki razamandi ke liye uski rah mein hijrat kar jaye, uske Rasool (ﷺ) ki aur uske deen ki madad ke liye pahunche, phir woh maidan-e-jihad mein dushman ke hathon shaheed kiya jaye ya bina lade bhide apni qaza ke sath apne bistar par maut aa jaye aur use bahut bada ajr aur zabardast sawab Allah ki taraf se hai. Jaise irshad hai aayat: (Wa man yakhruj min baitihi muhajiran ilallahi wa rasulihi thumma yudrik-hul mautu faqad waqa'a ajruhu 'alallahi, wa kanallahu Ghafurar-Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 100). Yani jo shakhs apne ghar aur des ko chhod kar Allah Rasool ki taraf hijrat karke nikle phir use maut aa jaye to use uska ajr Allah ke zimme tay ho chuka. In par Allah ka fazl hoga, inhe jannat ki roziyan milengi jis se unki aankhein thandi hon. Allah Ta'ala behtareen raaziq hai. Inhe Parwardigar jannat mein pahunchaye ga, jahan yeh khush khush honge jise farman hai ke jo hamare muqarrabon mein se hai uske liye rahat aur khushbudar phool aur nematon bhare baghat hain, aise logon ko rahat-o-rizq aur jannat milegi. Apni rah ke sacche muhajiron ko, apni rah mein jihad karne walon ko, apni nematon ke mustahiq logon ko Allah Ta'ala khoob janta hai. Woh bade hukm wala hai, bandon ke gunah maaf farmata hai, unki khataon se darguzar farmata hai, unki hijrat qubool karta hai, unke tawakkul ko khoob janta hai. Jo log Allah ki rah mein shaheed hon, muhajir hon ya na hon, woh Rabb ke paas zindagi aur rozi paate hain. Jise farman hai aayat: (Wala tahsabannalladhina qutilu fi sabilillahi amwatan, bal ahya'un 'inda Rabbihim yurzaqun) (Surah Al-Imran: 169), Khuda ki rah ke shaheedon ko murda na samjho, woh apne Rabb ke paas zinda hain, roziyan diye jate hain. Is bare mein bahut si hadeesein hain jo bayan ho chukin. Pas fi sabilillah shaheed hone walon ka ajr Allah Ta'ala ke zimme sabit hai is aayat se aur isi bare ki ahadees se bhi. Hazrat Sharjeel bin Samt (R.H) farmate hain ke Room ke ek qile ke muhasare par hamein muddat guzar chuki, ittefaq se Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) wahan se guzre to farmane lage, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai, jo shakhs rah-e-Allah ki tayyari mein mar jaye to uska ajr aur rizq barabar Allah ki taraf se hamesha us par jari rehta hai aur woh fitne mein dalne walon se mehfooz rehta hai. Agar tum chaho to yeh aayat (Walladhina hajaru fi sabilillahi thumma qutilu aw matu layarzuqannahumullahu rizqan hasana) (Surah Al-Hajj: 58) padh lo. Hazrat Abu Qabeel aur Rabee bin Saif Maghafiri (R.H) kehte hain hum Rhodes ke jihad mein the, hamare sath Hazrat Fazala bin Ubaid (R.A) bhi the. Do janaze hamare paas se guzre jin mein ek shaheed tha, dusra apni maut mara tha, log shaheed ke janaze mein toot pade. Hazrat Fazala (R.A) ne farmaya yeh kya baat hai?

Logon ne kaha Hazrat yeh shaheed hain aur yeh dusre shahadat se mehroom hain. Aap ne farmaya Wallah mujhe toh dono baatein barabar hain. Khwah is ki qabr mein se uthoon khwah is ki mein se. Suno Kitabullah mein hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap mare hue ki qabr par hi thehre rahe aur farmaya tumhein aur kya chahiye jannat, jagah aur umdah rozi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap us waqt ameer thay. Yeh aakhri aayat Sahaba R.A ke us chote se lashkar ke baare mein utri hai jin se mushrikeen ke ek lashkar ne bawajood un ke ruk jaane ki hurmat ke mahine mein ladai ki. Allah ne musalmanon ki imdad farmayi aur mukhalifeen ko neecha dikhaya. Allah Ta'ala dargarzar karne wala aur bakhshne wala hai.

Jaise irshad hai aayat: (Wa man yakhruj min baitihi muhajiran ilallahi wa rasulihi thumma yudrik-hul mautu faqad waqa'a ajruhu 'alallahi, wa kanallahu Ghafurar-Rahima) (Surah An-Nisa: 100). Yani jo shakhs apne ghar aur des ko chhod kar Allah Rasool ki taraf hijrat karke nikle phir use maut aa jaye to use uska ajr Allah ke zimme tay ho chuka. In par Allah ka fazl hoga, inhe jannat ki roziyan milengi jis se unki aankhein thandi hon. Allah Ta'ala behtareen raaziq hai. Inhe Parwardigar jannat mein pahunchaye ga, jahan yeh khush khush honge jise farman hai ke jo hamare muqarrabon mein se hai uske liye rahat aur khushbudar phool aur nematon bhare baghat hain, aise logon ko rahat-o-rizq aur jannat milegi. Apni rah ke sacche muhajiron ko, apni rah mein jihad karne walon ko, apni nematon ke mustahiq logon ko Allah Ta'ala khoob janta hai. Woh bade hukm wala hai, bandon ke gunah maaf farmata hai, unki khataon se darguzar farmata hai, unki hijrat qubool karta hai, unke tawakkul ko khoob janta hai. Hazrat Sharjeel bin Samt (R.H) farmate hain ke Room ke ek qile ke muhasare par hamein muddat guzar chuki, ittefaq se Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) wahan se guzre to farmane lage, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai, jo shakhs rah-e-Allah ki tayyari mein mar jaye to uska ajr aur rizq barabar Allah ki taraf se hamesha us par jari rehta hai aur woh fitne mein dalne walon se mehfooz rehta hai.
