Hazrat Abu Qabeel aur Rabee bin Saif Maghafiri (R.H) kehte hain hum Rhodes ke jihad mein the, hamare sath Hazrat Fazala bin Ubaid (R.A) bhi the. Do janaze hamare paas se guzre jin mein ek shaheed tha, dusra apni maut mara tha, log shaheed ke janaze mein toot pade. Hazrat Fazala (R.A) ne farmaya yeh kya baat hai?

Logon ne kaha Hazrat yeh shaheed hain aur yeh dusre shahadat se mehroom hain. Aap ne farmaya Wallah mujhe toh dono baatein barabar hain. Khwah is ki qabr mein se uthoon khwah is ki mein se. Suno Kitabullah mein hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap mare hue ki qabr par hi thehre rahe aur farmaya tumhein aur kya chahiye jannat, jagah aur umdah rozi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aap us waqt ameer thay. Yeh aakhri aayat Sahaba R.A ke us chote se lashkar ke baare mein utri hai jin se mushrikeen ke ek lashkar ne bawajood un ke ruk jaane ki hurmat ke mahine mein ladai ki. Wahi sacha mabood hai. Ibadaton ke laiq us ke siwa koi aur nahin. Zabardast ghalbe wala, badi shan wala wahi hai, jo chahta hai hota hai, jo nahin chahta namumkin hai ke woh ho jae. Har shakhs us ke samne faqeer, har ek us ke aage aajiz. Us ke siwa jise log poojen woh batil, koi nafa nuqsan kisi ke hath nahin, woh bulandiyon wala, azmaton wala hai. Har cheez us ke matahat, us ke zer-e-hukm. Us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, na us ke siwa koi Rabb, na us se koi bada, na us par koi ghalib. Woh taqaddus wala, woh izzat-o-jalal wala, zalimon ki kahi hui tamam fazool baton se pak, sab khubiyon wala, tamam nuqsanat se door.

Apni Azeem-ush-Shan qudrat aur zabardast ghalbe ko bayan farma raha hai ke sookhi ghair-abad murda zameen par uske hukm se hawayein badal lati hain jo pani barsate hain aur zameen lehlahati hui sarsabz-o-shadab ho jati hai goya jee uthti hai. Yahan par "Fa" ta'qeeb ke liye hai har cheez ki ta'qeeb usi ke andaaz se hoti hai. Nutfe ka alaqah hona phir alaqe ka mudghah hona jahan bayan farmaya hai wahan bhi "Fa" aayi hai aur har do surat mein chalees din ka fasla hota hai. Aur yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke Hijaz ki ba'az zameenein aisi bhi hain ke barish ke hote hi ma'an surkh-o-sabz ho jati hain, Fallahu A'lam. Zameen ke goshon mein aur uske andar jo kuch hai, sab Allah ke ilm mein hai. Ek ek dana uski danist mein hai. Pani wahin pahunchta hai aur woh ug aata hai. Jaise Hazrat Luqman R.H ke qaul mein hai ke ae bache! Agarche koi cheez rai ke dane barabar ho chahe kisi chattan mein ho ya aasman mein ya zameen mein Allah use zaroor layega, Allah Ta'ala pakeeza aur bakhabar hai. Ek aur aayat mein hai zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez ko Allah zahir kar dega. Ek aayat mein hai, har patte ke jhadne ka, har dane ka jo zameen ke andheron mein ho har tar-o-khushk cheez ka Allah ko ilm hai aur woh khuli kitab mein hai. Ek aur aayat mein koi zarra aasman-o-zameen mein Allah se posheeda nahin, koi choti badi cheez aisi nahin jo zahir kitab mein na ho. Umayyah bin Abu Salt ya Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ke qaseede mein hai sher: (Wa qoola lahu man yunbitul habba fis-sara, fayusbihu min-hul baqlu yahtazzu rabiyan, wa yukhriju min-hu habbahu fi ru'usihi, fafi zaaka aayatun liman kaana da'iya). Ae mere dono paighambaro! Tum us se kaho ke mitti mein se dane kaun nikalta hai ke darakht phoot kar jhoomne lagta hai aur uske sere par baal nikal aati hai? Aqlmand ke liye to is mein qudrat ki ek chhod kayi nishaniyan majood hain. Tamam kainat ka maalik wahi hai. Woh har ek se beniyaaz hai. Har ek uske samne faqeer aur uski bargah-e-aali ka mohtaj hai. Sab insaan uske ghulam hain. Kya tum dekh nahin rahe ke kul haiwanat, jamadat, khetiyan, baghaat usne tumhare faide ke liye, tumhari mat-huti mein de rakhe hain, aasman-o-zameen ki cheezein tumhare liye sargardan hain. Uska ehsan-o-fazl-o-karam hai ke usi ke hukm se kashtiyan tumhein idhar se udhar le jati hain. Tumhare maal-o-mata' unke zariye yahan se wahan pahunchte hain. Pani ko cheerte huin, maujon ko kaat-ti huin bahukm-e-Ilahi hawaon ke sath tumhare nafa ke liye chal rahi hain. Yahan ki zaroorat ki cheezein wahan se wahan ki yahan barabar pahunchti rehti hain. Woh khud aasman ko thame hue hai ke zameen par na gir pade warna abhi woh hukm de to yeh zameen par aa rahe aur tum sab halak ho jao. Insanon ke gunahon ke bawajood Allah un par rafat-o-shafqat, banda nawazi aur ghulam parwari kar raha hai. Jaise farman hai aayat: (Wa inna Rabbaka lazoo maghfiratin lin-naasi 'ala zulmihim, wa inna Rabbaka lashadeedul iqaab) 13.

(Ar-Ra'd: 6)، logon ke gunahon ke bawajood Allah Ta'ala un par sahib-e-maghfirat hai. Haan beshak woh sakht azabon wala bhi hai. "Usi ne tumhein paida kiya hai, wahi tumhein fana karega, wahi phir dobara paida karega." Jaise farmaya ayat (KAYFA TAKFURUNA BILLAHI WA KUNTUM AMWATAN FA-AHYAKUM, THUMMA YUMITUKUM THUMMA YUHYIKUM THUMMA ILAIHI TURJA'UN) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 28) tum Allah ke sath kaise kufr karte ho? Halankeh tum murda thay, usi ne tumhein zinda kiya phir wahi tumhein maar dalega, phir dobara zinda karde ga. Phir tum sab usi ki taraf lautaye jaoge. Ek aur ayat mein hai (QULILLAHU YUHYIKUM THUMMA YUMITUKUM THUMMA YAJMA'UKUM ILA YAWMIL QIYAMATI LA RAYBA FIHI WA LAKINNA AKSARAN NASI LA YA'LAMUN) (Surah Al-Jathiyah: 26) Allah hi tumhein dobara zinda karta hai phir wahi tumhein maar dalega phir tumhein Qayamat wale din, jis ke aane mein koi shuba nahin jama karega. Aur jagah farmaya "Woh kahenge ke ae Allah tu ne hamein do dafa mara aur do dafa zinda kiya." Pas kalam ka matlab yeh hai ke aise Allah ke sath tum dusron ko shareek kyun thairate ho? Dusron ki ibadat uske sath kaise karte ho? Paida karne wala faqat wahi, rozi dene wala wahi, malik-o-mukhtar faqat wahi, tum kuch na thay us ne tumhein paida kiya. Phir tumhari maut ke baad dobara paida karega yani Qayamat ke din. Insaan bada hi nashukra aur be-qadra hai.

Aur yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke Hijaz ki ba'az zameenein aisi bhi hain ke barish ke hote hi ma'an surkh-o-sabz ho jati hain, Fallahu A'lam. Zameen ke goshon mein aur uske andar jo kuch hai, sab Allah ke ilm mein hai. Ek ek dana uski danist mein hai. Pani wahin pahunchta hai aur woh ug aata hai. Jaise Hazrat Luqman R.H ke qaul mein hai ke ae bache! Agarche koi cheez rai ke dane barabar ho chahe kisi chattan mein ho ya aasman mein ya zameen mein Allah use zaroor layega, Allah Ta'ala pakeeza aur bakhabar hai. Ek aur aayat mein hai zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez ko Allah zahir kar dega. Ek aayat mein hai, har patte ke jhadne ka, har dane ka jo zameen ke andheron mein ho har tar-o-khushk cheez ka Allah ko ilm hai aur woh khuli kitab mein hai. Ek aur aayat mein koi zarra aasman-o-zameen mein Allah se posheeda nahin, koi choti badi cheez aisi nahin jo zahir kitab mein na ho. Umayyah bin Abu Salt ya Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail ke qaseede mein hai sher: (Wa qoola lahu man yunbitul habba fis-sara, fayusbihu min-hul baqlu yahtazzu rabiyan, wa yukhriju min-hu habbahu fi ru'usihi, fafi zaaka aayatun liman kaana da'iya). Ae mere dono paighambaro! Tum us se kaho ke mitti mein se dane kaun nikalta hai ke darakht phoot kar jhoomne lagta hai aur uske sere par baal nikal aati hai? Aqlmand ke liye to is mein qudrat ki ek chhod kayi nishaniyan majood hain. Tamam kainat ka maalik wahi hai. Woh har ek se beniyaaz hai. Har ek uske samne faqeer aur uski bargah-e-aali ka mohtaj hai. Sab insaan uske ghulam hain. Kya tum dekh nahin rahe ke kul haiwanat, jamadat, khetiyan, baghaat usne tumhare faide ke liye, tumhari mat-huti mein de rakhe hain, aasman-o-zameen ki cheezein tumhare liye sargardan hain. Uska ehsan-o-fazl-o-karam hai ke usi ke hukm se kashtiyan tumhein idhar se udhar le jati hain. Tumhare maal-o-mata' unke zariye yahan se wahan pahunchte hain. Pani ko cheerte huin, maujon ko kaat-ti huin bahukm-e-Ilahi hawaon ke sath tumhare nafa ke liye chal rahi hain. Yahan ki zaroorat ki cheezein wahan se wahan ki yahan barabar pahunchti rehti hain. Woh khud aasman ko thame hue hai ke zameen par na gir pade warna abhi woh hukm de to yeh zameen par aa rahe aur tum sab halak ho jao. Insanon ke gunahon ke bawajood Allah un par rafat-o-shafqat, banda nawazi aur ghulam parwari kar raha hai. Jaise farman hai aayat: (Wa inna Rabbaka lazoo maghfiratin lin-naasi 'ala zulmihim, wa inna Rabbaka lashadeedul iqaab) 13.

Manasik ke ma'ani asal mein Arabi zaban mein mansak ka lafzi tarjuma woh jagah hai, jahan insaan jaane aane ki aadat daal le. Ahkaam-e-Hajj ki baja-awari ko is liye manasik kaha jata hai ke log baar baar wahan jate hain aur thairte hain. Manqool hai ke yahan murad yeh hai ke har ummat ke paighambar ke liye hum ne shariat muqarrar ki hai, is amr mein log na lade, se murad yeh mushrik log hain. Aur agar murad har ummat ke bator qudrat ke un ke af'aal ka taqarrur karna hai. Jaise Surah Baqarah mein farman hai ke har ek ke liye ek simt hai jidhar woh mutawajja hota hai yahan bhi hai ke woh is ke baja lane wale hain to zameer ka i'ada bhi khud un par hi hai yani yeh Allah ki qudrat aur irade se kar rahe hain un ke jhagadne se to baddil na ho aur haq se na hat. Apne Rab ki taraf bulata reh aur apni hidayat-o-istaqamat par mukammal yaqeen rakh. Yehi rasta haq se milane wala hai, kamyabi se hamkinar karne wala hai. Jaise farmaya hai (وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بَعْدَ اِذْ اُنْزِلَتْ اِلَيْكَ وَادْعُ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ 87؀ۚ) (Surah Al-Qasas: 87) khabardar kahin tujhe Allah ki aayaton ke tere paas pahunch jaane par bhi un se rok na dein, apne Rab ke raste ki dawat-e-aam barabar deta reh. Is ke baad bhi agar koi haq qabool karne se jaye to us se kinara ikhtiyar kijiye aur keh dijiye Allah tumhare a'amal dekh raha hai. Jaise kayi jagah isi mazmoon ko doharaya hai. Ek aur jagah hai ke agar "Yeh tujhe jhutlayein to un se keh de ke mere liye mera amal hai aur tumhare liye tumhara amal hai tum mere a'amal se bari ho main tumhare kartoot se bezar hoon." Pas yahan bhi un ke kaan khol diye ke Allah tumhare a'amal se bakhabar hai woh tumhari adna si adna harkat ko bhi jaanta hai aur wahi hai tum mein kafi shahid hai Qayamat ke din hum tum mein faisla Allah khud kar de ga aur us waqt sare ikhtilafat mit jayenge jaise farman hai to isi ki dawat deta reh aur hamare hukum par sabit qadam reh aur kisi ki khwahish ke peeche na lag aur saaf elaan kar de ke Allah ki nazil ki hui kitab par mera imaan hai.

Kamal-e-Ilm-e-Rabb ki shaan: Rabb ke kamal-e-ilm ka bayan ho raha hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez us ke ilm ke ihata mein hai, ek zarra bhi us se bahar nahin. Kainat ke wajood se pehle hi kainat ka ilm use tha, balkay us ne Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein likhwa diya tha. Sahih Muslim mein hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish se pachaas hazaar saal pehle, jab ke us ka Arsh paani par tha, makhlooq ki taqdeer likhi. Sunan ki hadith mein hai ke sab se pehle Allah Ta'ala ne qalam ko paida kiya aur us se farmaya "Likh", us ne daryaft kiya ke "kya likhoon?" Farmaya "Jo kuch hone wala hai", pas Qayamat tak jo kuch hone wala tha use qalam ne qalam-band kar diya. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka qaul hai ke sau saal ki raah mein Allah ne Lauh-e-Mahfooz ko paida kiya aur makhlooq ki paidaish se pehle, jab ke Allah Ta'ala Arsh par tha, qalam ko likhne ka hukum diya. Us ne poocha "kya likhoon?", farmaya "Mera ilm jo makhlooq ke mutaliq Qayamat tak ka hai". Pas qalam chal pada aur Qayamat tak ke hone wale umoor jo ilm-e-Ilahi mein hain, us ne likh liye. Pas isi ko apne Nabi (ﷺ) se is aayat mein farma raha hai ke kya tu nahin jaanta ke aasman-o-zameen ki har ek cheez ka main aalim hoon. Pas yeh us ka kamal-e-ilm hai ke cheez ke wajood se pehle use maloom hai, balkay likh bhi liya hai aur woh sab yun hi waqay mein hone wala hai. Allah ko bandon ke tamam aamaal ka ilm un ke amal se pehle hai. Woh jo kuch karte hain, us karne se pehle Allah jaanta tha, har farman-bardar aur na-farman us ke ilm mein tha aur us ki kitab mein likha hua tha aur har cheez us ke ilmi ihate ke andar hi andar aur yeh amr Allah par mushkil bhi na tha, sab kitab mein tha aur Rabb par bahut hi aasaan.

Shaitan ki taqleed bila-sanad, baghair daleel ke Allah ke siwa dusre ki puja paat ibadat-o-bandagi karne walon ka jahl-o-kufr bayan farmata hai ke shaitani taqleed aur baap dada ki dekha dekhi ke siwa na koi naqli daleel un ke paas hai na aqli. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai (Wa man yadu'u ma'allahi ilahan aakhara) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 117) jo bhi Allah ke sath dusre mabood ko be-daleel pukare us se Allah khud hi baaz purs karlega. Namumkin hai ke aise zalim chutkara pa jayen. Yahan bhi farmaya ke in zalimon ka koi madadgar nahin ke Allah ke kisi azab se unhein bacha le. Un par Allah ke pak kalam ki aayatein, sahi daleelein, wazeh hujjatein jab pesh ki jati hain to un ke tan-badan mein aag lag jati. Allah ki tauheed, rasoolon ki itteba ko saaf taur par bayan kiya to unhein sakht gussa aaya, un ki shaklein badal gayin, tewriyon par bal padne lage, aastinein chadhne lagin agar bas chale to zaban kheench lein, ek lafz haqaniyat ka zameen par na aane dein. Isi waqt gala ghont dein, in sache khair-khwahon ki, Allah ke deen ke muballighon ki buraiyan karne lagte hain. Zabanein un ke khilaf chalne lagti hain aur mumkin ho to hath bhi un ke khilaf uthne mein nahin rukte. Farman hota hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in se keh do ke ek taraf to tum jo dukh in Allah ke matwalon ko pahunchana chahte ho use wazan karo, dusri taraf us dukh ka wazan kar lo jo tumhein yaqeenan tumhare kufr-o-inkaar ki wajah se pahunchne wala hai, phir dekho ke badtareen cheez kaun si hai? Woh aatish-e-dozakh aur wahan ke tarah tarah ke azab? Ya jo takleef tum in sache muwahidon ko pahunchana chahte ho? Go yeh bhi tumhare irade hi irade hain, ab tum hi samajh lo ke jahannam kaisi buri jagah hai? Kis qadar holnak hai? Kis qadar eeza-dehinda hai? Aur kitni mushkil wali jagah hai? Yaqeenan woh nihayat hi badtareen jagah aur bahut hi khaufnak maqam hai, jahan rahat-o-aaram ka naam bhi nahin.

Isi waqt gala ghont dein, in sache khair-khwahon ki, Allah ke deen ke muballighon ki buraiyan karne lagte hain. Zabanein un ke khilaf chalne lagti hain aur mumkin ho to hath bhi un ke khilaf uthne mein nahin rukte. Farman hota hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) in se keh do ke ek taraf to tum jo dukh in Allah ke matwalon ko pahunchana chahte ho use wazan karo, dusri taraf us dukh ka wazan kar lo jo tumhein yaqeenan tumhare kufr-o-inkaar ki wajah se pahunchne wala hai, phir dekho ke badtareen cheez kaun si hai? Woh aatish-e-dozakh aur wahan ke tarah tarah ke azab? Ya jo takleef tum in sache muwahidon ko pahunchana chahte ho? Go yeh bhi tumhare irade hi irade hain, ab tum hi samajh lo ke jahannam kaisi buri jagah hai? Kis qadar holnak hai? Kis qadar eeza-dehinda hai? Aur kitni mushkil wali jagah hai? Yaqeenan woh nihayat hi badtareen jagah aur bahut hi khaufnak maqam hai, jahan rahat-o-aaram ka naam bhi nahin.

Kam-aql pujari Allah ke masiva jin ki ibadat ki jati hai un ki kamzori aur un ke pujariyon ki kam-aqli bayan ho rahi hai ke ae logo yeh jahil jis jis ki bhi Allah ke siva ibadat karte hain, Rabb ke sath yeh jo shirk karte hain, un ki ek misaal nihayat umdah aur bilkul waqiye ke mutabiq bayan ho rahi hai zara tawajjah se suno. Ke un ke tamam ke tamam but, buzurg waghera jinhein yeh Allah ka shareek thahra rahe hain, jama ho jayen aur ek makkhi banana chahein toh saare aajiz aa jayenge aur ek makkhi bhi paida na kar sakenge. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein farman-e-Ilahi hai is se zyada zalim kaun hai jo meri tarah kisi ko banana chahta hai. Agar waqiye mein kisi ko yeh qudrat hasil hai toh ek zarra, ek makkhi ya ek dana anaaj ka hi khud bana dein. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein alfaaz yun hain ke woh ek zarra ya ek jau hi bana dein. Achha aur bhi un ke maboodan-e-batil ki kamzori aur natwani suno ke yeh ek makkhi ka muqabla bhi nahin kar sakte woh un ka haq un ki cheez un se chheene chali ja rahi hai, yeh bebas hain, yeh bhi toh nahin kar sakte ke us se apni cheez hi wapas le lein bhala makkhi jaisi haqeer aur kamzor makhlooq se bhi jo apna haq na le sake is se bhi zyada kamzor, bouda, zaeef, natwan, bebas aur gira pada koi aur ho sakta hai? Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain talib se murad but aur matloob se murad makkhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand karte hain aur zahir lafzon se bhi yahi zahir hai dusra matlab yeh bayan farmaya gaya hai ke talib se murad aabid aur matloob se murad Allah ke siva aur mabood. Allah ki qadr-o-azmat hi un ke dilon mein nahin rachi agar aisa hota toh itne bade tawana Allah ke sath aisi zaleel makhlooq ko kyun shareek kar lete. Jo makkhi udane ki bhi qudrat nahin rakhti jaise mushrikeen-e-Quraish ke but thay. Allah apni qudrat-o-quwwat mein yakta hai tamam cheezein benamuna sab se pehli paidaish mein us ne paida kar di hain kisi ek se bhi madad liye baghair phir sab ko halak karke dobara us se bhi zyada aasani se paida karne par qadir hai. Woh badi mazboot pakad wala, ibtida aur iaada karne wala, rizq dene wala, aur be-andaz quwwat rakhne wala hai, sab kuch us ke samne past hai, koi us ke irade ko badalne wala, us ke farman ko talne wala us ki azmat aur saltanat ka muqabla karne wala nahin, woh Wahid Qahhar hai.

Mansab-e-Nabuwwat ka haqdar kaun? Apni muqarrar karda taqdeer ke jaari karne aur apni muqarrar karda shariat ko apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tak pahunchane ke liye Allah Ta'ala jis farishtay ko chahta hai, muqarrar kar leta hai isi tarah logon mein se bhi paighambari ki khil'at se jise chahta hai nawazta hai. Bandon ke sab aqwal sunta hai, ek ek banda aur uske a'maal uski nigah mein hain, woh bakhoobi jaanta hai ke mansab-e-nabuwwat ka mustahiq kaun hai? Jaise farmaya aayat (ALLAHU A'LAMU HAITHU YAJ'ALU RISALATAHU, SAYUSIBULLADHINA AJRAMU SAGHARUN 'INDALLAHI WA 'ADHABUN SHADIDUN BIMA KANU YAMKURUN) (Surah Al-An'am: 124). Rabb hi ko ilm hai ke mansab-e-risalat ka sahih taur par ahl kaun hai? Rasoolon ke aagay peechay ka Allah ko ilm hai, kya us tak pahuncha, kya usne pahunchaya, sab us par zahir-o-bahir hai. Jaise farman hai aayat ('ALIMUL GHAIBI FALA YUZHIRU 'ALA GHAIBIHI AHADA) (Surah Al-Jinn: 26), ya'ni woh ghaib ka jaanne wala hai, apne ghaib ka kisi par izhar nahin karta. Haan jis paighambar ko woh pasand farmaye uske aagay peechay pehray muqarrar kar deta hai. Taake woh jaan le ke unhon ne apne Parwardigar ke paigham pahuncha diye aur Allah Ta'ala har us cheez ka ihata kiye hue hai jo unke paas hai aur har cheez ki ginti tak uske paas shumar ho chuki hai. Pas Allah Subhanah-o-Ta'ala apne Rasoolon ka nigehban hai, jo unhein kaha suna jata hai us par khud gawah hai, khud hi unka hafiz hai aur unka madadgar bhi hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (YA AYYUHAR RASULU BALLIGH MA UNZILA ILAIKA MIR RABBIKA) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 67), ae Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo kuch tere paas tere Rabb ki taraf se utra hai, pahuncha de agar aisa na kiya to haq-e-risalat ada na hoga, tera bachao Allah ke zimme hai, al-kh.

Surah Hajj ko do sajdon ki fazilat hasil hai, is dusre sajde ke bare mein do qaul hain. Pehle sajde ki ayat ke mauqa par hum ne woh hadith bayan kar di hai jis mein hai ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya "Surah Hajj ko do sajdon se fazilat di gayi, jo yeh sajde na kare woh yeh parhe hi nahin". Pas ruku, sajda-e-ibadat aur bhalai ka hukm karke farmata hai, ummat-e-muslimah ko sabiqah ummaton par fazilat, apne maal, jaan aur apni zaban se rah-e-Allah mein jihad karo aur haq-e-jihad ada karo. Jaise hukm diya hai ke Allah se utna daro jitna us se darne ka haq hai, usi ne tumhein barguzidah aur pasandidah kar liya hai. Aur ummaton par tumhein sharafat-o-karamat, izzat-o-buzurgi ata farmayi. Kamil Rasool aur kamil shariat se tumhein sarbar-awarda kiya, tumhein aasan, sahal aur umdah deen diya. Woh ahkaam tum par na rakhe, woh sakhti tum par na ki, woh bojh tum par na dale jo tumhare bas ke na hon, jo tum par garan guzrein, jinhein tum baja na lasako. Islam ke baad sab se aala aur sab se zyada takeed wala rukn namaz hai. Ise dekhiye ghar mein aaram se baithe hue hon to char rakat farz aur phir agar safar ho to woh bhi do hi reh jayen. Aur khauf mein to hadith ke mutabiq sirf ek hi rakat, woh bhi sawari par ho to aur paidal ho to, ru-ba-qiblah ho to aur dusri taraf tawajjah ho to, isi tarah yahi hukm safar ki nafl namaz ka hai ke jis taraf sawari ka munh ho parh sakte hain. Phir namaz ka qayam bhi ba-wajah bimari ke saqit ho jata hai. Mareez baith kar namaz parh sakta hai, us ki bhi taqat na ho to leite leite ada kar le. Isi tarah aur faraiz aur wajibaat ko dekho ke kis qadar un mein Allah Ta'ala ne aasaniyan rakhi hain. Isi liye Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmaya karte the, main yak-tarfah aur bilkul aasani wala deen de kar bheja gaya hoon. Jab aap ne Hazrat Mu'az aur Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) ko Yaman ka ameer bana kar bheja to farmaya tha, tum khushkhabri sunana, nafrat na dilana, aasani karna sakhti na karna aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si hadithein hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) is ayat ki tafsir karte hain ke tumhare deen mein koi tangi-o-sakhti nahin. Ibn Jarir (R.H) farmate hain millata ka nasb ba-naz-e-khafz hai, goya asal mein millata-e-abikum tha. Aur ho sakta hai ke iltazamu ko mehzoof mana jaye aur millata ko is ka maf'ool qarar diya jaye. Is surat mein yeh isi ayat ki tarah ho jaye ga deenan qayyiman al-kh, us ne tumhara naam Muslim rakha hai yani Allah Ta'ala ne, Ibrahim (A.S) se pehle. Kyunke un ki dua thi ke hum dono baap beton ko aur hamari aulad mein se bhi ek giroh ko musalman bana de. Lekin Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) farmate hain yeh qaul kuch jachta nahin ke pehle se murad Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke pehle se ho, is liye ke yeh to zahir hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne is ummat ka naam is Quran mein Muslim nahin rakha. "Pehle se" ke lafz ke ma'ani yeh hain ke pehli kitabon mein zikr mein aur is pak aur aakhri kitab mein. Yahi qaul Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) wagairah ka hai aur yahi durust hai.

Kyunke is se pehle is ummat ki buzurgi aur fazeelat ka bayan hai un ke deen ke aasaan hone ka zikr hai. Phir unhein deen ki mazeed raghbat dilane ke liye bataya ja raha hai ke yeh deen woh hai jo Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) le kar aaye the, phir is ummat ki buzurgi ke liye aur unhein mail karne ke liye farmaya ja raha hai ke tumhara zikr meri sabiqah kitabon mein bhi hai. Muddaton se ambiya ki aasmani kitabon mein tumhare charche chale aa rahe hain. Sabiqah kitabon ke parhne wale tum se khoob aagah hain, pas is Quran se pehle aur is Quran mein tumhara naam Muslim hai aur khud Allah ka rakha hua hai. Nasai mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke "Jo shakhs jahiliyat ke da'we ab bhi kare (yani baap dadon par, hasab nasab par fakhr kare, dusre musalmanon ko kamina aur halka khayal kare) woh jahannam ka indhan hai." Kisi ne pucha ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ) agarche woh rozay rakhta ho? Aur namazein bhi parhta ho? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan haan agarche woh rozay dar aur namazi ho. Yani Muslimeen, Momineen aur Ibadullah. Surah Baqarah ki aayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعْبُدُوْا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَكُمْ وَالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 21) ki tafseer mein hum is hadith ko bayan kar chuke hain. Phir farmata hai hum ne tumhein aadil, umdah, behtar ummat is liye banaya hai aur is liye tamam ummaton mein tumhari adalat ki shohrat kar di hai ke tum Qayamat ke din aur logon par shahadat do. Tamam agli ummaten Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) ki buzurgi aur fazeelat ka iqrar karengi, ke is ummat ko aur tamam ummaton par sardari hasil hai is liye in ki gawahi is par motabar mani jaye gi. Is bare mein ke is ke rasoolon ne Allah ka paigham unhein pohanchaya hai, woh tableegh ka farz ada kar chuke hain aur khud Rasool (ﷺ) ummat par shahadat denge ke aap (ﷺ) ne unhein deen pohancha diya aur haq-e-risalat ada kar diya. Is babat jitni hadithein hain aur is bare ki jitni tafseer hai woh hum sab ki sab Surah Baqarah ke satrahein ruku ki aayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنٰكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّسَطًا لِّتَكُوْنُوْا شُهَدَاۗءَ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَيَكُـوْنَ الرَّسُوْلُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 143) ki tafseer mein likh aaye hain. Is liye yahan ise dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin wahin dekh li jaye. Wahin Hazrat Nuh (A.S) aur un ki ummat ka waqia bhi bayan kar diya hai. Phir farmata hai ke itni bari azeem-ush-shan nemat ka shukriya tumhein zaroor ada karna chahiye. Jis ka tareeqa yeh hai ke jo Allah ke faraiz tum par hain unhein shauq khushi se baja lao, khusoosan namaz aur zakat ka poora khayal rakho. Jo kuch Allah ne wajib kiya hai use dili mohabbat se baja lao aur jo cheezein haram kar di hain us ke paas bhi na phatko. Pas namaz jo khalis Rab ki hai aur zakat jis mein Rab ki ibadat ke ilawa makhlooq ke sath ehsan bhi hai ke ameer log apne maal ka ek hissa faqiron ko khushi khushi dete hain. Un ka kaam chalta hai, dil khush ho jata hai.

Is mein bhi hai ke Allah ki taraf se bahut aasani hai, hissa kam bhi hai aur saal bhar mein ek hi martaba. Zakat ke kul ahkaam Surah Taubah ki aayat-e-zakat (Innamas-sadaqatu lil-fuqara-i wal-masakini wal-amilina alaiha wal-mu'allafati qulubuhum wa fir-riqabi wal-gharimina wa fi sabilillahi wabnis-sabili faridatam minallahi wallahu alimun hakim) (Surah At-Taubah: 60) ki tafsir mein hum ne bayan kar diye hain, wahin dekh liye jayen. Phir hukm hota hai ke Allah par pura bharosa rakho, isi par tawakkul karo, apne tamam kaamon mein us ki imdad talab kiya karo, har waqt aitimaad us par rakho, isi ki ta'eed par nazrein rakho. Woh tumhara Maula hai, tumhara hafiz hai, nasir hai, tumhein tumhare dushmanon par kamyabi ata farmane wala hai, woh jis ka wali ban gaya use kisi aur ki wilayat ki zaroorat nahin, sab se behtar wali wahi hai, sab se behtar madadgar wahi hai, tamam duniya go dushman ho jaye lekin woh sab par qadir hai aur sab se zyada qawi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Waheeb bin Ward (R.H) se marwi hai ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Apne gusse ke waqt tu mujhe yaad kar liya kar, main bhi apne ghazab ke waqt tujhe maafi farma diya karunga, aur jin par mera azab nazil hoga main tujhe un mein se bacha lunga, barbad hone walon ke sath tujhe barbad na karunga. Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Jab tujh par zulm kiya jaye to sabr-o-zabt se kaam le, mujh par nigahain rakh, meri madad par bharosa rakh, meri imdad par raazi reh, yaad rakh main teri madad karun yeh us se bahut behtar hai ke tu aap apni madad kare. (Allah Ta'ala hamein bhalaiyon ki taufiq de, apni imdad naseeb farmaye, Ameen). Wallahu A'lam.

Isi liye Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmaya karte the, main yak-tarfah aur bilkul aasani wala deen de kar bheja gaya hoon. Jab aap ne Hazrat Mu'az aur Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) ko Yaman ka ameer bana kar bheja to farmaya tha, tum khushkhabri sunana, nafrat na dilana, aasani karna sakhti na karna aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si hadithein hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) is ayat ki tafsir karte hain ke tumhare deen mein koi tangi-o-sakhti nahin. Ibn Jarir (R.H) farmate hain millata ka nasb ba-naz-e-khafz hai, goya asal mein millata-e-abikum tha. Aur ho sakta hai ke iltazamu ko mehzoof mana jaye aur millata ko is ka maf'ool qarar diya jaye. Is surat mein yeh isi ayat ki tarah ho jaye ga deenan qayyiman al-kh, us ne tumhara naam Muslim rakha hai yani Allah Ta'ala ne, Ibrahim (A.S) se pehle. Kyunke un ki dua thi ke hum dono baap beton ko aur hamari aulad mein se bhi ek giroh ko musalman bana de. Lekin Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) farmate hain yeh qaul kuch jachta nahin ke pehle se murad Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke pehle se ho, is liye ke yeh to zahir hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne is ummat ka naam is Quran mein Muslim nahin rakha. "Pehle se" ke lafz ke ma'ani yeh hain ke pehli kitabon mein zikr mein aur is pak aur aakhri kitab mein. Yahi qaul Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) wagairah ka hai aur yahi durust hai.

Kyunke is se pehle is ummat ki buzurgi aur fazeelat ka bayan hai un ke deen ke aasaan hone ka zikr hai. Phir unhein deen ki mazeed raghbat dilane ke liye bataya ja raha hai ke yeh deen woh hai jo Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) le kar aaye the, phir is ummat ki buzurgi ke liye aur unhein mail karne ke liye farmaya ja raha hai ke tumhara zikr meri sabiqah kitabon mein bhi hai. Muddaton se ambiya ki aasmani kitabon mein tumhare charche chale aa rahe hain. Sabiqah kitabon ke parhne wale tum se khoob aagah hain, pas is Quran se pehle aur is Quran mein tumhara naam Muslim hai aur khud Allah ka rakha hua hai. Nasai mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke "Jo shakhs jahiliyat ke da'we ab bhi kare (yani baap dadon par, hasab nasab par fakhr kare, dusre musalmanon ko kamina aur halka khayal kare) woh jahannam ka indhan hai." Kisi ne pucha ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ) agarche woh rozay rakhta ho? Aur namazein bhi parhta ho? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan haan agarche woh rozay dar aur namazi ho. Yani Muslimeen, Momineen aur Ibadullah. Surah Baqarah ki aayat (يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعْبُدُوْا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَكُمْ وَالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 21) ki tafseer mein hum is hadith ko bayan kar chuke hain. Phir farmata hai hum ne tumhein aadil, umdah, behtar ummat is liye banaya hai aur is liye tamam ummaton mein tumhari adalat ki shohrat kar di hai ke tum Qayamat ke din aur logon par shahadat do. Tamam agli ummaten Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) ki buzurgi aur fazeelat ka iqrar karengi, ke is ummat ko aur tamam ummaton par sardari hasil hai is liye in ki gawahi is par motabar mani jaye gi. Is bare mein ke is ke rasoolon ne Allah ka paigham unhein pohanchaya hai, woh tableegh ka farz ada kar chuke hain aur khud Rasool (ﷺ) ummat par shahadat denge ke aap (ﷺ) ne unhein deen pohancha diya aur haq-e-risalat ada kar diya. Is babat jitni hadithein hain aur is bare ki jitni tafseer hai woh hum sab ki sab Surah Baqarah ke satrahein ruku ki aayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنٰكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّسَطًا لِّتَكُوْنُوْا شُهَدَاۗءَ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَيَكُـوْنَ الرَّسُوْلُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 143) ki tafseer mein likh aaye hain. Is liye yahan ise dobara bayan karne ki zaroorat nahin wahin dekh li jaye. Wahin Hazrat Nuh (A.S) aur un ki ummat ka waqia bhi bayan kar diya hai. Phir farmata hai ke itni bari azeem-ush-shan nemat ka shukriya tumhein zaroor ada karna chahiye. Jis ka tareeqa yeh hai ke jo Allah ke faraiz tum par hain unhein shauq khushi se baja lao, khusoosan namaz aur zakat ka poora khayal rakho. Jo kuch Allah ne wajib kiya hai use dili mohabbat se baja lao aur jo cheezein haram kar di hain us ke paas bhi na phatko. Pas namaz jo khalis Rab ki hai aur zakat jis mein Rab ki ibadat ke ilawa makhlooq ke sath ehsan bhi hai ke ameer log apne maal ka ek hissa faqiron ko khushi khushi dete hain. Un ka kaam chalta hai, dil khush ho jata hai.

Is mein bhi hai ke Allah ki taraf se bahut aasani hai, hissa kam bhi hai aur saal bhar mein ek hi martaba. Zakat ke kul ahkaam Surah Taubah ki aayat-e-zakat (Innamas-sadaqatu lil-fuqara-i wal-masakini wal-amilina alaiha wal-mu'allafati qulubuhum wa fir-riqabi wal-gharimina wa fi sabilillahi wabnis-sabili faridatam minallahi wallahu alimun hakim) (Surah At-Taubah: 60) ki tafsir mein hum ne bayan kar diye hain, wahin dekh liye jayen. Phir hukm hota hai ke Allah par pura bharosa rakho, isi par tawakkul karo, apne tamam kaamon mein us ki imdad talab kiya karo, har waqt aitimaad us par rakho, isi ki ta'eed par nazrein rakho. Woh tumhara Maula hai, tumhara hafiz hai, nasir hai, tumhein tumhare dushmanon par kamyabi ata farmane wala hai, woh jis ka wali ban gaya use kisi aur ki wilayat ki zaroorat nahin, sab se behtar wali wahi hai, sab se behtar madadgar wahi hai, tamam duniya go dushman ho jaye lekin woh sab par qadir hai aur sab se zyada qawi hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Waheeb bin Ward (R.H) se marwi hai ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Apne gusse ke waqt tu mujhe yaad kar liya kar, main bhi apne ghazab ke waqt tujhe maafi farma diya karunga, aur jin par mera azab nazil hoga main tujhe un mein se bacha lunga, barbad hone walon ke sath tujhe barbad na karunga. Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Jab tujh par zulm kiya jaye to sabr-o-zabt se kaam le, mujh par nigahain rakh, meri madad par bharosa rakh, meri imdad par raazi reh, yaad rakh main teri madad karun yeh us se bahut behtar hai ke tu aap apni madad kare. (Allah Ta'ala hamein bhalaiyon ki taufiq de, apni imdad naseeb farmaye, Ameen). Wallahu A'lam.
